Freightos.description:
As a Business Development Executive, you’ll bring that crucial industry know-how to the table. We don't expect you to have checked every single box, but you should have a solid, foundational understanding of how the freight and logistics puzzle fits together. Ideally, your background looks something like this:
From the Freight Forwarding World: You know the ins and outs of export, import, or domestic logistics across air, ocean, or ground freight—whether you gained that experience in sales or operations.
From Logistics Service Providers: Maybe you’ve worked directly with airlines, trucking companies (LTL/FTL), ocean carriers, or handled the daily hustle at terminals, docks, and warehouses.
From Logistics Tech: Or perhaps you come from the software side, helping supply chain and logistics companies digitize their operations.
Responsibilities
In this role, you’ll balance high-level business development strategy with a lot of hands-on, day-to-day grit. Here is what your focus will look like:
Hunt for New Business: You'll proactively identify and pursue fresh opportunities through smart prospecting, cold outreach, and active networking.
Own the Pitch: You'll schedule and conduct engaging meetings to show prospective clients exactly how our platform can make their lives easier.
Sell Responsively: We lean into consultative selling, which means you'll dive deep into client pain points, understand their unique business operations, and tailor our solution to fit.
Master the Platform: You'll become an expert on our SaaS platform so you can seamlessly showcase its value and handle any question that comes your way.
Onboard & Retain: You'll guide new users through training so they comfortably adopt the platform, while keeping an eye on account management and upsell opportunities.
Represent the Brand: You'll hit the road to represent us at key industry conferences, trade shows, and regional networking events.
Requirements
About You
Requirements
Whether you're typing up an email or chatting live, your English communication skills need to be absolutely top-notch.
You have at least 2+ years of experience hunting for new business and successfully upselling existing accounts.
You are just as comfortable building relationships over phone and video calls as you are pitching face-to-face.
You have the training skills needed to help new users embrace a brand-new, tech-driven way of booking freight.
You're a proactive, results-oriented professional who thrives when given the independence to meet and exceed targets.
Speaking of colleagues, we love team players. Which team doesn’t? You’ll fit right in if you love collaborating.
You are based in and are legally authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employer sponsorship.
Preferred Qualifications
If you want to score some extra bonus points, it’s a massive plus if you have...
Deep knowledge of the air cargo, LTL, or freight forwarding industries.
Experience working within an online transactional business (like a tech company driven by price-per-transaction revenue).
Direct experience selling SaaS platforms.
Bilingual capabilities or previous experience navigating a global company culture.
Benefits:
Pay: $70K annually + variable
Paid Holidays, Unlimited Paid Time Off, 100% Company-paid Health Insurance, 401K enrollment eligibility after 90 days, and a company match is available after one year of employment.
Schedule:
M-F 9-5 EST hours per day.
Location: Dallas, Texas, or other cities in Texas; open to Central or East Coast time zones.

About the Role
We are looking for a proactive, impact-driven Customer Success Specialist to own the post-onboarding lifecycle for enterprise accounts in the APAC region. In this role, you will be the ultimate champion for user adoption, platform value realization, and cross-functional coordination. You will bridge the gap between commercial strategy and day-to-day execution, ensuring our forwarder and shipper clients fully leverage the power of the Freightos platform.
If you excel at turning technical escalations into seamless customer experiences, driving user engagement, and protecting revenue streams through deep product expertise, we want to hear from you.
Requirements
Responsibilities
Drive Platform Adoption & Account Health
Own the post-go-live lifecycle for designated regional accounts to maximize user adoption and platform value.
Proactively monitor account health to identify low-usage trends, friction points, and churn risks early.
Identify expansion opportunities by helping customers scale usage across new workflows and internal teams.
Partner with Sales / Account Management by providing regular updates on client health, risks, and growth signals.
Deliver Enablement & Training
Lead post-onboarding training sessions, advanced product refreshers, and best-practice workshops for clients.
Ensure a smooth transition for customers moving from initial onboarding into long-term customer success.
Support scalable education by contributing to user documentation, training guides, and self-service content.
Client Escalations Management
Act as the primary customer point of contact for complex, high-priority, or post-go-live technical issues.
Coordinate cross-functionally with Operations, Product, Engineering, PMO to build clear resolution paths.
Provide customers with clear and timely updates throughout the lifecycle of key customer requests and critical escalations.
Enable Commercial Teams & Feedback Loops
Absorb non-commercial operational tasks to free up Sales and Account Management teams for revenue-generating activities.
Maintain clear boundaries by supporting adoption and customer experience without taking on commercial quota or contract ownership.
Translate customer insights and product feature gaps into structured feedback for the Product and Operations teams.
Basic requirements
2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Account Management, Solution Consulting, Implementation, or high impact customer facing role
Strong experience working with B2B SaaS, logistics technology, freight forwarding, marketplaces, or supply chain solutions.
Experience managing enterprise, mid-market, or strategic customers.
Strong understanding of the post-golive customer lifecycle, including adoption, enablement, customer health, retention, and value realization.
Ability to identify churn risks, adoption gaps, and customer experience issues early.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem solving skills.
Ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, Account Management, Product and Operations
Comfortable creating structure in a fast moving environment where ownership is not always clearly defined.
Strong documentation and process mindset.
Strong verbal and written English communication skills. Relevant regional language skills (Chinese, Korean, for example) are a strong plus.
Experience working with customers across multiple time zones.
﻿Preferred requirements
Experience in freight forwarding, logistics, air freight, ocean freight, procurement, rate management, or digital freight platforms.
Experience with Salesforce, Zoho, Jira, Confluence, support tools, or knowledge base systems.
Ability to understand technical topics such as APIs, integrations, platform configurations, or customer workflows at a business level.
﻿ Why Freightos is the Perfect Runway for Your Career!
Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely while collaborating with a dynamic and supportive team.
A multicultural global team makes global freight easier. You’ll work with people from around the world, gain new perspectives, and experience diverse ways of thinking—fun and eye-opening!
Statutory benefits in accordance with local regulations.

Gamida Cell is a leader in advanced cellular therapies and hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, with two FDA approved therapies, Omisirge® (omidubicel-onlv) and APHEXDA® (motixafortide). Omisirge® is a nicotinamide (NAM) modified allogeneic hematopoietic progenitor cell therapy that is potentially curative for patients with hematologic malignancies. APHEXDA® is a CXCR4 antagonist with long receptor occupancy indicated in combination with filgrastim to mobilize hematopoietic stem cells to the peripheral blood for collection and subsequent autologous transplantation in patients with multiple myeloma.

General Motors.description:
About the Role
We are seeking a Senior Researcher - Wireless Connectivity & AI to drive innovation at the intersection of wireless communications, AI/ML, and automotive applications.
This role combines deep technical expertise in wireless systems with advanced data-driven methods to unlock new capabilities and improve real-world performance beyond current limits.
What will YOU do?
Analyze connectivity system performance using data collected from field deployments, lab measurements, and simulations
Benchmark performance against commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) devices and identify key performance gaps
Develop models and methodologies—leveraging AI/ML and analytical techniques—to improve connectivity robustness and user experience
Design and evaluate system-level optimizations for in-vehicle connectivity across multiple radio technologies
Influence next-generation connectivity architectures and standards with a focus on enhancing customer-facing applications
Collect, preprocess, and analyze large-scale connectivity datasets from simulations, lab measurements, and field deployments
Develop predictive models for:
Physical layer (link-level) performance
End-to-end system and network performance
Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)
PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field
Strong background in wireless communications, including:
Physical layer and higher-layer protocols
Cellular (4G/5G) and WLAN systems
Real-world deployment considerations and KPI trade-offs
Solid foundation in:
Signal processing
Probability and statistics
Optimization
Estimation and detection theory
Information theory
Proven experience in AI/ML, including model development and evaluation
Proficiency in programming: Python, MATLAB, C/C++
Experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch)
What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)
Experience in applied research and transitioning ideas into practical solutions
Background in system-level simulations or real-world measurement campaigns
Familiarity with automotive connectivity use cases and constraints
Contributions to research or standardization (publications, patents, 3GPP/IEEE involvement)
Why Join Us
This is a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of wireless connectivity innovation, combining AI, communications, and real-world automotive applications . You will have the ability to influence both current vehicle performance and future industry standards , while working with a highly skilled, multidisciplinary team.
GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need gm immigration sponsorship now or in the future.
This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the selected candidate is expected to report to a specific location at least 3 times a week {or other frequency dictated by their manager}.
This job is not eligible for relocation benefits. Any relocation costs would be the responsibility of the selected candidate.
About GM
Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.
Why Join Us
We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team.
Total Rewards | Benefits Overview
From day one, we're looking out for your well-being–at work and at home–so you can focus on realizing your ambitions. Learn how GM supports a rewarding career that rewards you personally by visiting Total Rewards resources .
Non-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities (U.S.)
General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. We strongly believe that providing an inclusive workplace creates an environment in which our employees can thrive and develop better products for our customers.
All employment decisions are made on a non-discriminatory basis without regard to sex, race, color, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, disability, pregnancy or maternity status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran or protected veteran, or any other similarly protected status in accordance with federal, state and local laws.
We encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for any positions that match their skills and capabilities. Applicants in the recruitment process may be required, where applicable, to successfully complete a role-related assessment(s) and/or a pre-employment screening prior to beginning employment. To learn more, visit How we Hire .
Accommodations
General Motors offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us [email protected] or call us at 1-800-865-7580. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

General Motors.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our team.
This role reports directly to the Director of Software Engineering and is a senior technical leadership position for someone who is exceptionally strong in hands-on software engineering and can also drive meaningful change across multiple teams, domains, and technical layers.
This person will operate across Android, RTOS, embedded systems, platform integration, and product delivery boundaries, helping shape direction, solve critical problems, and raise engineering execution across the organization.
The right candidate has the technical depth to go deep into architecture and implementation, the judgment to navigate ambiguity, and the credibility to work directly with senior managers, directors, architects, and cross-functional leaders. They should be comfortable switching between senior technical leadership and direct hands-on work in code, debugging, design reviews, integration, and problem solving.
What will YOU do?
Lead technically complex efforts across Android, RTOS, and embedded software domains within the vehicle camera organization.
Drive architecture, design, and implementation decisions for critical software systems and cross-domain integrations.
Stay close to the code and work hands-on in ambiguous, high-risk, or high-impact areas.
Identify and resolve systemic technical issues that span components, teams, or organizational boundaries.
Influence software direction across platform, application, integration, and vehicle-level concerns.
Partner closely with engineering leaders, architects, systems engineering, program teams, and global stakeholders to align technical strategy with execution reality.
Translate broad product or organizational needs into practical technical plans, engineering improvements, and measurable outcomes.
Raise the technical bar through design reviews, code quality expectations, engineering rigor, and strong technical judgment.
Drive improvements in development practices, integration approaches, debugging efficiency, and delivery predictability.
Mentor and influence engineers across the organization through technical excellence, clarity, and execution.
Help the organization make sound tradeoffs across speed, quality, scalability, maintainability, and vehicle/program constraints.
Contribute to software that ultimately runs in production vehicles and supports critical customer-facing and safety-relevant functionality.
Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)
B.Sc. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
Over 10 years of hands-on software engineering experience building complex production systems.
Strong experience in embedded software development, including low-level debugging, performance analysis, and system integration.
Significant experience with Android and/or RTOS-based systems in production environments.
Strong proficiency in C++ and/or C in complex software systems.
Proven track record of driving technical outcomes across multiple teams or domains through influence, ownership, and execution.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a senior technical leadership capacity, working directly with directors, senior managers, architects, and cross-functional leaders.
Strong software engineering fundamentals in system design, architecture, concurrency, debugging, performance, and maintainability.
Experience working in large-scale, cross-site, cross-functional software organizations.
What Can Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)
Experience in automotive, camera systems, computer vision pipelines, or safety-relevant embedded platforms.
Strong background in multi-domain systems that combine platform software, application logic, hardware-aware constraints, and vehicle integration.
Experience with software running on resource-constrained or real-time environments.
Familiarity with Android platform internals, middleware, BSP/system bring-up, or similar platform-level work.
Experience improving engineering effectiveness across organizations through better architecture, technical decision-making, tooling, development workflows, or integration practices.
M.Sc. or other advanced technical degree.
Why this role matters
This role is central to how we scale technical excellence in a growing and increasingly complex organization. It is an opportunity to shape both product and engineering direction, work on real systems that ship to vehicles, and have broad impact across critical camera and embedded software domains.
This is the right role for someone who wants to stay deeply hands-on, operate at high scope, and lead through expertise, judgment, and execution.

Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.

We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team.

Gett.description:
You'll lead a cross-functional team of Product Managers, owning the consumer product suite end-to-end, from strategy and roadmap to execution and outcomes. This is a role for someone who combines strong people leadership with sharp product and UX instincts, and who's comfortable operating where consumer experience meets B2B complexity (corporate accounts, bookers, admins) and regulated markets.
Why This Role
Our consumer product suite at Gett isn't a single app - it's a portfolio spanning private riders, B2B bookers, and admin tooling, operating across regulated markets with real compliance and pricing constraints. HiBob helps modern, mid-size businesses transform the way they manage people, giving HR and managers all they need to connect, engage, develop, and retain top talent. Since 2015, we’ve achieved consecutive triple-digit year-over-year growth, all backed by our amazing team of Bobbers from across the globe, making us the choice HRIS of over 5,500 midsize and multinational companies and over 1 Milion users.

As part of our Finance Revenue Operations function, you’ll play a critical role in driving deal efficiency, quote management, facilitating contract review, pricing strategy, and cross-functional collaboration — helping us scale smarter and close deals faster.
You’ll report to the Head of Deal Desk and work closely with stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and MIS .
If you are a highly motivated, organized, proactive, independent, self-starter who enjoys working in a dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative environment, Hibob is where you want to be! Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Legal, Finance, MIS) to remove roadblocks and accelerate deal cycles.
Own and maintain Salesforce data quality for closed deals; define and enforce deal hygiene standards .
Analyze deal patterns, pricing trends, and process bottlenecks ; surface actionable insights to improve efficiency and profitability.
Support the rollout of automation, process improvements, and reporting tools within the Deal Desk ecosystem.
Contribute to the creation and refinement of playbooks, guidelines, and best practices .
Participate in enablement and education for internal teams on deal structuring, quoting tools, and commercial policies.
requirements

Excel/Google Sheets (formulas, pivot tables, etc.) and familiarity with BI tools or dashboarding (e.g.,Tableau).

Israeli High-tech / startup with multi-national teams experience — required.
BA in Economics, Business, Industrial Engineering, Finance, or related field (LL.B also considered).

As Commission Analyst at HiBob, you’ll own one of our most visible and business-critical functions — ensuring that all commission-based people across our GTM and CS organizations are rewarded accurately, transparently, and on time.
You’ll own end-to-end commission operations for a global population of 400+ Sales and CS employees, partnering closely with Sales, Finance, People, and Revenue Operations teams. This is a high-impact role focused on commission calculations, plan implementation, reporting, dispute resolution, and continuous process improvement, where accuracy, analytical thinking, and cross-functional collaboration are essential.

Investigate Discrepancies & Disputes Analyze payout issues and employee inquiries using data and how the system is built to calculate them, and feed common themes back into plan or process improvements.
Support System Changes & Testing Test and validate changes to plans, calculation rules, and integrations before release, including their impact on affected employees.

This role will be central to shaping how organizations plan their workforce, manage positions and headcount, align people plans with business priorities, and make better decisions through clear, reliable data.

Hud.description:
About the Role
This is a hybrid role combining hands-on software engineering, deep production debugging, and direct customer engagement.
You will work directly inside customer production systems, integrating Hud’s SDK, solving real-world issues, and shaping how our product is used in practice. At the same time, you will translate field learnings into scalable product improvements and reusable systems.
We’re building a runtime code sensor that operates where most tools don’t: inside running applications. Our goal is to give engineers and AI agents real-time, high-fidelity visibility into how code behaves in production—under real load, real traffic, and real failures.
This role blends deep systems engineering with applied, real-world problem solving. You’ll navigate complex production environments, explore runtime behavior, and design low-overhead solutions that are safe, reliable, and production-ready.
If you enjoy breaking (and fixing) complex systems, working closely with customers, and building tools that engineers trust in their most critical services—this role is for you.
What You’ll Do
Own technical execution end-to-end across customer engagements and internal tooling
Integrate Hud’s SDK into complex production systems across different environments and stacks
Debug real production issues (performance, reliability, edge cases) and demonstrate Hud’s value
Build and ship code (primarily in FDE tooling and internal codebases)
Design and implement repeatable agentic workflows , where production signals power automated workflows across the SDLC
Create reusable assets such as playbooks, runbooks, templates, reference architectures, and demo environments
Turn recurring customer pain points into scalable solutions and product improvements
Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to translate field insights into features and capabilities
Lead technical customer interactions, including calls, debugging sessions, and written communication
Why You Should Join
High-impact role – Play a critical role in how customers adopt and extract value from Hud
Shape the product – Turn real-world production challenges into product capabilities
Build from zero to one – Define workflows, playbooks, and systems for this function
Work at the frontier of AI + production systems – Help define how production signals power agentic workflows
Fast-moving environment – Ship constantly, iterate quickly, and take real ownership
Hard Skills & Experience
6+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, field engineering, or technical leadership roles
Strong backend engineering fundamentals and production debugging skills
Deep expertise in at least one runtime: Node.js / TypeScript, Python, or Java (JVM)
Experience working within real production systems, including troubleshooting latency, memory issues, regressions, and distributed system failures
Strong understanding of modern backend architectures:
Microservices and distributed systems
Async and event-driven systems
Containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
Cloud environments and production reliability challenges
Hands-on experience building or integrating SDKs, devtools, or production-facing components
Strong performance engineering skills (CPU/memory profiling, minimizing overhead)
Ability to design safe, stable, and resilient systems that operate inside customer environments
Full-time, on-site role in Tel Aviv
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment
Engineering Excellence & Mindset
Strong ownership mindset: code quality, reliability, observability, and documentation
Bias to action—build fixes, tools, and workarounds rather than only providing guidance
Ability to anticipate risks, identify bottlenecks, and drive long-term improvements
Comfortable balancing technical trade-offs with product and customer needs
Autonomous, proactive, and capable of leading technical initiatives
Strong communication skills and comfort in customer-facing environments
Nice to Have
Experience with observability, performance monitoring, or developer tooling
Background in SDKs, instrumentation, or in-process production components
Experience designing AI-assisted SDLC workflows (LLM agents, evaluations, guardrails, human-in-the-loop systems)
Familiarity with runtime internals (e.g., event loop, GC, JIT, tracing hooks)
Experience with APM agents, tracing systems, or telemetry pipelines
Exposure to low-overhead instrumentation techniques (sampling, bytecode manipulation, eBPF)
Previous customer-facing technical roles such as FDE, Solutions Engineering, or Sales Engineering

Hud.description:
About the Role
We’re building a runtime code sensor that operates where most tools don’t: inside running applications. Our goal is to give engineers and AI agents real-time, high-fidelity visibility into how code actually behaves in production – under real load, real traffic, and real failures.
This role blends deep systems engineering with applied research . You’ll dive into runtime internals, explore undocumented behavior, design low-overhead instrumentation, and turn research insights into production-grade components that safely run in customer environments. One day you might analyze GC or JIT behavior; the next, design tracing mechanisms that survive real-world distributed systems.
If you get excited about runtime internals, enjoy breaking (and fixing) complex systems, think like both a researcher and a production engineer, and care deeply about performance, safety, and correctness – you’ll feel right at home here. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for engineers who want to ship technology that engineers actually trust to run in their most critical services.
Engineering Excellence / Mindset
Ability to anticipate technical risks, identify bottlenecks, and drive long-term engineering improvements.
Takes ownership of code quality, documentation, reliability, and observability.
Comfortable working with product teams to balance technical trade-offs with user and business needs.
Autonomous and proactive; capable of mentoring others or leading technical initiatives.
Bonus Points
Background in security agents, observability tools, or other components deployed directly into customer environments.
Experience with APM agents, JVM agents, Python tracing, V8 internals, or other instrumentation/profiling frameworks.
Experience with telemetry systems (metrics, tracing, logging) including batching, rate-limiting, and safe data collection.
Familiarity with sampling techniques, bytecode manipulation, eBPF, or low-overhead tracing.
Exposure to safety-critical or high-throughput environments where reliability and minimal overhead are mandatory.
Contributions to open-source instrumentation, tracing, or internals-related projects.
Requirements
This is a full-time on-site position located in Tel Aviv.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced startup environment is essential.
Experience
5+ years of hands-on research or development roles.
Deep expertise in at least one runtime (Node.js, Python, or Java/JVM), including understanding of internals (event loop, GC, tracing hooks, bytecode/JIT, etc.).
Hands-on experience building in-process production components (SDKs, agents, profilers, monitoring/security tools) that must be safe, stable, and backward-compatible.
Strong performance engineering skills – profiling CPU/memory, avoiding overhead, understanding how instrumentation affects runtime behavior.
Defensive engineering mindset – experience designing systems that fail-open, degrade gracefully, protect the host application, and never introduce instability.
Track record debugging production issues (latency, memory leaks, regressions, deadlocks) in real-world distributed systems.
Solid understanding of modern backend architectures – experience with microservices, distributed systems, async and event-driven patterns, containers/orchestration (Docker/K8s), cloud runtimes, and the performance or reliability challenges they introduce.
Proven ability to ship stable, resilient, maintainable systems in production.

Active coaching of Process Operators towards conducting root cause analysis on equipment prior to notifying maintenance of a problem. Ensure required safety self-inspections are completed. Immunai.description:
Description
About Immunai:
Immunai is an AI-driven platform company focused on improving drug discovery and development by decoding the human immune system.
We combine large-scale single cell immune data, advanced machine learning, and strong engineering to help pharmaceutical and research partners make better, more informed decisions throughout the drug development process.
Our long-term goal is to reduce drug development failure rates and help more effective medicines reach patients. We’re building this platform thoughtfully and collaboratively, bringing together expertise across biology, AI, engineering, and business.
Immunai is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
About the role:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced LLM/ML Agentic AI Researcher to lead the technical development of our agentic AI interpretation framework. This hands-on role involves designing, building, and evaluating AI agents that interpret complex biological data.
You will be at the forefront of developing a sophisticated scientific reasoning system that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to provide structured, biologically-grounded explanations. Collaborating closely with immunologists, machine learning researchers, and technical leadership, you'll shape how we derive insights at a systems level, pushing the boundaries of AI in biology.
Location: Ramat Gan, Israel (Hybrid role)
What will you do?
Design, prototype, and build LLM-based agentic systems that reason over biological data, scientific literature, model outputs, and internal tools.
Develop agents capable of structured reasoning, hypothesis generation, explanation, planning, tool use, and iterative scientific analysis.
Build robust evaluation frameworks for agentic systems, including automated and human-in-the-loop evaluation pipelines.
Define and implement benchmarks, metrics, and test suites for measuring agent performance, including reasoning quality, biological grounding, factuality, robustness, reproducibility, and usefulness.
Work closely with AI researchers, computational biologists, immunologists, and product teams to translate scientific needs into measurable AI capabilities.
Create evaluation datasets and benchmark tasks that reflect real-world biological and therapeutic reasoning problems.
Analyze agent behavior, failure modes, hallucinations, tool-use errors, reasoning gaps, and grounding issues.

Intuit Israel.description:
In this role you will define, design, and build groundbreaking AI solutions that understand, reason, and act across complex financial and business contexts.
You will collaborate closely with cross-functional experts across AI research, data science, engineering, and product to create intelligent agents that help SMBs automate financial tasks, make smarter decisions, and operate more efficiently. Your work will combine scientific rigor with visionary execution, balancing theoretical innovation with large-scale practical impact.
As a Staff Scientist you set technical direction beyond your own projects. You are a builder-scientist — a creative thinker who develops novel model architectures and training paradigms and also drives their implementation and validation in real-world applications — and you raise the scientific bar for the teams around you. You will help shape the AI foundation that powers transformative products serving millions of customers.
Responsibilities
Set technical direction. Define the technical strategy and roadmap for next-generation agentic and foundation-model systems, and drive innovation and scientific excellence across the organization.
Build foundational models and agents. Design and develop foundational language models and agentic architectures that power intelligent decision-making for small and medium businesses.
Advance the science. Explore novel approaches in large-scale pretraining, fine-tuning (SFT and RLFT/GRPO), retrieval-augmented generation, and reasoning to improve factuality, adaptability, and alignment.
Solve real financial work. Build intelligent agents that understand financial data, customer context, and business workflows — from bookkeeping and autonomous accounting to planning, communication, and insight generation.
Leverage Intuit’s data moat. Turn Intuit’s unique ecosystem signals — counterparty behavior, two-sided transaction visibility, and business twins — into defensible modeling advantages.
Ship end-to-end. Take work from experimentation to production, owning evaluation frameworks and metrics that prove real-world impact.
Elevate others. Mentor scientists and engineers, review technical designs, and grow the craft of the wider team — a core expectation at the Staff level.
Collaborate across functions. Partner with AI research, engineering, product, and design to translate breakthrough science into scalable products used by millions.
Share knowledge. Publish and present research findings, internal innovations, or contributions to open-source frameworks where appropriate.
Qualifications
Qualifications
Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Math, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field, with a track record of technical leadership on complex AI systems.
Proven experience with LLMs, multimodal, or foundation models — including pretraining, fine-tuning, and deployment.
Deep understanding of transformer architectures, reinforcement learning, reasoning models, and agentic systems.
Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML and agentic frameworks .
Demonstrated ability to build end-to-end AI pipelines, from experimentation to production at scale.
Experience influencing technical direction across multiple teams and mentoring other scientists and engineers.
Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills.
A passion for creating AI that augments human potential and simplifies complex business workflows.
Nice to have
Experience applying RL fine-tuning (GRPO, RLHF/RLFT) or model-based RL to language or decision-making systems.
Background in financial, accounting, or business-domain AI, or in probabilistic forecasting and world models is a major advantage.
Publications at top ML venues or meaningful open-source contributions.

sland is the ideal environment for enterprise work, where security is everywhere without ever getting in the way.
The Island Enterprise Platform unifies AI enablement, network access, data protection, identity, and endpoint control into one coherent workspace—so organizations get universal visibility and control, and users get a fast, fluid, beautifully simple experience. It's not just a better way to secure work. It's a better way to work. Backed by investors like Coatue Management, Insight Partners, Sequoia Capital and Cyberstarts, and trusted by some of the largest, most respected enterprises on the planet, Island is redefining what the modern workplace can be.
Come join us in building something that's already changing how the world works
We’re a team of hungry, high-character professionals from all backgrounds who came together to reinvent work for the modern enterprise.
What you will do:
Improve RnD velocity by finding ways to improve CI stability and performance.
Build and maintain CI pipelines that will deliver a high-quality standard of code to our customers.
Create monitoring tools and metrics to understand R&D pain points, identify production issues, and ensure the product always works.
Allow developers to write E2E tests for any feature needed while supporting all platforms.
Create tools for developers to work locally and on the developer stage, allowing them to troubleshoot and test the code more easily before merging.
Description

5+ years of development experience, including writing integration tests E2E.

Experience working with multi-cloud, a strong understanding of how servers communicate.
Familiarity with DevOps tools (Kubernetes, Dockers, Terraform, etc.).
Strong problem-solving abilities and a data-driven approach to decision-making.
Great communication skills, with high service awareness.
Experience in monitoring, working with Grafana, SQL, etc - Advantage.
Experience developing in C# and Python - Advantage.

Island.description:
As a Product Support Engineer you will have a pivotal role in providing assistance to our customers and sales team by addressing technical inquiries, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring the uninterrupted functionality of The Enterprise Browser throughout the entire customer journey.
In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a small, but highly skilled and talented team. You will have the freedom to self-promote and take on additional responsibilities as you see fit. This is a great opportunity for someone who is looking to make a big impact in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
We are looking for engineers whose customer obsession is in their DNA and who possess a strong eagerness to learn, evolve and become experts in our cutting-edge technologies.
This position is Dallas-based.
Responsibilities:
Provide exceptional technical support to enterprise customers, promptly addressing their queries and issues via various communication channels (email, phone, chat).
Demonstrate a deep understanding of our products and its integration with clients' systems to offer effective solutions and guidance.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including development and QA, to escalate and resolve critical customer issues promptly.
Document customer interactions, technical solutions, and best practices to create an organized knowledge base for both internal and external use.
Actively contribute to product improvement by providing valuable feedback and insights gained from customer interactions.
Work independently with a self-sufficient and proactive approach while adhering to established SLAs and performance metrics.
Ability to work off-hours when needed.
Description
This position is Dallas-based.
5+ years of hands-on experience in support roles, working directly with enterprise customers.
5+ years of proven experience in troubleshooting methodologies and problem-solving skills.
3+ years of working in a startup environment and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile atmosphere.
In-depth knowledge of network and security devices, such as Okta, Zscaler, and Siem.
Expertise in OS systems, including, Windows, Mac and Linux.
Strong debugging skills for Windows applications and a solid understanding of the HTTP protocol.
5+ years of experience with IT tasks like installing virtual machines and configuring IT environments.
5+ years of experience with support methodologies and tools (Confluence, Salesforce, Jira).
3+ years of experience working with Log systems like Coralogix, and Sentry.
Advantage - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Jeen.ai.description:
Description
Play a key role across the entire product lifecycle - from discovery and system definition to delivery and impact. This is a senior, technical product role with ownership across complex enterprise capabilities. You'll deeply understand customer needs, architecture, data flows, technology, and business goals, and translate them into scalable product execution. Your first mission: understand the existing product, market, and governance challenges and turn them into focus, clarity, and measurable outcomes.
This role includes hands-on product work and customer-facing discussions with government, defense, and security organizations in Israel and global markets.
Responsibilities
Own product metrics and outcomes, not just feature delivery
Lead technical discovery with enterprise customers and partners globally
Turn business, security, and governance needs into scalable system requirements
Own complex platform capabilities from concept to launch and trade-offs
Partner with Engineering and Architecture on design, integrations, and scale
Define data flows, APIs, permissions, and governance behavior
Present complex product capabilities to senior customer stakeholders
Research enterprise AI, governance, and the competitive landscape
Collaborate across Engineering, Architecture, Design, Sales, and Customer Success
Requirements
5+ years as a Product Manager for complex enterprise or platform products
Strong technical product background: architecture, APIs, data flows, and integrations
Experience with large-scale, data-intensive, distributed, or infrastructure systems
Experience with AI/Generative AI products and enterprise AI concepts
Experience defining scalable platform capabilities beyond UI features
Experience with governance, access control, security, auditability, or compliance
Proven customer-facing work with large enterprises and technical stakeholders
Strong product presentation skills with customers in Israel and abroad
Strong product fundamentals, ownership, prioritization, and execution
Preferred Qualifications
Deep experience with AI/ML products or platforms
Background in data platforms, architecture, infrastructure, or governance
B2B SaaS or enterprise software experience, ideally in regulated industries
Jeen.ai.title: Product Manager

Jeen.ai.description:
Description
About us
Jeen empowers enterprises with generative AI through advanced AI agents, automations, voice analytics, and knowledge-based insights across any cloud or on-premise environment. Trusted by industry leaders shaping tomorrow's technological landscape.
About the Role
Join a fast-growing AI company where product design shapes the core experience.
You will work closely with Product and Development teams to design scalable systems and high-quality user experiences for complex platforms.
Responsibilities
Build and maintain a modular Design System that supports product scalability and ensures consistency and development efficiency.
Lead end-to-end design processes, including research, UX flows, and high-precision, innovative UI tailored to user needs.
Collaborate closely with Product, Development, and Project teams to align on goals and deliver polished, functional experiences.
Integrate into existing workflows while identifying gaps and driving improvements in tools, methodology, and design quality.
Design new features and refine existing interfaces based on user insights, industry trends, and business objectives.
Requirements
1-2 years of experience in Product Design.
Proven experience designing complex systems and platform-level UX.
Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design thinking, problem solving, and execution.
High proficiency in Figma or similar design tools.
Experience working with visual AI tools and AI-driven interfaces.
Solid understanding and hands-on experience with design system architecture.
Experience designing animations, transitions, and micro-interactions as part of product UI.
Jeen.ai.title: Junior Product Designer

Jeen.ai.description:
Description
Jeen empowers enterprises with generative AI through advanced AI agents, automations, voice analytics, and knowledge-based insights across any cloud or on-premise environment. Trusted by industry leaders shaping tomorrow's technological landscape.
About the Role
Join a fast-growing company building next-generation AI platforms for large enterprises. Work hands-on on both core product development and real customer implementations, bridging engineering, AI, and business needs. This is a unique opportunity to influence both the product and how customers successfully adopt AI at scale, splitting your time between front-end development and AI agent configuration.
Responsibilities
Full Stack Development
Develop and maintain end-to-end product features across frontend and backend systems, including web applications using React, TypeScript
Develop backend logic, APIs, and integrations using Python and NestJS
Translate product and customer requirements into intuitive, high-quality solutions
Work closely with Product, AI, and Backend teams to deliver end-to-end features
Ensure performance, scalability, and clean UX across projects
Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices
AI Agents & Automations
Support implementation of Jeen.ai’s platform in customer environments
Configure and adapt AI solutions (agents, workflows, integrations) to customer needs
Connect AI agents to external systems, APIs, and data sources
Design agent logic, flows, and use-case driven automations
Support customer-facing AI implementations and POCs
Requirements
2+ years of software engineering experience, with strong frontend fundamentals and hands-on full-stack development experience
Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
Solid understanding of modern web application architecture
Experience working with REST APIs and databases (SQL)
Ability to take end-to-end ownership of features and technical solutions
Strong integration and problem-solving skills
Independent, curious, and comfortable working in fast-moving environments
Creative, independent, curious, and comfortable working in fast-moving environments
Basic familiarity with cloud environments, deployments, and containerized applications
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on experience with Langflow or similar orchestration tools
Experience building AI agents, automations, or LLM-based solutions
Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP)
Experience with Docker or containerized environments
Jeen.ai.title: Full Stack Engineer

Jeen.ai.description:
Description
Jeen.AI empowers enterprises with generative AI through advanced AI agents, automations, voice analytics, and knowledge-based insights across any cloud or on-premise environment. Trusted by industry leaders shaping tomorrow's technological landscape.
About the Role
Design prompts, build automations, and ensure AI model quality in a hands-on role. You’ll have creative freedom to shape innovative AI products while growing your technical skills in a fast-moving environment.
Responsibilities
Prompt Creation and Automation Development: Design and refine prompts to improve the performance of AI models and develop automations by integrating various LLM models
Python & SQL Coding: Write and debug code to support the development and enhancement of our AI-driven products
QA Testing: Conduct quality assurance tests on AI models and related software to ensure reliability and accuracy
Research: Stay up to date with the latest advancements in AI and related technologies to inform product development and strategy
Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, designers, and product managers, to drive project success
Requirements
Education: A degree in Industrial or Information Systems Engineering
Languages: Advanced proficiency in both English and Hebrew
Technical Skills: Coding abilities, preferably in Python and SQL
Attention to Details: Ability to meticulously manage and execute tasks with precision
Prior knowledge or experience with AI technologies - must
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a command/instructional role
Understanding of user interface design principles
Jeen.ai.title: Junior AI Solution Engineer

Jeen.ai.description:
Description
As a Technical Project Manager at Jeen.ai, you will lead the delivery of enterprise-grade AI projects from planning through execution. You’ll work closely with customers, engineering, and cross-functional teams to ensure smooth technical integrations, clear communication, and on-time delivery. This role combines strong project management skills with a solid technical background, enabling you to translate complex requirements into successful, scalable AI solutions in a fast-growing, innovative environment.
About the Role
Shape enterprise AI transformations from a technical perspective.
Lead complex implementations, own client relationships, and drive innovation in fast-paced environments where your technical expertise creates real business impact.
Responsibilities
Lead and manage full-cycle implementation projects, from planning to go-live
Own the client relationship from a technical perspective- requirements, customizations, installations, and version updates
Oversee the installation of JEEN’s platform across dev, test, and production environments, including integration with client systems
Collaborate with IT stakeholders and internal engineering teams
Coordinate cross-functional project roles in a matrix environment
Create detailed project plans, track progress, and ensure on-time delivery
Manage and execute version updates and technical change processes with the client
Requirements
2+ years of experience managing technical projects in enterprise environments
3+ years of hands-on development experience in data or digital domains
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent experience
A proven ability to deliver complex technical projects in fast-paced environments
Deep understanding of integration solutions and diverse IT systems
Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills
Experience with AI-related projects- a plus
Familiarity with large language models (LLMs)- a plus
Jeen.ai.title: Technical Project Manager

Jeen.ai.description:
Description
We're looking for an experienced Principal AI Architect to join Jeen and lead the architectural direction of our products.
In this role, you'll define the company's architectural vision, establish engineering standards, and drive technical decisions across multiple R&D teams. You'll work closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, AI, Security, and Data teams to build scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions while evaluating and adopting cutting-edge AI technologies.
This is a highly strategic and hands-on role, ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, mentoring engineering teams, and shaping the future of modern AI products.
Responsibilities
Define and lead the architectural vision across the organization.
Design scalable, secure, and high-performance distributed systems.
Establish architecture standards, best practices, and technical guidelines across multiple engineering teams.
Design and lead enterprise authentication, authorization, SSO, Groups, Policies, and identity management solutions.
Architect advanced GenAI solutions, including RAG, Embeddings, Vector Databases, LLM integrations, AI Agents, Guardrails, and large-scale inference workloads.
Define reference architectures and engineering standards for deployment, monitoring, observability, reliability, and security.
Drive architectural decisions around scalability, performance, availability, security, and operational efficiency.
Own the architectural roadmap while balancing business value, operational costs (COGS), scalability, and long-term maintainability.
Lead Proofs of Concept (POCs) to evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and developer productivity tools.
Promote engineering excellence through CI/CD best practices, observability, monitoring, security, and compliance.
Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, AI, DevOps, Security, Data teams, customers, and strategic partners.
Requirements
10+ years of software development experience, including 4+ years in architecture or technical leadership roles.
Proven experience designing large-scale distributed systems running on Kubernetes.
Strong experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Experience designing cloud-native architectures, microservices, serverless applications, and data pipelines.
Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience designing and deploying On-Premise / Air-Gapped environments.
Practical experience working with Generative AI technologies, including LLMs, RAG, Embeddings, Vector Databases, AI Agents, MCP, or similar AI frameworks.
Strong understanding of observability, monitoring, and performance optimization.
Experience implementing security and compliance best practices, including IAM, Secrets Management, and infrastructure hardening.
Excellent architectural thinking, problem-solving, mentoring, and technical leadership skills.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on software development experience with Python, TypeScript, Node.js, or similar languages.
Experience deploying SaaS and On-Premise enterprise products.
Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar observability platforms.
Experience with GPU optimization, AI inference infrastructure, or large-scale AI workloads.
Experience working in fast-growing AI startups or enterprise software companies.

Jeen.ai.description:
Description
Join Jeen Talk and help build one of the most advanced Enterprise Conversational AI platforms. You'll develop production-ready Voice AI and Chat AI solutions used by enterprise customers worldwide, working on real-time voice infrastructure, AI orchestration, and modern web applications.
You'll be part of a fast-moving startup environment with high ownership, working closely with Product, AI, and DevOps teams to build scalable AI-powered customer experience solutions.
Responsibilities
Develop production-grade AI Voice Agents and Chat Agents.
Build scalable backend services using Python and FastAPI.
Integrate OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, and additional AI providers.
Design scalable multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
Optimize performance, latency, scalability, and system reliability.
Participate in architecture discussions and technical planning.
Ensure high code quality through testing, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
Requirements
4+ years of Backend or Full Stack development experience, with a strong focus on backend development.
Strong hands-on experience with NestJS and TypeScript.
Strong experience designing and developing scalable backend services and architectures.
Experience building REST APIs and asynchronous services.
Experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, and relational data modeling.
Experience with Python and FastAPI or similar modern backend frameworks.
Experience with React and modern frontend development.
Experience integrating LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, or Claude.
Strong understanding of scalable software architecture and distributed systems.

We're looking for an Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our team in Tel Aviv. This is a revenue-driving role with a project management core: you'll own retention, upsell, and cross-sell targets for a portfolio of top-tier EMEA accounts, and you'll hit them by running tight, structured execution across every function that touches the account. Strong project management skills - proven ability to run complex, multi-stakeholder workstreams to a deadline
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and translate it into insights and actions
Demonstrated success in building and growing long-term, value-driven customer relationships that convert into expansion revenue
Comfortable operating in fast-paced, dynamic environments
Willingness to travel at least once per quarter

אנגלית ברמה גבוהה.

In this role you will support the Officers and Council and manage the secretariat, activities, and operations of the association in accordance with guidelines and objectives.
Responsibilities :
Responsibilities:
The Association Manager is responsible for the overall administration and smooth operation of the society, supporting its strategic, operational, and business objectives.
Key Areas of Responsibility:
Administration & Operations:
Manage the association’s day-to-day activities, stakeholder communication, documentation, and internal processes.
Meeting & Board Management:
Coordinate and manage virtual and in-person meetings (Board, committees, General Assembly), including logistics, materials, minutes, and follow-ups.
Executive & Governance Support:
Support the Board and Officers, implement strategic plans and policies, manage elections, governance processes, and key programs (e.g., grants, endorsements).
Project & Event Management:
Plan and deliver key projects, awards, grants, and support congress coordination with relevant stakeholders.
Communications & Marketing:
Manage member communications, newsletters, website, and social media; support branding, visibility, and promotional activities.
Financial Coordination:
Support financial operations including budgeting, invoicing, payments, reporting, and coordination with finance teams.
Membership Management:
Oversee membership processes, database management, renewals, engagement, and growth initiatives.
Stakeholder Management:
Work closely with Board members, partners, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure effective collaboration.
Qualifications:
University degree, or equivalent
Excellent English (written/spoken)
Excellent computer skills (Microsoft Office – Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
Working knowledge of online systems such as WordPress, CRM system.
Experience:
3–5 years of experience in an administrative, Project Managment, coordination role
Experience working with non-profit associations / NGOs – an advantage
The following skills and attributes are essential:
Strong administrative and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
Tech-savvy, with hands-on experience using a variety of digital tools (e.g., Canva, Mailchimp, Elementor, and similar platforms)
High level of commercial and financial awareness
Well-developed communication and interpersonal skills
Good judgment, with the ability to work independently, proactively, and creatively
Ability to build effective working relationships with a wide range of stakeholders, including international counterparts
Discretion, diplomacy, and strong attention to detail
WHAT WE OFFER: 
Competitive salary and full-time labor contract.
Flexible benefits program: food vouchers, optional additional health insurance, corporate discounts, etc.
Fixed working hours (Monday-Friday).
Hybrid working mode, excellent office location, and free shuttle bus from the metro station to the office.
Gifts for special occasions, fruits, massages, and yoga classes in the office once per week.
Real opportunities for professional development in a leading international company.
Friendly team culture that promotes initial and continual professional education and team collaboration.
Regular team events.
Refer a friend program.

Only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

Legit Security.description:
Description
About Legit Security
We are a well-funded cybersecurity startup backed by top-tier VCs, on a mission to solve some of the most challenging problems in software security — how to make AI-first organizations release applications securely, leveraging AI agents to create secure code from the start, and fix vulnerabilities automatically. In a world where attackers leverage AI to exploit software in minutes, this becomes a must-have capability for every organization.
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who doesn't just manage- they lead, own, and win. Someone who thrives at the intersection of deep technical understanding and sharp strategic thinking, and who knows how to turn customer pain into product that matters.
What you'll own
Take full ownership of product domains, from strategy to feature definition to delivery, driving growth and ensuring impactful results.
Engage directly with customers to deeply understand their needs and pain points and translate to actionable tasks
Define product features, backlogs, and roadmaps, collaborating closely with UX, design, and R&D with the power to build some of it yourself.
Communicate effectively and create alignment across sales, marketing, customer success, support, and R&D.
Requirements
What you’ll bring
A high-performing leader who owns their domain and gets things done
3–4 years of experience as a software developer or engineering team lead — experience in both is a significant advantage.
2–3 years of proven product management experience, particularly with enterprise B2B products.
Strong software engineering or DevOps background.
“Builder” mindset – come to build the product with us. Leverage AI to bypass blockers and lead with example.
Fluent English with outstanding communication and presentation skills.
Core product skills we value
Leader / Founder mindset
Hungry to win- energetic and pushing with ambition to make things happen
Strategic and first principal thinking
Presentation skills
Legit Security.title: Product Manager

Legit Security.description:
Description
About Legit Security
Legit Security is a well-funded cybersecurity company backed by top-tier VCs, on a mission to solve some of the most challenging problems in application security. We help AI-first organizations release software fast, without security slowing them down, by leveraging AI agents to secure code and remediate vulnerabilities automatically. We're leading a new era of AppSec, built for a world where AI writes the code.
﻿About the Role
We're looking for a driven, enterprise-focused Account Executive who knows how to create opportunities, not just close them. You'll own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, targeting security and development leaders at enterprise accounts across the US. If you thrive in fast-moving environments and know how to navigate a technical buyer, we'd love to meet you.
﻿ You Are
A pipeline builder. You proactively create opportunities through outbound, your network, and market knowledge.
A solution seller. You understand customer challenges and know how to map our platform to real business outcomes.
A strong communicator at the C-level- CISOs, VPs of AppSec, and DevSecOps leaders are your primary targets.
Persistent and process-driven. You can find, navigate, and close complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
A team player. Comfortable collaborating across sales, marketing, and customer success in a fast-moving startup.
Proficient with tools like ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Navigator, Salesforce, SalesLoft, and Clari.
Requirements
10+ years of sales experience, predominantly in SaaS solution selling to enterprise and larger mid-market accounts.
Strong background in cybersecurity sales- AppSec or DevSecOps experience is a significant advantage.
A network of CISOs, Directors of Application Security, DevOps, or DevSecOps.
Proven track record of overachievement in previous roles.
﻿Work Model
Remote - West Coast - USA
Sound like you? Give us a ping 🤙
Legit Security.title: Security Team Analyst Lead

Legit Security.description:
Description
Legit Security is looking for an experienced security leader to build and lead our Security Analyst team — the people who turn the latest threats, frameworks, and data into detections, fixes, content, and insights inside our product and for the industry
About Us
We are a well-funded cybersecurity startup backed by top-tier VCs. Our mission is to solve some of the most challenging problems in software security – how to make organizations build with AI fast, and stay secure, especially against the rising threats from supply chain attacks. Our solution provides full management from AI-generated code to deployment – helping customers analyze their software risk, fix it with agents and secure code during generation.
We are in a fast-growing new space and work hard to become the leader.
What you'll own
Own the business of security analysis in Legit – owning the quality and content of our risk detection, threat intelligence feed and security-matter-expertise.
Manage the team — set the bar for the work, coach analysts day-to-day, and own their development and performance.
Own the team's roadmap together with engineering, product and marketing: prioritize and bring initiatives to promote your business.
Be the focal point to lead Legit's response to global incidents in supply chain and application security — decide how the team reacts, what ships into the product, and what we publish externally.
Own the quality and voice of the team's security content — guides, remediation steps, in-product insights, blogs and social publications — and represent Legit as a thought leader in the space.
Partner with customers and field teams on high-stakes analyses of customer data and environments; present findings to security leaders and use those engagements to sharpen the team's focus.
Requirements
﻿What you’ll bring
﻿ Has experience leading a security research, detection or analyst team
Has deep hands-on background in cybersecurity or application security or supply chain security or a closely related domain.
Has some development experience (can be AI-based), and is comfortable with modern development workflows.
Knows how to balance speed and rigor — and how to make that trade-off legible to a team under incident pressure.
Writing and speaking skills in English enough to represent Legit publicly: customer executives, webcasts, blogs and social platforms.
If you think you are "Legit”, let's talk
Legit Security.title: Senior Product Manager

Lema AI.description:
Description
We are
Lema AI is a fast-growing, venture-backed B2B SaaS company on a mission to ensure modern businesses never fail because of a third-party incident. We’re reimagining the stagnant Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) and cyber resilience space by moving companies from reactive compliance to proactive, real-time risk prevention powered by advanced AI.
Already trusted by industry-leading enterprises, Lema is entering a phase of hypergrowth. We’re tripling our team as we build a category-defining platform, guided by a culture of radical ownership, transparency, and fast, cross-functional execution. If you thrive in high-context, high-impact environments, you’ll feel at home here.
More about Lema:
Lema.ai website
Business Insider - Cybersecurity startup Lema has come out of stealth to raise $24 million
Team8 - Why We Invested In Lema
About the TPRM market:
McKinsey - nearly one-third of recent cyber breaches originated from third parties
Hitch Partners - Third-party risk dominates security priorities, with AI-enhanced attacks and cloud misconfigurations completing the top three concerns.
About The Role
We’re looking for a a senior backend engineer with 6+ years of experience, playing a key role in building impactful, user-centric products from the ground up. As part of the company’s early engineering team, you’ll help shape both the product and the engineering culture, own backend architecture, lead end-to-end feature development, and drive technical excellence while collaborating closely with product, design, and infrastructure in a fast-growing environment.
What You’ll Do
Be one of our first 10 engineers, shaping both our product and our engineering culture.
Define and evolve the backend architecture, infrastructure and development best practices for a fast-growing team.
Own features end-to-end - from concept and design discussions to implementation, deployment and observability.
Solve complex challenges in distributed systems, event-driven architectures and real-time data pipelines.
Continuously improve developer workflows - identify friction, integrate new tools, automate repetitive tasks and champion engineering excellence.
Lead and mentor a small team of engineers: drive planning, break down work, ensure quality delivery and help hire exceptional talent.
Collaborate with experienced peers - engineers, PMs and designers - who’ve built large-scale systems at top-tier companies.
Here are some of the technologies we work with: Golang, Python, Protobuf, React, Typescript, Kafka, Postgresql, Redis, Kubernetes, Terraform and AWS
Requirements
What You Bring
A seasoned backend engineer (6+ years) who thrives on building impactful, user-centric products from the ground up.
Experienced in designing and scaling modern microservices architectures (both BE and FE integration).
Capable of taking complex features from design to deployment, owning every stage of the backend lifecycle - while guiding others to do the same.
Pragmatic about code quality: confident refactoring, simplifying and deleting code when needed.
Comfortable leading code reviews, defining engineering standards and collaborating across product, design and infrastructure.
Why Join Lema AI
Impact: Build a category-defining platform that safeguards how modern businesses operate.
Ownership: Join a culture that gives you full context, autonomy, and trust to drive outcomes.
Compensation & Benefits: Competitive salary, equity package, and additional perks
Velocity: Work with exceptional peers in a high-energy, low-bureaucracy environment.
Growth: Shape a company that’s scaling rapidly, backed by Tier 1 investors and visionary customers.
Lema AI.title: Senior Backend Engineer

Lightbits Labs.description:
In this role, you will work at the intersection of CUDA, GPU architecture, transformer inference, Rust systems programming, and large-scale AI serving platforms. You will design and build systems that intelligently manage KV cache placement across GPU, CPU, storage, and remote memory tiers while maximizing throughput, minimizing latency, and reducing infrastructure costs. This is a highly hands-on position for someone who enjoys solving deep performance challenges, optimizing every layer of the inference stack, and turning low-level innovations into customer-facing product value. Position based in Israel.
Responsibilities
Design and implement KV cache offloading, streaming, and memory management infrastructure for large-scale LLM serving.
Build cache-aware scheduling systems that determine when to keep, evict, prefetch, stream, compress, decompress, or recompute KV cache blocks.
Optimize inference runtimes such as vLLM and SGLang, including paged attention, prefix caching, schedulers, and cache management systems.
Develop mechanisms that overlap IO operations with attention execution to maximize GPU utilization and minimize latency.
Build high-performance components in Rust, C++, and CUDA for scheduling, cache coordination, telemetry, and inference optimization.
Profile and eliminate bottlenecks across GPU, CPU, memory, networking, storage, and runtime layers.
Design benchmark frameworks and performance tests for long-context, streaming, multi-turn, and high-concurrency workloads.
Measure and improve key inference metrics including TTFT, TBT/ITL, GPU utilization, cache hit rates, and cost per token.
Collaborate closely with Product, Platform, ML, and Engineering teams to deliver production-ready optimization capabilities.
Desired Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with CUDA programming and GPU performance optimization.
Deep understanding of transformer inference, attention mechanisms, KV cache architecture, batching, streaming generation, prefill, and decode.
Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, or similar LLM serving frameworks.
Experience designing or optimizing KV cache systems, including cache reuse, eviction, prefix caching, radix caching, or cache offloading.
Strong systems programming skills in Rust, C++, or both.
Strong Python skills for experimentation, benchmarking, and performance analysis.
Experience building performance-sensitive schedulers, async IO systems, or distributed infrastructure.
Strong debugging and profiling skills using tools such as Nsight, CUDA profiling tools, or custom telemetry systems.
Experience with GPUDirect, RDMA, NVMe, cache compression, FlashAttention, paged attention, or distributed inference architectures is a strong advantage.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

על התפקיד
אנחנו מחפשים מפתח/ת תוכנה מנוסה שיצטרף/תצטרף לצוות פיתוח מקצועי וייקח/תקח חלק בפיתוח מערכות מורכבות מקצה לקצה. התפקיד כולל פיתוח על פי מפרטים, הובלת רכיבים מרכזיים בפרויקט, ביצוע עבודות עיצוב ותכנות מורכבות, הנחיית מפתחים בצוות, תכנון וביצוע בדיקות סופיות ועבודה עם טכנולוגיות Frontend, Backend ותשתיות מתקדמות.
דרישות
• ניסיון של 4+ שנים בפיתוח תוכנה
• ניסיון מוכח בפיתוח Frontend עם HTML, CSS ו-JavaScript
• ניסיון בעבודה עם React, Angular או Vue.js
• ניסיון מוכח בפיתוח .NET Core או Java
• ניסיון בפיתוח Web API ושירותי רשת
• ניסיון בעבודה עם מסדי נתונים כגון SQL, PostgreSQL או MongoDB
• ניסיון בפיתוח והטמעת פתרונות Cloud , בדגש על Google Cloud
• יכולת עבודה עצמאית ובצוות, לצד הנחיה וליווי של מפתחים
היתרונות שלך
• ניסיון בעבודה עם עקרונות UI/UX Design
• ניסיון עם Docker , Kubernetes וטכנולוגיות קונטיינרים
• ניסיון בתכנון וביצוע בדיקות למערכות מורכבות
• ניסיון בהובלת רכיבי פיתוח מרכזיים ובהנחיית צוותי פיתוח
• היכרות מעמיקה עם סביבת פיתוח מודרנית ומתודולוגיות עבודה מתקדמות

Majestic Labs ai.description:
Description
About Majestic Labs
Majestic Labs is a deep-tech pioneer re-architecting AI systems for the data center to systematically dismantle the industry's most critical barrier: the "memory wall." Backed by a $100 million Series A closed in late 2025.
We’re a fast-moving AI startup building next-generation infrastructure for the world’s most demanding AI workloads. Our mission is to accelerate the future of intelligence by delivering cutting-edge server solutions optimized for large-scale inference and training. Backed by top-tier investors and led by industry veterans, we’re scaling rapidly and looking for a dynamic partnerships leader to help us win the trust of enterprise and hyperscaler customers.
We are a US-Israeli company looking for builders-engineers and operators who have shipped production hardware and know the crucial difference between compelling research and systems that operate at massive scale.
If you want to build infrastructure that fundamentally changes what the world can accomplish with AI, come join us!
About the position
Design and implement high-performance compute kernels for AI primitives such as GEMM, attention, normalization, and convolution.
Optimize for throughput, latency, and memory hierarchy across heterogeneous compute units (SIMD, matrix engines, DMA).
Collaborate with compiler and runtime teams to integrate kernels into Triton and PyTorch pipelines.
Profile and tune kernels using tools like Perfetto, VTune, Tracy, Nsight, or custom simulators.
Prototype and evaluate precision formats (FP16/BF16/FP8/e5m2, MXFP/FP4, etc.).
Contribute to micro-architecture feedback loops, helping co-design ISA and memory features with the hardware team.
Requirements
Degree at any level in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field from a recognized university.
Strong background in parallel programming (CUDA, Triton, RISC-V Vector (RVV), POSIX Threads, or OpenMP).
Deep understanding of memory layout, vectorization, thread/block scheduling, and cache behavior.
Experience programming wide-SIMD vector units and matrix/systolic engines.
Familiarity with the parallel-computing ecosystem and its high-performance libraries and
primitives, such as BLAS/BLIS, dense linear algebra, and parallel scan/reduce/sort.
Skilled in performance analysis and parallel debugging using tools such as GNU Debugger and Nsight.
Hands-on experience profiling and optimizing compute or AI workloads (e.g., GEMM, softmax, attention).
Solid grasp of numerical stability, precision formats, and mixed precision arithmetic.
Proficiency in C++17 or higher, with strong knowledge of standard algorithms, data structures, and generic programming paradigms.
Collaborative work style with the ability to operate effectively in multicultural, cross-disciplinary environments.
Preferred qualifications
Experience with optimization of irregular algorithms, such as graph computations or sparse
numerical linear algebra, combining high-level data structure design with low-level SIMD and synchronization optimizations.
Familiarity with LLVM/MLIR.
RISC-V systems or bare-metal programming, including RISC-V vector and matrix extensions.
We seek smart, curious, self-driven individuals who enjoy creative problem-solving and continuous learning. Even if you don't meet all requirements, we'd love to hear from you if you have the mindset to tackle complex challenges.
Majestic Labs is an equal opportunity employer deeply committed to diversity of background and thought. If you are ready to dare greatly, learn from mistakes, engage in vigorous debates, and help create a step-function shift in human technical capability, we want to meet you!
