Nexar Inc..description:
as a Senior AI Researcher and build world models that predict driving risks, advance road safety, and turn cutting-edge research into real-world impact.
Apply here!
DESCRIPTION
Join the team behind BADAS, a state-of-the-art world model for driving.
Nexar’s research team is looking for a Senior AI Researcher to help us build models that understand real world driving, not only what is happening now, but what is likely to happen next, and build the next generation of road safety and autonomy.
Using one of the world’s largest and most unique driving video datasets, we built BADAS, a state-of-the-art world model for identifying dangerous situations on the road before an accident happens.
Our dataset covers a vast range of roads, behaviors, conditions, and long tail events, allowing us to solve problems that are difficult to address using academic datasets or simulation alone.
Our work includes:
World Models and Video Foundation Models
Trajectory and motion prediction
BADAS, predicting risk and identifying dangerous situations before an accident
Driving and evaluation in simulation and closed loop settings
Embeddings and semantic search across large scale video datasets
Self supervised learning from large amounts of unlabeled data
We are looking for a researcher who can take an open ended problem, turn it into a clear research question, and build a solution that works in the real world.
The role requires research depth, but also the ability to make decisions, focus on what matters, and move quickly from an idea to an experiment, and from an experiment to a system people can use.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Lead research from early ideas to working models.
Develop new methods for video understanding, motion prediction, and risk prediction.
Work with large scale datasets, simulation environments, and advanced training infrastructure.
Turn real world needs into well defined research problems and measurable solutions.
Balance long term exploration with results that need to work today.
Run experiments at a fast pace, analyze failures, and change direction when needed.
Collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, and cross functional teams.
Publish and present research at leading academic conferences.
REQUIREMENTS
Technical skills & qualifications
Significant research experience in Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or a related field.
Experience in research, training and evaluation of large models.
Experience in one or more of the following: video understanding, representation learning, world models, trajectory prediction, or autonomous driving.
The ability to lead independent research together with strong hands on implementation skills.
A deeply agentic approach to work, using AI agents as an integral part of research, experimentation, analysis, and execution.
Strong proficiency in Python and PyTorch.
Experience training models and building reliable experimental pipelines.
People skills & traits
The judgment to choose the right solution even when the problem, timeline, and constraints are not perfect.
Curiosity, depth, pragmatism, and a strong desire to see research create impact beyond the lab.
Nice to have
A PhD in a relevant field.
Publications at conferences such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, or ICML.
Experience with simulation, closed loop evaluation, retrieval, or distributed training.
Experience turning research ideas into systems used in practice.
WHAT WE OFFER
The chance to have a meaningful and positive impact on roads and cities’ safety
Flexibility - in schedule, work location, benefits
Competitive compensation
A fast-paced work environment full of kind, smart, and highly driven people
Great professional and personal growth opportunities
Regular team-building events and well-being initiatives/facilities
WHO WE ARE
Nexar is building the real-world intelligence platform powering the physical AI era. As machines move into the real world—from autonomous vehicles to robotics—they all face the same challenge: they cannot scale or operate safely without access to high-quality, real-world data. Nexar solves this by operating one of the largest naturalistic driving intelligence platforms globally, powered by a live network of hundreds of thousands of cameras and a rapidly growing dataset of safety-critical events.
Our platform transforms this data into actionable intelligence used across multiple industries—from AV and ADAS to fleets, insurance, and public safety. By connecting real-world data supply with cross-industry demand, we enable organizations to better understand, benchmark, and improve how their systems perform in the real world. Every interaction strengthens the platform, making it smarter, more scalable, and increasingly valuable.
We’re building more than a product—we’re building the intelligence layer for the physical world. A platform that compounds with every mile driven, every dataset delivered, and every customer served.

About the role:
We are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to join our Sustaining Engineering team and play a key role in supporting the ongoing evolution of Novocure's innovative cancer treatment systems.
In this role, you will lead electrical engineering activities across design transfer and sustaining engineering, ensuring our products successfully transition from development into manufacturing while maintaining the highest standards of quality, reliability, manufacturability, and regulatory compliance.
Working closely with R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, and external suppliers, you will combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership to drive robust product solutions throughout the product lifecycle.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, mentoring others, and collaborating across multidisciplinary teams to bring life-changing medical technologies to patients worldwide.
What you will do:
Lead electrical engineering activities for Design Transfer and Sustaining Engineering projects .
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to electrical engineers within the DT & Sustaining Engineering team .
Serve as the company's subject matter expert for electrical design, supporting Design Transfer and Production activities .
Lead the transfer of electrical designs from R&D into manufacturing, ensuring manufacturability, quality, and reliability .
Partner with R&D teams to provide Design for Manufacturing (DFM) recommendations early in the development process .
Maintain and improve PCB and electrical board designs to support product robustness, manufacturability, and cost-effectiveness .
Define electrical project requirements, timelines, and budgets .
Generate and maintain complete production documentation, including PCB documentation, PCBA files, BOMs, assembly drawings, and work instructions .
Work closely with suppliers and manufacturing subcontractors throughout the product lifecycle .
Perform hands-on electrical design, testing, validation, and troubleshooting .
Develop and execute electrical test procedures and generate technical documentation and test reports .
Lead electrical design reviews and provide technical guidance to cross-functional teams .
What you will bring:
B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering (required)
M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering (advantage)
Minimum of 5 years of experience in electrical engineering within the medical device industry
Strong knowledge of medical device standards and electrical safety requirements
Minimum of 5 years of experience in digital circuit design, with basic knowledge of analog circuit design
Proven experience leading electrical projects from concept through manufacturing
Experience working with PCB design and layout tools, including Altium
Hands-on experience using laboratory test equipment, including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and function generators
Strong technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal
Proficiency with Altium and Microsoft Office
Who you are:
A hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges .
A collaborative team player who thrives in cross-functional environments .
A technical leader who enjoys mentoring and supporting other engineers .
Organized and capable of balancing multiple projects and priorities .
Passionate about delivering high-quality engineering solutions that make a meaningful impact on patients' lives .
ABOUT NOVOCURE
Novocure is a company with a powerful mission: to extend the lives of people living with some of the most aggressive forms of cancer.
Here, your work will have a direct impact on patients and those who care about them. Join a team of passionate, collaborative people who support each other, challenge one another, and innovate together.
Here, you’ll connect, grow, and make a real difference. We’re a company with the drive of a startup and the strength that comes with 25 years of success.
Novocure operates at a rare crossroads, where advanced medical technology converges with cutting-edge biotechnology.
We are the only company to develop and commercialize Tumor Treating Fields (TTFields), a proprietary, groundbreaking therapy designed to disrupt cancer cell division.
With us, you will find a unique combination of laboratory research work alongside engineering development of advanced technologies.
This fusion of disciplines positions us as true pioneers in oncology innovation, leading a new frontier in the treatment of aggressive cancers.
Our patient-forward values
– innovation
– focus
– drive
– courage
– trust
– empathy

About the role:
We are looking for a Researcher to join our Biology Research team within the Preclinical Department for a temporary 9-month position covering maternity leave.
In this role, you will contribute to basic scientific research focused on understanding cellular and molecular responses to electric fields, supporting Novocure's mission to advance innovative cancer therapies.

Opmed.ai.description:
About the Role
Opmed.ai is a rapidly growing healthcare AI startup helping leading health systems optimize their operations. Our platform is already in use at major health systems and large networks such as Mayo Clinic and Geisinger, and we are backed by world-class funds including NFX and Grove.
We're looking for a Data Science Tech Lead to take technical and delivery ownership of this team, a hands-on senior IC role. You'll set research direction, own client-facing delivery end-to-end, and drive how the team builds and scales its use of GenAI tooling and agentic capabilities. You'll work closely with other data scientists & analysts and partner daily with Solutions, Implementation, and Engineering. This role comes with real latitude to shape research direction and influence our product offering and roadmap — not just execute against a backlog.
What you will do
1. Research Direction
Set the technical research agenda for our tabular prediction models.
Guide how we incorporate temporal signal - case history, lag features, schedule snapshots- without defaulting to time-series techniques that don't fit our data.
Own our strategy for extracting value from unstructured data sources via LLMs - feature extraction, embeddings, or fine-tuning - balancing accuracy, cost, and constraints like latency and privacy.
Set standards for experimentation, evaluation, and model guardrails.
2. Client Project Delivery
Own DS delivery end-to-end across concurrent client engagements - from discovery through modeling, validation, and go-live.
Partner with Solutions and Implementation on discovery and rollout; represent Data Science in client meetings, presenting results directly to stakeholders.
Ensure delivery lands inside the product, on timeline, coordinating with Engineering on productionization.
Track delivery risk across the client portfolio, flagging blockers and scope changes early.
3. GenAI Tooling & Team Capability
Build the team's onboarding and delivery playbook for new use-cases and encode it as reusable Claude skills/agents
Turn repeatable steps in the DS workflow into standardized, shared tooling.
Raise the team's GenAI fluency through mentoring on Claude Code and related tooling.
What We're Looking For
M.Sc. in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field - or equivalent practical experience (PhD is an advantage).
Experience building or adapting LLM-native ML research workflows - including monitoring research quality and running critical peer reviews of results.
6+ years in applied data science / ML, including recent experience as a senior IC technical lead.
Deep, practical expertise with tabular ML: gradient-boosted trees (XGBoost/LightGBM or similar), feature engineering, and rigorous model evaluation for regression and classification problems.
Comfortable working with temporal/panel data (lag features, entity history, point-in-time snapshots).
Proven ownership of client-facing technical engagements end-to-end - discovery, stakeholder presentations, and delivery against deadlines - ideally in a B2B / enterprise or professional-services-adjacent setting.
Hands-on experience building and shipping GenAI applications: LLM-based feature extraction or structured extraction from unstructured text, prompt engineering vs. fine-tuning trade-offs, and at least conceptual fluency with agent orchestration.
Track record of building tooling or frameworks (internal libraries, standardized pipelines, or similar) that scaled a team's output, not just personal productivity.
Strong communicator who can move fluidly between technical peers, engineering, and non-technical clinical or business stakeholders.
Comfortable holding multiple concurrent workstreams and client engagements with competing timelines.
It will be great if you have
Healthcare, clinical, or EHR data experience - HL7/FHIR familiarity, PHI-aware ML practices, or exposure to clinical NLP (e.g., ClinicalBERT-style models).
Experience fine-tuning or distilling LLMs (SFT, LoRA/QLoRA) for domain-specific extraction or embedding tasks.

Description
At Orca AI, we build AI-powered vision systems that enhance safety and decision-making for some of the world’s largest vessels.
Our platform processes live video streams from multiple onboard cameras to provide real-time situational awareness, detecting and tracking marine objects, even in low visibility and highly congested environments. These systems directly support navigational decisions and help prevent collisions, reduce human error, and improve operational efficiency.
Our systems are already deployed across thousands of vessels and have processed hundreds of millions of nautical miles of real-world data, operating in unpredictable and safety-critical conditions.
This role sits at the intersection of AI and high-performance systems engineering, focused on solving real-world problems under strict constraints. You will work on systems where performance and reliability are critical and where improvements have a direct, measurable impact on real-world safety.
This is a senior, systems-focused role with end-to-end ownership over performance and reliability of production computer vision pipelines. You will define optimization strategies, identify bottlenecks across the system, and drive improvements under real-world constraints.
What you’ll do
Build and optimize real-time computer vision pipelines running on edge systems processing live maritime video streams (e.g, NVIDIA Jetson, Triton Inference Server)
Take models from research and turn them into production-ready, reliable components deployed on vessels
Profile and improve end-to-end system performance across: multi-camera video ingestion; preprocessing; inference; postprocessing
Identify and resolve bottlenecks across CPU, GPU, memory, and pipeline coordination
Make and justify tradeoffs between latency, accuracy, stability, and resource utilization
Design and implement robust data and inference pipelines (video -> model -> actionable output for crew)
Develop benchmarking and evaluation workflows to measure performance end-to-end and support release gating

PAPAYA.description:
What you’ll own
﻿The end-to-end Banco consumer experience: onboarding and identity verification (KYC), the multi-currency wallet, card issuing (virtual and physical), and withdrawals to bank and stablecoin — across web and mobile.
Activation and retention: turning invited workers into active, paid, engaged users; reducing drop-off across onboarding and first-payout funnels.
Reliability and quality: driving down errors, support tickets, and friction so that “I got paid” is boring and dependable.
Localization at scale: making the experience feel native across 160+ countries and dozens of payout rails, banking conventions, and languages.
The consumer data model: real objects (addresses, bank accounts, identity) that power smart UX — IBAN→bank lookup, zip→address autofill, one-time data entry instead of repeated forms.
Requirements
Consumer product experience. You have owned a B2C or consumer-grade app — ideally in fintech, neobanking, payments, wallets, or gig-economy payouts — where the user is an individual, not a business, and the bar is “make it effortless.” This is the core requirement for this role.
Mobile-first UX instinct. You think in funnels, activation, and retention, and you have measurably improved onboarding or engagement in a consumer app.
Payments or fintech depth. You understand money movement — wallets, cards, KYC/AML, payout rails — or you have shown you can master a complex, regulated domain fast.
Metrics fluency. You quote baseline → intervention → result numbers, know how each metric was measured, and know its weaknesses.
Correctness instinct for money. You grasp that in money movement a wrong payout costs far more than a blocked one, and you design for that asymmetry.
Individual ownership. You can tell at least one product story entirely in “I” terms — the decision you personally made, the alternative you rejected, and what happened.
Practical AI fluency (2026 bar). You use AI daily in your own product work and can describe last week’s usage concretely; bonus if you have shipped AI features and understand evals, failure modes, and human-in-the-loop.
Nice to have
Cross-border / multi-currency payments, card issuing, or KYC-provider integration experience.
Experience taking a consumer app from early/unstable to reliable at scale.
Experience in both a large PM org and a scrappy, 0→1 environment.
Hands-on building — you ship small things without waiting for engineers.
Apply for this position

Overview (English)
At SodaStream, part of PepsiCo, we are looking for a Global Planning Sr. Manager
The Global Planning Sr. Manager is a senior leadership role within SodaStream’s Global Supply Chain organization, responsible for leading the end-to-end planning agenda for SodaStream’s Israeli manufacturing operations across metal, assembly and plastics. The role ensures that production capacity, materials, inventory, master data and new product requirements are aligned with global demand, S&OP / IBP priorities and business objectives.
Reporting to the Global Supply Chain Sr. Director, the role is a member of the SodaStream Global Supply Chain Leadership Team and serves as a key interface between Israeli manufacturing, global S&OP, international markets, procurement, R&D, engineering, quality, logistics and cross-site supply chain teams. The position leads an organization of approximately 20 planning and supply chain professionals, including five direct reports.
#sodastream
Responsibilities (English)
Lead the end-to-end production planning process for SodaStream’s Israeli manufacturing sites across metal, assembly and plastics, translating global demand, S&OP / IBP priorities, inventory targets and operational constraints into executable production plans.
Set production priorities across plants and subcontractors, balancing service, capacity, inventory, cost and operational stability, while identifying material, capacity and supply constraints and leading mitigation and recovery plans.
Own planning recommendations for raw materials, buy items, long-lead components, technical warehouse materials and maintenance-related items, ensuring supplier lead times, MOQ constraints, demand variability and inventory objectives are reflected in supply plans.
Define and govern inventory targets, safety stocks and replenishment parameters, balancing customer service, supply continuity, working capital, obsolescence and operational risk.
Lead planning-related master data governance, MRP parameters, system inputs, reporting, dashboards and planning analytics to create a reliable single source of truth for planning, supply, inventory and operational decision-making.
Lead planning readiness for NPI and product changes, including bill-of-materials readiness, material availability, capacity readiness, inventory parameters and cross-functional alignment with R&D, Engineering, Operations, Procurement, Quality and global markets.
Serve as the key planning interface with global S&OP / IBP teams and international markets, providing visibility on capacity, material constraints, service risks, inventory and supply allocation priorities.
Manage the planning interface with SodaStream Netherlands and other cross-site partners, aligning supply plans, shipment needs, inventory levels, risks and recovery plans to ensure service reliability.
Lead, develop and strengthen a planning organization of approximately 20 employees, directly managing five team leaders / managers, setting clear objectives, accountability, operating routines and capability-building plans.
Drive planning standards, governance, process improvement, automation, digitalization and transformation across the planning organization, while contributing to global supply chain strategy and leadership forums.
Qualifications (English)
Bachelor's degree in industrial engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business or a related discipline; advanced degree is an advantage.
At least 10 years of experience in production planning, supply planning, material planning or end-to-end supply chain within a complex manufacturing environment.
At least 5 years of managerial experience, including proven experience leading planning teams through team leaders or managers.
Strong knowledge of S&OP / IBP, MRP, capacity planning, inventory management, production scheduling, master data and planning systems.
Experience working in multi-site manufacturing environments and international supply chains.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to translate data into clear operational and business decisions.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to align global and local teams across Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, R&D, Engineering, Quality, Logistics and commercial markets.
Experience with ERP / planning systems, BI / reporting tools, automation, digitalization and planning-system transformation.
Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.
Strong leadership capabilities, including end-to-end supply chain thinking, business acumen, strategic planning, execution discipline, people development, continuous improvement mindset, resilience and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional global environment with competing priorities.

Ambition Needs a Place to Grow.

Playtika is looking for a Data Scientist Expert – Production ML to join the Data & AI d epartment
In this position y ou will join a multidisciplinary team focused on personalization using Reinforcement Learning methods. Over the last few years, we have built a real-time recommendation engine based on Bayesian Multi-Armed Bandits - including our open-source PyBandits library - serving millions of players across multiple studios and use-cases.
This is an applied research role , with impact measured in production . Your primary contribution will be advancing the mathematical and statistical foundations of our existing solutions: identifying limitations, deriving principled improvements, and owning those improvements all the way through to production. You will not be handed research problems from above - you will find them yourself, inside systems that are already running at scale.
Scaling here is fundamentally a mathematical problem: identifying better statistical methods, proving they hold under real-world constraints, and knowing exactly how far they deviate from the ideal. That's what sets this role apart.
Responsibilities:
Identify mathematical and statistical limitations in existing ML solutions and deliver provably correct, more efficient alternatives
Validate the correctness of scaled solutions - diagnosing where distributed execution or approximation invalidates prototype-level results, and redesigning accordingly
Own the full lifecycle of your improvements: from research and prototyping through production deployment and impact measurement
Drive the evolution and scalability of our personalization and recommendation systems to meet future business and technical requirements
Contribute to end-to-end data-driven research including problem definition, data collection, model development, evaluation, and deployment
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineers, BI, Product) to deploy solutions quickly and effectively
Mentor Data Scientists and ML Engineers, and serve as a technical reference on statistical and mathematical rigor across the organization
Requirements:
M.Sc or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics , Engineering or a related field
5 + years of relevant work ing experience , including significant production ML ownership
Demonstrated experience taking statistically sophisticated models from prototype to production and operating them successfully under real-world business constraints.
Experience with neural network architectures, including the ability to diagnose, interpret and debug their behavior in probabilistic or decision-making contexts (e.g. Bayesian Neural Networks, Neural Linear models)
Strong theoretical foundation in at least one of: Multi-Armed Bandits, Bayesian methods, online learning, recommendation systems, or related decision-making frameworks
Strong understanding of experimentation, causal inference and statistical evaluation of online decision systems.
Strong hands-on Python engineering skills, with the ability to design, implement, review, and maintain production-quality code, leveraging modern AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Cursor) to improve productivity and code quality
Proficiency in SQL
Clear written and verbal communication - able to explain statistical reasoning to non-technical stakeholders
Ability to operate autonomously and influence decisions across teams without direct authority.
Nice to have
Experience with probabilistic programming frameworks (e.g. PyMC or Numpyro )
Familiarity with MLOps tooling (experiment tracking, model serving, monitoring)
Familiarity with approximate inference methods (variational inference, MCMC)
Experience with PySpark
Experience in the Mobile G aming industry

Description
About Port
Port is the Agentic SDLC Platform. The way engineering teams build software is constantly evolving, and every new wave - such as AI agents operating across the SDLC- makes engineering more powerful, but also more complex and chaotic.
Port turns that chaos into control: one platform to build, govern, and operate the software development lifecycle, enabling every team to move as fast as technology allows.
Following our $100M Series C funding round, we are entering an exciting stage of significant growth and global expansion. As a product-led company, we believe the recipe for success is a world-class product that speaks for itself.
About the role
We're building the intelligence layer that lets everyone at Port ask hard questions of our data and get trustworthy answers — in plain language, in seconds. As AI Data Engineer, you own the semantic and AI-native surface of our Snowflake platform: the governed semantic layer that defines "what a metric means," the Cortex Agents that let business users query it conversationally, and the infrastructure that keeps all of it fast, reliable, and ready to scale.
This is a builder-owner role. You'll ship the semantic models, wire up the agents, and set the standard for how analysts across the company work with data. You'll also lead the Data Analyst guild — the connective tissue that keeps our hub-and-spoke analytics model coherent as it grows.
If you're excited by the space where data engineering, LLM tooling, and analytics governance meet, this role sits right in the middle of it.
What you’ll Own:
Snowflake semantic layer — Own the semantic layer end-to-end as the single source of truth for metrics; design semantic models, enforce naming standards, and ensure consistent metric definitions across dashboards and AI agents.
Cortex Agents — Design and deploy conversational AI agents using Cortex Analyst and Cortex Search; tune for accuracy and safety, expose through multiple surfaces (Snowflake Intelligence, Streamlit, MCP), and build evaluation harnesses to maintain quality at scale.
Data craft (Analytics guild) — Co-lead the technical track of the Analytics guild; set SQL and modeling standards, run technical enablement and code reviews, and serve as the technical authority for analysts.
Scaling data infrastructure — Improve performance, reliability, cost efficiency, and governance across the dbt/Airflow/Airbyte/Snowflake stack as data volume and query load grow; optimize warehouse sizing, medallion layers, and ingestion pipelines.
What you'll do day to day
Model and maintain semantic views that power both dashboards and AI agents, keeping definitions versioned, tested, and certified.
Build, evaluate, and iterate on Cortex Agents — including retrieval quality, guardrails, and observability.
Extend and optimize dbt models, Airflow DAGs, and Airbyte connectors across bronze/silver/gold layers.
Partner with GTM, Finance, CS, and Product stakeholders to translate business questions into governed, reusable data assets.
Run the Data Analyst guild: standards, reviews, enablement, and tooling.
Own data quality, lineage, and cost monitoring across the Snowflake platform.
Expose data and agents through Streamlit apps, BI tools (Omni), and MCP servers for internal AI workflows.
Requirements
5+ years of experience in data engineering roles in B2B SaaS companies
Strong SQL and hands-on data engineering experience building production pipelines (dbt strongly preferred; orchestration with Airflow or similar).
Deep, practical Snowflake experience — warehouse management, performance tuning, cost control, and data modeling.
Experience building or maintaining a semantic / metrics layer, and a strong point of view on metric governance.
Hands-on work with LLM-powered data applications — RAG, text-to-SQL, agent orchestration, or similar. Snowflake Cortex (Analyst, Search, Agents) is a big plus.
A builder mindset paired with the judgment to set standards others follow.
Nice to have
Experience leading a guild, chapter, or community of practice — or otherwise driving standards without direct authority.
Familiarity with reverse-ETL, streaming ingestion (Airbyte or similar), and BI tooling on a semantic layer (Omni, ThoughtSpot).
Exposure to GTM / RevOps data (CRM, product usage, call intelligence) and the ambiguity that comes with it.
Experience with MCP, Streamlit, or embedding AI into internal tooling.

Description
About Port
At Port.io, we are building an open and flexible Agentic SDLC Platform for modern engineering organizations. Following our recent $100M Series C funding round, we are in a phase of rapid hypergrowth with strong enterprise momentum.
We act as the central nervous system for engineering, enabling platform teams to unify their stack and expose it as a governed layer through golden paths for developers and AI agents. By combining rich engineering context, workflows, and actions, we help organizations transition from manual processes to autonomous, AI-assisted engineering workflows — while maintaining control and accountability.
As a product-led company, we believe in building world-class platforms that fundamentally shape how modern engineering organizations operate.
About the Role
We are seeking a strategic technical leader to drive the next phase of our engineering evolution. Reporting directly to the VP of R&D, you will carry two core mandates:
Manage one or more engineering teams with a focus on AI development.
Lead AI SDLC transformation efforts across the entire R&D organization.
This is a rare, high-leverage role at the intersection of people leadership, technical craft, and organizational transformation. If you want to define how an entire engineering organization works in the age of AI — and leave a lasting fingerprint on a fast-scaling SaaS platform — this role is for you.
What You'll Do:
Domain Ownership & People Management
Assume operational leadership for critical R&D domains, including management of engineering teams focusing on AI.
Manage, coach, and grow Team Leads and senior engineers, building leadership depth across your domains.
Own team health, delivery velocity, and engineering quality for every team under your purview.
AI Developer Experience (AI DX)
Lead the transformation of our engineering processes by implementing AI-driven tools, frameworks, and workflows.
Significantly accelerate R&D throughput, optimize developer workflows, and foster an AI-first engineering culture — leading by example.
Drive adoption of agentic coding tools (e.g., Cursor, AI agents) across teams and measure their impact on productivity.
Technical Authority & Governance
Challenge existing architectural paradigms and introduce innovative, out-of-the-box solutions to complex technical problems.
Mentor engineering teams and raise the bar for AI engineering quality and best practices across R&D.
Strategic Cross-Team Leadership
Orchestrate complex, cross-functional initiatives that require deep technical alignment across disparate teams.
Manage project delivery, timelines, and execution to ensure seamless cross-functional results.
Architectural Vision
Define and execute the long-term technical AI roadmap, ensuring high standards of scalability, reliability, observability and engineering excellence across the platform.
Requirements
Engineering leadership experience: Extensive background as a Director of Engineering or equivalent senior technical leadership capacity (typically 8+ years of experience), overseeing multiple Team Leads and cultivating leadership talent in medium-to-large startup environments. Proven experience working in organizations with enterprise customers.
Delivery track record: Demonstrated success managing cross-functional engineering teams and delivering large-scale technical projects.

At Port, we've taken a platform-first, builder mindset from day one, developing the modular building §blocks we call pillars. Our users are exceptional engineers who continuously build creative and unexpected solutions with our platform. Being a PM here means embracing that creative tension while staying relentlessly focused on where the platform needs to go next.
As a PM at Port, you'll own a pillar end-to-end alongside your team of engineers and designers. You'll build and evolve it as a standalone value stream and as a connected part of the broader platform. PMs at Port are full picture owners: they shape the story of their pillar from market positioning to technical enablement, defining success not just by what gets shipped, but by the measurable impact it delivers.

Define what to build and why. Go deep with customers, analyze usage data, and research the competitive landscape. Bring that view to your team, build a sharp perspective on what's worth building next, and communicate the reasoning to engineering, leadership, and the market.

Drive cross-functional impact. At Port, PMs don't hand off and wait. You work across engineering, design, marketing, sales, and CS throughout the full product cycle, accountable for picking the right problem, the solution built, and whether the launch lands.
Build for agents and developers. Port is the context and action layer for both. Shape your domain so agents can act on it reliably and developers can navigate it intuitively. Prisma Photonics.description:
In this role, you will research and develop next-generation distributed fiber-optic sensing technologies, focusing on signal processing, system modeling, simulations, and experimental validation. Working at the intersection of physics, electro-optics, fiber-optic sensing, and DSP, you will transform complex physical phenomena into robust sensing solutions for real-world applications.
You will tackle challenging physical and algorithmic problems, contribute to cutting-edge sensing products, and collaborate closely with multidisciplinary R&D teams.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys working across disciplines, and is excited to take ideas from research and lab validation to large-scale deployment.
What You’ll Do:
Conduct experimental and theoretical R&D for Prisma’s next-generation distributed fiber-optic acoustic sensing systems.
Develop, implement, and validate DSP algorithms for coherent optical sensing systems.
Build end-to-end expertise across the full sensing pipeline, including optical signal generation and propagation, coherent detection, signal acquisition, DSP, and advanced data analysis.
Design and run laboratory experiments to validate new concepts, improve system performance, and support current and future product generations.
Develop simulations, models, and analysis tools using Python and/or C++ for lab experiments, field data analysis, signal processing, and system-level performance evaluation.
Work with field experiment data to identify performance gaps, validate models, and improve sensing capabilities.
Collaborate with R&D teams across disciplines to develop, validate, and integrate new sensing capabilities.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
What You Bring:
MSc or PhD in Physics, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Strong understanding of DSP methods, system-level modeling, and validation of algorithms using experimental or field data.
Strong background in one or more relevant domains, such as electro-optics, fiber sensing, optical communications, RF DSP, radar/sonar, ultrasound imaging, or related fields.
Experience applying DSP methods to physical sensing problems, including modeling, extracting, and interpreting signals from noisy experimental or field-deployed systems.
Experience with advanced signal processing methods, such as filtering, spectral analysis, FFT-based processing, estimation, detection, or time-series analysis.
Experience processing large-scale or streaming signal data and developing real-time or near-real-time DSP pipelines.
Strong programming skills in Python, C++ or similar.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects in a dynamic R&D environment.
Great to Have:
Experience applying AI/ML techniques to signal processing problems and/or using AI-assisted tools to accelerate DSP research, simulations, and experimental analysis.
Hands-on laboratory experience with advanced optical measurement techniques and optical/electro-optical systems.
Experience with electro-optical noise analysis, including phase noise, detector noise, amplifier noise, SNR, and related performance limitations.
Experience with GPU acceleration, CUDA, or parallel computing.

BDR SDR cloud SAAS CRM About Profisea Profisea is a multi-cloud DevOps as a Service company and Premier Partner with AWS, GCP, Azure, and Oracle. We help fast growing startups and scaleups run reliable, cost efficient cloud infrastructure without building an internal DevOps team from scratch. Our clients include companies across fintech, AI, and SaaS who are scaling fast and need real cloud expertise, not just credits. About the role We’re looking for a Sales Development Representative to build and manage outbound pipeline for our US market. You’ll be based in our Israel office, but your day will run on US hours and your entire focus will be American CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and founders evaluating how to scale their cloud infrastructure. This is a foundational role for our US expansion. What you’ll do Research and identify target accounts that fit our ideal customer profile, fast growing US companies with meaningful cloud spend who need DevOps capability without hiring internally. Run outbound campaigns across email, LinkedIn, and phone to generate qualified meetings with US prospects. Qualify inbound leads from marketing campaigns and events. Work closely with account executives to hand off qualified opportunities smoothly. Keep CRM data accurate and up to date in HubSpot. What we’re looking for Native or native level English, American accent and business communication style are important since you’ll be speaking with US prospects daily. Deep familiarity with US business culture. American citizens, former US residents, or Olim from the US are a strong fit. Willing and able to work US hours, meaning afternoon and evening shifts Israel time. 1 to 3 years of SDR or BDR experience, ideally in SaaS, cloud, or technical B2B sales. Comfortable talking to technical audiences like CTOs and VPs of Engineering, even without a deep technical background yourself. Self starter, comfortable being the only one on the team working that shift. Experience with HubSpot or similar CRM tools is a plus. Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure is a plus but not required. What we offer Ground floor opportunity to build Profisea’s US market presence. Direct mentorship from experienced sales leadership. Competitive commission structure. Publicis Groupe Israel.title: Project Manager- For Mint

Pynt.description:
Responsibilities:
You will build, manage and grow relationships with inbound and outbound leads
Follow up with leads in a timely and professional manner
Conduct research to qualify prospect leads according to Pynt’s criteria
Identify, initiate and nurture business relationships with prospects
Manage your pipeline to meet monthly, quarterly and annual meeting goals
Engage and provide initial introduction to Pynt’s platform to diverse, enterprise-class audiences in application security and engineering leadership positions
Cross-functional collaboration across multiple departments to improve sales efforts
Requirements:
Minimum of two years of experience as a SDR/BDR in the AppSec/Cyber industry
BA/BS degree preferred but will consider equivalent years of work experience
Excellent written and oral communication skills
Native level English
A positive, customer-centric attitude
Strong work ethic, goal-oriented, and able to meet sales quota expectations
Ability to work independently and as part of the Sales team
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
Self-starter, results-oriented, and independent professional
Process-driven individual, who can organize and prioritize leads effectively
Technical expertise and ability to work with CRM, sales and outreach tools
Willing to work flexible hours and time zones
Want to learn more about Pynt’s secret sauce?
Get a Demo
Pynt.title: Sales Development Representative

Pynt.description:
The Role
Take a lead role in shaping the user interface and user experience of our applications
Develop and decide of our practices, and technology stack
Work closely with the product, UX and decision-makers to define the company roadmap and execute the development plans
Drive technical excellence, high product quality, innovation, and timely delivery in an agile, production critical environment
‍
Requirements
At least 4 years of experience with React
At least 4 years of experience with a backend language
Experience with SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and/or other database technologies
Experience operating within a cloud-native environment, along with familiarity with software architectures and methodologies
Good skills of seeing a big picture and system architecture planning
Team player, egoless, strong communication skills, and empathy
Preferred Qualifications
At least 3 years of experience with Go or Python
Experience with AWS
‍

Pynt.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer

Pynt.description:

Qedma is looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong Python expertise and a passion for solving complex algorithmic problems. We are seeking a highly driven, hands-on Production Engineering Leader to join our Operations & Manufacturing team. Contract Manufacturer (CM) Management & Line Ownership

Continuous Improvement

Quantum Source is a novel key player at the forefront of the worldwide effort towards large-scale quantum computation. Based on proprietary technology, Quantum Source is developing a unique fault-tolerant compound photon–atom quantum computer.
We are a young, dynamic, and extraordinarily multidisciplinary company that combines the fields of quantum physics, optics, mechanical engineering, hardware, firmware, and software.
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Researcher to join the Applications Team within the Theory Group.
The Quantum Applications Team is responsible for exploring practical applications and quantum algorithms that leverage Quantum Source's fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) architecture — identifying high-impact use cases, developing and benchmarking quantum algorithms, and collaborating with industry and academic partners to demonstrate the advantage of our hardware.

We are hiring a senior individual contributor to join our Data Science team. This is a hands-on role for someone who can take ownership of the full solution,  from understanding the problem and building the required data pipelines to developing the model, deploying it, and keeping it reliable in production. You should be comfortable working across data, code, infrastructure, and monitoring independently.
The domain is genuinely hard: noisy sensor and telemetry data, weak and delayed labels, enormous scale, and physical systems that fail in complicated ways.  We use whatever technique the problem calls for, from classical machine learning and survival analysis to our own patent-pending deep learning architectures and agentic flows already running in production.
The team moves quickly and operates with a startup mentality: high ownership, short decision paths, and a strong bias toward action. When we encounter a difficult problem, we do not stop at “we can’t.” We ask, “How can we?”
Moving fast does not mean cutting corners. It means combining resourcefulness and practical judgment with scientific rigor, engineering quality, and production reliability.
We also have proprietary methods for validating results against ground truth, so the feedback loop is real: when a solution works, it ships. You will see your work in production and understand its impact on real fleets. What you’ll do
Own projects end to end: stakeholder discussions, problem framing, data exploration, modeling, validation, deployment, and post-launch monitoring.
Turn ambiguous or partially defined business needs into clear, practical, and measurable solutions.
Build predictive and prescriptive models over large-scale vehicle telemetry, diagnostics, and fault data.
Design, build, and maintain scalable, reproducible, and well-tested data pipelines over billions of daily data points.
Build and operate the workflows required for training, validation, inference, and ongoing evaluation.
Take responsibility for getting solutions into production, including automated testing and deployment, environment configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Choose the right tool for each problem, from gradient boosting and survival analysis to deep architectures over raw signals—and clearly explain your decisions.
Design evaluations that reflect reality, use our proprietary validation methods, and challenge metrics that tell a comfortable but misleading story.
Develop and integrate agentic and LLM-based flows that explain findings, recommend actions, and build the relevant evals.
Investigate failures across data, models, workflows, and production systems.
Present findings, trade-offs, and results clearly to business stakeholders and executive leadership.
Raise the technical bar through reviews, mentorship, and shared standards, as a senior IC, not a people manager.
Qualifications
MSc in Computer Science or an engineering-related quantitative field, such as Electrical Engineering,  Statistics, Physics, or Applied Mathematics. A PhD is an advantage.
At least eight years of industry experience in a related data science or machine learning role.
Proven experience taking machine learning solutions to production, not only building prototypes and notebooks, but deploying, monitoring, maintaining, retraining, and troubleshooting what you shipped.
Strong experience building reliable, performant, and well-tested data pipelines over very large datasets.
Strong experience with Spark, distributed computing, SQL, and modern big data platforms. Databricks experience is a significant advantage.
Practical experience with automated testing and deployment, cloud-based systems, workflow orchestration, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
Experience delivering LLM or agentic applications to production, including evaluation, guardrails, and cost and latency trade-offs.
Strong foundations across statistics, experimental design, classical machine learning, and modern deep learning.
Excellent Python skills and fluency with PyTorch.
Demonstrated ability to work comfortably across data science, data engineering, model deployment, and production systems.
Demonstrated ability to lead projects independently, make sound decisions under ambiguity, and determine what should—and should not—be built.
A proactive and resourceful mindset. You naturally look for viable solutions rather than stopping at constraints.
Very good English communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to business stakeholders and C-level audiences.
Advantages
Experience in automotive, telematics, IoT, predictive maintenance, or industrial and physical systems.

Experience designing and operating end-to-end machine learning systems.

Broad ownership across data, modeling, deployment, and production systems.
Hard problems worth solving, with the freedom to challenge assumptions and find better approaches.
Work that reaches production and measurably reduces cost and downtime for fleets across four continents.

Description
We're looking for a sharp, strategic Product Marketing Manager to own the voice of Reco in the market. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role at the intersection of product, sales, and go-to-market at a moment when the security landscape is being reshaped by AI.
You'll translate complex capabilities from SaaS posture management to agentic AI security and non-human identity governance into narratives that resonate with security leaders. You'll build competitive programs that arm the field, shape how analysts and buyers understand emerging AI risk categories, and partner with Product and Engineering to ensure the market perspective drives what we build.
You'll be the connective tissue between what Reco does and why it matters to buyers, to practitioners, to analysts, and to our own teams.
Responsibilities
Build and operationalize a competitive intelligence program that keeps the company consistently informed about the market, including the fast-evolving AI security and agentic security landscape.
Own win/loss analysis; synthesize findings into actionable insights for product, sales, and leadership.
Track how competitors are positioning around AI agents, non-human identities, and security for AI tools and define how Reco stands apart.
Be the go-to expert on how Reco compares to the market and how we should talk about it.
Market & Customer Intelligence
Continuously track emerging use cases, shifting buyer needs, and market trends, including how AI adoption is creating new security requirements and translate those signals into strategic action.
Run customer interviews and synthesize insights from across the field to keep Reco grounded in real-world problems, particularly around AI agent risk, shadow AI, and non-human identity sprawl.
Monitor analyst coverage and category formation around agentic AI security and AI-SPM and help Reco shape the narrative.
Feed intelligence into product, marketing campaigns, and executive strategy.
Storytelling & GTM Narrative
Translate complex technical capabilities including AI-driven detection, agentic security, and security for AI tools into clear, outcome-driven narratives that articulate customer value and business impact.
Develop and own Reco's core GTM messaging from platform positioning to use-case-level stories across personas, including the emerging CISO conversation around AI risk governance.
Create content that works across the funnel: website, decks, one-pagers, blog posts, and customer-facing collateral.
Product & Engineering Partnership
Serve as a strategic partner to Product and Engineering, bringing market, customer, field, and competitive perspectives, especially around AI security, into roadmap decisions.
Lead go-to-market planning for new feature and product launches, including capabilities in agentic security and AI posture management, ensuring messaging and enablement are ready at launch.
Help define how new capabilities are packaged, named, and positioned before they ship.
Sales & Field Enablement
Create the tools sellers need to have better conversations: messaging frameworks, competitive battle cards, discovery guidance, and objection handling, including how to position Reco in AI security conversations.
Partner closely with Sales leadership to understand where deals are won and lost, and close the gaps.
Deliver regular enablement sessions to keep the field sharp and confident on evolving topics like AI agents, non-human identities, and security for AI.
Requirements
5+ years of product marketing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally in cybersecurity, identity, or adjacent security verticals.
Genuine curiosity about AI, you follow how AI agents, copilots, and LLM-based tools are reshaping enterprise workflows and the security challenges they introduce.
Proven ability to distill complex technical concepts including emerging topics like agentic AI risk, non-human identities, and AI-SPM into crisp, compelling narratives.
Hands-on experience building competitive programs, running win/loss analysis, and turning insights into sales tools.
Strong cross-functional instincts you know how to influence without authority and build trust with Product, Sales, and Marketing peers.
A bias toward execution: you can move from strategy to artifact quickly, without sacrificing quality.
Fluent English (written and spoken) required.

Roche.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
Roche היא חברת הביוטכנולוגיה המובילה בעולם המחויבת לקידום רפואה מותאמת אישית בתחומי האונקולוגיה, המטולוגיה, אופתלמולוגיה, נוירולוגיה ועוד. בישראל, הפעילות של רוש ממוקדת בשיווק, הנגשת תרופות ומחקר קליני. רוש, כחברה פורצת דרך בתחומי רפואה רבים, מובילה פריצת דרך נוספת במודל עבודה חדשני, הטומן בחובו הזדמנויות רבות לצמיחה והתפתחות. אנחנו ברוש מאמינים שעל מנת להגשים את כוכב הצפון שלנו, יש לפעול בראיה רחבה יותר מול כלל הגורמים בשוק המהווים את האקוסיסטם שלנו. מתוך כך נולד תפקיד ה- Patient Journey Partner , שהוא תפקיד מפתח, רחב וחדשני הממוקד בצרכי המטופלים והלקוחות. בתפקיד זה, נדרשת יכולת לבניית קשרים חזקים וליצירת שותפות אמיתית עם לקוחות לאורך הדרך.
תפקיד ה- Patient Journey Partner משלב בתוכו תחומי אחריות ממספר תפקידים המוכרים היום בתעשיית הפארמה, החל מעבודה אסטרטגית, מדעית, שיווקית ועבודת שטח ממוקדת לקוח. ה- Patient Journey Partner מהווה את הפנים של רוש בכלל האינטראקציות מול הלקוחות שלנו ואחראי על יצירת שיתופי פעולה והובלת תהליכים משמעותיים וחדשניים באקוסיסטם הישראלי.
תחומי האחריות המרכזיים:
ניהול יומיומי של כלל האינטראקציות בשטח עם בעלי עניין במסע המטופל בתוך האקו-סיסטם
זיהוי צרכים, אתגרים והזדמנויות תוך כדי עבודה צמודה עם הלקוחות בשטח ומתן מענה ופתרונות מותאמים בתחומים עדכניים כגון רפואה מותאמת אישית ובריאות דיגיטלית.
הובלת חדשנות ותהליכים משמעותיים ויצירת קשרים חזקים מול הלקוחות, שיאפשרו תוצאות טובות יותר עבור המטופלים.
עבודה בקבוצות חוצות ארגון, מקומיות וגלובליות
מי את/ה:
התפקיד מתאים לאנשים בעלי רצון להתנסות במודל עבודה אחר - מודל מולטידיסיפלינרי, המאפשר מרחב פעולה רחב, אחריות גדולה ומנדט להוביל מהלכים משמעותיים בארגון ומחוצה לו.
אנשים בעלי תשוקה לעבודה עם צוותים רפואיים, המביאים איתם רקע מגוון לתפקיד שהוא "גם וגם" ומשלב בתוכו מגוון יכולות שיאפשרו לדיאלוג עם הרופאים לעשות הבדל בחיי המטופלים.
ניסיון מוכח בניהול קשרי לקוחות מורכבים וביצירת שותפויות משמעותיות עם מובילי דעה באקוסיסטם הרפואי
ניסיון קודם בתפקיד PS/נציג/ה רפואי בפארמה (מינימום 3 שנות ניסיון) – עדיפות לניסיון בתחום הנוירולוגיה, בדגש על טרשת נפוצה
ניסיון בעבודה שיווקית מדעית מול צוותים רפואיים
נכונות לעבודת שטח אינטנסיבית (אזור מרכז-ירושלים-דרום), מתוך הבנה ששם נמצאים הפתרונות האמיתיים עבור המטופלים
תואר אקדמי במדעי החיים
ניסיון בפיתוח והובלת פרויקטים בשיתוף עם הלקוחות
אנחנו רצים יחד למרחקים ארוכים וגאים לעבוד בסביבה בה שליחות ומשמעות נפגשים.
הצטרפו אלינו למסע חדשני שבו כוכב הצפון הוא טובת המטופל.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
Roche.title: Patient Journey Partner

Roche.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
מי אנחנו
רוש היא חברת הביוטכנולוגיה המובילה בעולם, המחויבת לקידום טיפולים חדשניים ו רפואה מותאמת אישית בתחומי האונקולוגיה, המטולוגיה, נוירולוגיה, אופתלמולוגיה ותחומים תרפויטיים נוספים.
ברוש ישראל אנחנו מתמקדים ברישום, שיווק, הנגשת תרופות ומחקר קליני. אנחנו רצים יחד למרחקים ארוכים וגאים לעבוד בסביבה בה קריירה ומשמעות נפגשים. אנחנו מחפשים חברי צוות חדשים שיצטרפו אלינו למסע, בו טובת המטופל היא כוכב הצפון שלנו.
מסגרת התפקיד
מיפוי וזיהוי אתגרים והזדמנויות שעשויים להיטיב עם המטופל במסלול ניהול מחלתו, בתחומים האסטרטגים של רוש
עבודה מול גורמים במערכת הבריאות - קופות החולים, בתי חולים, משרד הבריאות, אקדמיה, מרכזי חדשנות ועוד - בניית קשרים מקצועיים, זיהוי ממשקים לשיתופי פעולה והובלתם
ניהול פרויקטים ושיתופי פעולה להנגשת פתרונות הוליסטיים וחדשניים לקידום הבריאות ושיפור מסע המטופל
חיבור בין מידע רפואי, מיזמים ואנשים באקוסיסטם הבריאות המקומי והגלובלי
מינוף ושיתוף מידע, עבודת צוות מטריציונית בתוך ומחוץ לחברה
דרישות התפקיד
תואר במדעי החיים או מקצועות הבריאות (רפואה, רוקחות, סיעוד וכד')
יתרון לתואר נוסף במינהל מערכות בריאות / מינהל עסקים / תעשייה וניהול
יתרון לניסיון עבודה במערכת הבריאות הציבורית
יכולת לימוד וידע במגוון תחומים תרפויטים, יצירת קשרים מקצועיים לטווח ארוך
ראש יזמי, יצירתיות וזיקה לעולם הבריאות הדיגיטלית והחדשנות
יכולת ניהול עצמי גבוהה, עבודה בצוות מטריציוני והנעת תהליכים
עברית ואנגלית ברמה גבוהה
העבודה באיזור מרכז ודרומה
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche.title: Healthcare Systems Partner

Roche.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
The application specialist is responsible for responding to customers’ needs and expectations with high quality scientific answers, to contribute to customer long term loyalty, ensuring immediate and proper scientific support to customers (incl. providing instrument training and troubleshooting, settlement of scientific problems and timely update on new methods, techniques and Product Bulletins), and documenting all calls, activities on the CRM System.
This is a field-based role.
Key Responsibilities:
Provide high-level scientific support and operator training to customers.
Handle all calls received from customers that relate to CPS and troubleshoot them to provide instant solutions to reagent and software problems due to customer complaints.
Escalate unsolved cases to 2nd level support CIR, and/or GCS with complete case explanation.
Ensure follow-up until the issue has been resolved and the customer is satisfied.
Provide scientific documentation to customers.
Document all his activities in Rexis/Lightning/ NFSS.
Deliver best in class support utilizing appropriate systems and processes and providing a consistent and high level of support to customers.
Continuing development of application skills to ensure resilience in the support of all CPS products.
Proactively propose and implement activities aligned with customer satisfaction surveys and on-going customer and business area feedback.
Ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner and guarantee the activity reporting at the CRM (Rexis) software and appropriate escalation of product issues to management center and ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner.
Who you are:
PhD in Medical Laboratory Sciences, Chemistry, Histopathology, Biology or Biochemistry or related field - Mandatory
Good knowledge and experience in pathology/molecular solutions.
Minimum 3 year of experience in Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS).
Fluent in English (oral and written).
Technical vocabulary & terminology.
Advanced computer skills (Windows and Microsoft Office).
Experience in laboratory practice and/or experience in the use of automated laboratory equipment (Roche instruments preferably).
Experience in laboratory manual practice and chemicals handling.
Verbal and written communication skills.
Planning, administration and decision making.
Work well in a team environment.
Service/Customer oriented.
Creativity & well critical thinking with a proactive mindset.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Role
We’re looking for a Full Stack Developer who cares about building high-quality products and turning complex systems into reliable, intuitive solutions.
You’ll work on the core of SOURCIX’s SaaS platform and marketplace, collaborating closely with product, and AI teams. This role is ideal for someone who takes ownership end-to-end: from understanding product requirements, to designing and implementing scalable solutions, and delivering features to production.
You’ll also be expected to operate at the forefront of modern development – leveraging AI tools and rapid, iterative “vibe coding” to move fast and build smarter in a startup environment.
Responsibilities
Development & Architecture
Build, maintain, and scale modern web applications across frontend and backend
Design and implement end-to-end features, from UI to backend services
Translate product requirements into high-quality, reliable solutions
Own features end-to-end: design, implementation, testing, and deployment
Ensure performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability of the system
Product & User Experience
Work closely with product and design to build efficient, user-focused workflows
Bridge the gap between frontend experience and backend logic
Simplify complex systems into clear and usable solutions
Continuously improve based on feedback and data
Modern Development
Use AI tools (LLMs, copilots, automation tools) to improve productivity and code quality
Iterate quickly, prototype when needed, and ship production-ready features
Stay at the forefront of AI-driven development and modern engineering practices
Collaboration
Collaborate with engineers across frontend, backend, and AI
Work with APIs, databases, and data flows across the full stack
Participate in code reviews and technical discussions
Requirements
3+ years of software development experience
Strong experience across both frontend and backend development
Experience with modern web technologies (e.g., React, Next.js, Node.js, or similar)
Good understanding of APIs, databases, and system design
Experience building and integrating production systems end-to-end
Strong attention to detail and code quality
Ability to work independently and take ownership
Nice to Have
Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar)
Experience with scalable system design and architecture
Experience building SaaS platforms or complex systems
Familiarity with performance optimization across frontend and backend
What We’re Looking For
A builder mindset — someone who moves fast and takes ownership
Strong problem-solving skills
Ability to work in ambiguity and shape solutions
Curiosity and drive to stay at the edge of AI and modern development
Why Join SOURCIX
Join a fast-growing AI startup transforming mechanical procurement and sourcing. We’re building a platform that brings speed, transparency, and intelligence to custom manufacturing – powered by AI and advanced matching algorithms.
Competitive compensation + early-stage equity
Real ownership and impact on product and technology
Opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, manufacturing, and SaaS

The Role
We are looking for a Head of Marketing to lead and execute our marketing strategy across all
channels, with a strong emphasis on B2B growth, ABM (Account-Based Marketing), SaaS
marketing, and AI-driven marketing operations.
This is a hands-on leadership role requiring close collaboration with sales, product, and
leadership teams to shape and communicate our brand story, drive demand generation, and
build the foundation for scalable growth.
Beyond traditional marketing expertise, we are specifically looking for someone who deeply
understands how to leverage AI in modern marketing — both strategically and operationally.
The ideal candidate actively uses AI tools in their personal workflow, understands how AI can
optimize marketing execution and content creation, and can guide teams and external
partners in adopting AI-first marketing methodologies.
The ideal candidate is an experienced B2B marketing leader with a strong track record in
early-stage startups, capable of operating as a highly independent marketing owner while
leveraging agencies, freelancers, and AI tools to scale efficiently.

Own and drive SOURCIX’s short- and long-term marketing strategy — from high-level
positioning to campaign-level execution.
Lead and optimize AI-powered marketing workflows across content creation,
campaign execution, lead generation, research, automation, and analytics.
Drive adoption of AI tools and AI-first methodologies within marketing operations and
collaborate with internal teams to improve efficiency using AI technologies.
Craft compelling messaging and storytelling that clearly communicates SOURCIX’s
value proposition to technical and business audiences.
Define and execute Go-to-Market (GTM) strategies for SOURCIX’s SaaS and
Marketplace offerings in alignment with product and sales initiatives.
Plan and execute targeted Account-Based Marketing (ABM) campaigns to generate,
nurture, and convert high-value leads.
Lead demand generation efforts through paid media, outbound campaigns, content
marketing, SEO, email marketing, partnerships, and digital acquisition channels.
Work closely with sales, product, and leadership teams to ensure cohesive messaging,
aligned priorities, and impactful outreach strategies.
Operate effectively as a hands-on marketing leader while identifying opportunities to
scale through agencies, freelancers, automation tools, and future team hires.
Monitor industry trends, customer feedback, AI marketing trends, and competitor
positioning to continuously refine messaging and growth strategy.
Build and manage marketing performance tracking, reporting, and KPI measurement
to support scalable company growth.
Support outbound sales initiatives with personalized marketing content, campaigns,
and sales enablement materials.

5–10+ years of experience in B2B marketing with proven success in SaaS and ABM
environments.
Demonstrated experience working in early-stage startups, ideally as the first

Personal hands-on use of AI tools for content creation, research, campaign execution,

processes.
Strong background in positioning technical products to engineering, procurement,

Hands-on experience building and executing GTM campaigns, including marketing
automation and sales enablement workflows.
Exceptional storytelling, branding, content creation, and communication skills.

effectively in fast-paced environments.

Background or familiarity with mechanical engineering, manufacturing, procurement,

Experience supporting outbound sales teams through personalized content and
outreach strategies.

SaaS space.
Experience building AI-native or AI-enhanced marketing operations.

We’re looking for a VIP Monetization Manager to join our team in a specialized role focused on Loyalty Feature, aiming to enhance the experience of our games’ most valuable players.
By developing a retention-focused strategy tailored to this key player segment, you’ll drive efforts to strengthen the connection between our games and their high-tier player base, creating an impactful and lasting bond.
In this role, you’ll manage the life cycle of top-tier players, elevating their in-game experience through innovative mechanics and features—driven by data, testing, and evaluation. You’ll work closely with Monetization, Product, and Analytics teams, making data-informed decisions on priorities for both the game team and VIP Account Managers to support the long-term growth of our high-value player tiers. This position offers high-impact potential and a unique blend of creative and analytical skills for the right candidate.

Key responsibilities:
  • Leverage strong numerical and data analysis skills to drive business-oriented decisions, supported by insightful reporting and trend analysis
  • Analyze information effectively, drawing actionable conclusions to optimize player engagement and retention strategies
  • Collaborate with multiple interfaces across the organization, partnering with cross-functional teams to influence outcomes and align goals
  • Demonstrate a proactive, solution-oriented approach—able to tackle challenges and drive initiatives forward
  • Exhibit teamwork and a passion for growth, contributing actively to team objectives and culture
  • Communicate clearly and confidently in English, both written and verbal, ensuring ideas and insights are well understood
  • Maintain a focus on consumer behavior, particularly in digital entertainment and gaming, as an advantage

Requirements:
  • Strong skills in numbers, business orientation, reports, and data analysis - a must
  • 2+ Years’ experience as a Product Manager/ Monetization Management in B2C; Gaming, Social/Mobile, Casino preferred
  • Self-motivated and PROACTIVE go-getter who is results-driven and has shown a track record of achievement through creativity – a must!
  • Exemplary communication skills in both written and spoken English – a must

  • Identify and resolve developer pain points through data, feedback, and hands-on investigation.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and drive improvements.
  • Own operational aspects of systems, including monitoring, SLIs/SLOs, and on-call participation.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and long-term platform strategy.

  • 5–10+ years of software engineering experience (platform, infrastructure, or DevOps focus).
  • Strong product mindset with a passion for improving developer experience.
  • Experience building and operating distributed systems.
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language (C#, Go, Python, or Typescript).
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.


Nice to Have:
  • Experience working with game development teams.
  • Background in internal developer platforms or large-scale tooling.
  • Knowledge of security, compliance, or platform governance.

The ideal candidate will be highly detail-oriented and proactive in supporting the team.

 

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and record monthly journal entries for general ledger posting and perform related account reconciliations 
  • Assist with the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes, working closely with the Finance leadership team
  • Maintain the general ledger accounts for the respective legal entities, reporting discrepancies, imbalances, and other issues to the corporate finance team

  • Assist in the preparation and review of tax filings and statutory reporting requirements.
  • Prepare and monitor weekly cash flow reports
  • Collaborate with the U.S. Finance team to perform account reconciliations, resolve discrepancies, and support reporting requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve finance processes through automation and AI-driven tools.
  • Manage ad-hoc special projects as required

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, with CPA certification
  • 2+ years of progressive experience in general accounting and finance.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. and Israeli GAAP
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, lookups, conditional formulas, etc.)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Hebrew
  • Self-motivated and able to work effectively in a fast-paced, unsupervised environment
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously within deadlines in a technology-driven setting
  • Ability to optimize processes and improve workflows
  • Service-oriented with the ability to communicate effectively with all levels of personnel
  • Proven problem-solving skills and strong analytical thinking
  • A team player with a proactive approach
