* This role requires relocation to the United States following an initial transition period in Israel.

The VP Monetization serves as the studio’s senior monetization advisor and subject matter expert, partnering closely with game leadership teams to maximize business performance and player value. This role provides strategic guidance, data-driven insights, industry expertise, and monetization best practices to help solve complex business challenges and identify growth opportunities across the portfolio

Key Responsibilities:
  •  Serve as the studio’s subject matter expert on monetization, providing strategic guidance and thought leadership across multiple games and products.
  • Partner with game leadership teams to identify monetization opportunities, diagnose complex business challenges, and recommend data-driven solutions.
  • Support product, economy, and LiveOps teams in evaluating monetization strategies, pricing approaches, player segmentation, and offer design.
  • Leverage analytics, experimentation results, player behavior insights, and market trends to provide actionable recommendations that improve business performance.
  • Identify cross-portfolio monetization best practices and drive knowledge sharing across game teams.
  • Conduct competitive analysis and monitor industry trends to uncover new opportunities for growth and innovation.
  • Influence decision-making through expertise, insights, and strong stakeholder partnerships while empowering game teams to own and execute their strategies.
  • Develop frameworks, methodologies, and tools that help teams make more effective monetization decisions.
  • Mentor and support product, economy, and monetization professionals across the organization.


Requirements:
  • Significant experience in Monetization, Product, Economy, Growth, or related leadership roles within gaming or a data-driven consumer business.
  • Deep understanding of free-to-play monetization, game economies, LiveOps, and experimentation.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with a proven track record of driving business growth.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
SciPlay.title: VP Monetization

SciPlay.description:
The VP Product role is a strategic product leadership position focused on supporting and aligning roadmap direction across multiple teams and product domains within the studio organization. The role partners closely with product leaders, game teams, and business stakeholders to ensure product initiatives align with company goals, player needs, and long-term business strategy.

This position focuses on shaping product strategy, driving roadmap alignment across multiple teams, and partnering with studio leadership to support long-term business growth and player experience. The role works cross-functionally with product, LiveOps, monetization, and development teams to help guide strategic priorities, evaluate opportunities, and ensure product initiatives align with overall business objectives.

Key responsibilities :

  • Driving strategic alignment across product roadmaps and initiatives
  • Supporting prioritization and investment decisions based on business impact and player value
  • Partnering with studio and product leadership to shape long-term product direction
  • Using data and performance insights to guide roadmap recommendations and feature strategy
  • Facilitating cross-team collaboration and organizational alignment
  • Influencing decision-making across multiple stakeholders in a matrix environment
  • The role requires strong business acumen, strategic thinking, communication skills, and the ability to influence without direct authority in a fast-paced, data-driven gaming environment

Requirements :

  • Significant experience in Product or related leadership roles within gaming or a highly data-driven consumer business.
  • Deep understanding of product, player behavior, and experimentation frameworks.
  • Strong business acumen and strategic thinking, with the ability to evaluate opportunities and guide product-related decisions across multiple products.
  • Experience partnering with senior product, game, and studio leaders to influence strategy and business outcomes.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage data and performance insights to identify growth opportunities and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Proven ability to drive alignment, influence stakeholders, and operate effectively in a matrix organization without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
SciPlay.title: VP Product

SciPlay.description:
We are looking for a talented and a Monetization Manager to join our team.
The Monetization team is responsible for driving revenue growth and providing the best game experience to our users. To achieve company business goals, the team constantly optimizes the game experience and performance based on data.
As part of your role, you'll manage a full-cycle campaign calendar, including planning short & long-term activities, defining goals, executing, and analyzing performance. Possess a deep understanding of existing game mechanics and how to best utilize them within Monetization tools.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Develop quarterly, monthly, and weekly promotional plans according to the monetization strategy
  • In charge of the implementation of promotions through the campaign design and creative creation in all communication channels
  • Responsible for the operational launch of campaigns, QA, monitoring results, reacting accordingly, analyzing the campaigns, and bringing insights for optimization
  • Leverage product features and marketing tools for driving revenue growth and providing a good game experience to our players
  • Constantly coming up with exciting new innovative ideas.
  • Constantly improving and optimizing in a data-driven manner the game experience and performance in order to hit the company KPIs.
  • Collaborate with the creative team, operations team, game economy team, BA, and product managers in order to execute in-game events & promotions.
Requirements:
  • 2+ years of experience working as a monetization live-ops/ CRM manager in a gaming company OR 2+ years of experience in a similar role (Product Marketing, Branding, Growth Manager, etc.) in a B2C company.
  • Strong English written/verbal communication skills
  • Outstanding creativity, drive, and data orientation
  • Strong sense of responsibility and professionalism
  • Attention to detail with an eye for aesthetics
  • A people person, positive, initiator, curious, independent, and a quick learner
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work well independently or within a team environment
  • Experience with planning in-app campaign calendar
  • Working closely with all teams in executing in-app promotions (Creative, BA, Product, Economy)
SciPlay.title: Monetization Manager

SciPlay.description:
The Head of Monetization & Economy is responsible for driving the business optimization, monetization models, and game economy strategy across the studio’s portfolio—featuring one live product and two upcoming games in the pre-scale phase. This role is a unique blend of highly analytical business strategy and a deep commitment to the player experience. You will be hands-on in crafting the game economy, while managing and leading the LiveOps and monetization operations functions. By collaborating closely with Product, Creative, and LiveOps teams, you will champion out-of-the-box thinking and leverage cutting-edge AI tools to deliver sustainable growth, compelling in-game campaigns, and an unforgettable player journey.
Key Responsibilities
  • Business & Monetization Strategy: Drive the commercial success of our games by optimizing business models, monetization strategies, and revenue streams, ensuring a balance between high profitability and excellent player retention.
  • Hands-on Economy Design: Take a deeply hands-on approach to building, balancing, and optimizing the game economy and math models. Design the delicate balance of difficulty curves versus reward systems to maximize engagement.
  • Player Experience & Product Collaboration: Share the burden of the overall player experience. Collaborate closely with the Product department to spec features that support monetization, shape the creative direction, and design compelling in-game campaigns and events.
  • LiveOps & Configuration Management: Manage and lead the LiveOps and monetization operations function (including configuration specialists). Oversee the end-to-end execution of events, A/B tests, and economy updates to ensure flawless delivery.
  • Scaling & Launch: Build the foundational economy frameworks for two games currently in the launch/pre-scale phase, driving them from soft launch to successful global scale.
  • Innovation & AI Adoption: Act as a pioneer in adopting new technologies. Leverage AI tools and out-of-the-box thinking to optimize economy balancing, automate workflows, and uncover new monetization opportunities.
  • Data & Experimentation: Analyze player behavior and economy health. Define experimentation strategies and run A/B tests to continuously optimize both business KPIs and player satisfaction.
Requirements
  • Must: 5+ years of experience in Game Economy, Monetization, Product Management, or LiveOps within the gaming industry.
  • Must: Proven hands-on experience designing, building, and balancing complex game economies, math models, and progression systems.
  • Must: Demonstrated experience managing employees and leading operational functions (LiveOps, monetization ops, or configuration teams).
  • Strong understanding of the holistic player experience, including difficulty tuning, reward loops, and the impact of creative assets on player behavior.
  • Strong strategic and business acumen, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business and product decisions.
  • A forward-thinking mindset with a demonstrated passion for exploring and adopting AI tools and innovative tech in day-to-day work.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to partner effectively with Product, R&D, and Creative teams.
  • Advantage: Experience with Ad-driven Free-to-Play business models (Ad-Monetization, Rewarded Video, Interstitials) and mediation platforms.

Sensos.description:
The Role:
We're looking for a Head of AI to own everything AI and ML at Sensos - from the agentic systems that power autonomous supply chain execution to the data science and modeling that turn our real-world data into an unfair advantage.
This is a founding leadership role. You'll be 100% hands-on from day one - researching, prototyping, and shipping models and AI capabilities directly into the platform - and over time you'll build and lead the data organization (data science, ML, and analytics). Put simply: you're the person who brings the "smart" into the platform.
We capture billions of real-world signals from IoT smart labels moving through global supply chains. That data is the raw material; your job is to turn it into prediction, detection, and trustworthy autonomous decisions.
What You'll Do:
Work with a wide variety of datasets - IoT sensor, GIS, time-series, tabular, and textual
Solve a range of business problems: time-series prediction, anomaly detection, scoring, and agentic flows
Design real-time inference pipelines
Develop and deploy ML models and LLM-based agents that serve tens of enterprise clients
Conduct exploratory data analysis, feature development, and correlation analysis
Take work all the way from prototype to production — you own it end-to-end
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to embed intelligence natively into the platform and shape the roadmap
Stand up the infrastructure: evaluation pipelines, model promotion, MLOps, and artifact management
Build, hire, and lead the data function (DS, ML, and analytics) as we scale
Lead patent registrations, technical presentations, and stakeholder discussions
Who Supports You:
Full-stack engineers
DevOps to support your MLOps strategy
A seasoned product manager with AI experience
Data-warehouse engineers who query like pros
Domain experts to label data
A budget for managed services (SageMaker, Bedrock), external AI services, and more
Reporting directly to the CTO
What You Bring:
MSc / PhD in Computer Science, ML, Statistics, EE, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field
5+ years in data science / machine learning (required) - including deep neural networks, gradient-boosted trees and classical ML, NLP, and time-series analysis
2+ years hands-on with LLMs / SLMs in applied or production settings (required)
Strong SQL skills, with a track record of data analysis and feature extraction
Production-quality coding, testing, and CI/CD — and fluency coding with an AI agent (Claude Code / Cursor / Codex)
Proven people-leadership: you've managed data scientists / ML engineers and are ready to build and lead the data team as we scale
Fluency working with large, noisy, real-world data
A self-starter who thrives with ambiguity and moves fast in a startup environment
A player-coach mindset: happy to go deep hands-on today and grow a team tomorrow
Preferred / Nice to Have:
Domain experience in supply chain, logistics, or hardware-adjacent software
Registered patents or scientific publication

We're looking for an experienced and passionate ML Engineering Team Lead to lead our ML Engineering team and shape the next generation of our AI infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll combine technical leadership, software architecture, and people management to build scalable, production-ready AI systems running on edge devices.
About The Role
Lead, mentor, recruit, and grow a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Own the team's technical roadmap, architecture, execution, and project prioritization, aligning delivery with business goals.
Design, build, and maintain scalable software and ML infrastructure across cloud and edge environments.
Partner with AI Researchers to productionize Computer Vision and Deep Learning models into reliable, high-performance systems.
Design and optimize inference pipelines with a focus on scalability, latency, and reliability.
Drive engineering excellence through architecture reviews, code reviews, development best practices, and modern AI-assisted engineering workflows.
Your Experience & Skills
6+ years of software development experience, including 3+ years leading software engineering or ML engineering teams.
Strong hands-on experience with Python and C++ or Rust.
Experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-grade Machine Learning systems.
Strong understanding of software architecture, scalable system design, and performance optimization.
Experience collaborating with AI, Machine Learning, or Computer Vision teams.
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills, with a strong ownership mindset.
Experience using modern AI-assisted development tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex) while maintaining high engineering quality.
Nice to Have
Hands-on experience developing and optimizing AI applications on NVIDIA edge platforms, particularly NVIDIA Jetson devices, including GPU acceleration and deployment on resource-constrained systems.
Experience with modern AI and Computer Vision frameworks such as PyTorch, CUDA, TensorRT, NVIDIA DeepStream, and GStreamer.
Experience with containerized and cloud-native development using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using agentic AI coding tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) as part of the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity while maintaining code quality and best practices.
Why Join Us?
Build AI products deployed by leading retailers around the world.
Lead a highly technical team working on real-world Edge AI challenges.

Influence product direction, architecture and engineering culture.
Solve complex engineering problems at the intersection of AI, Computer Vision and retail innovation.

Shopic.title: Software Engineer (Full Stack)

Shortical.description:
Description
We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our core team and own the data, reporting, and insight layer that our biggest decisions are built on — what to greenlight, what to spend, and where to double down. You'll report into the Head of Data and work closely with Marketing, Product, and Content, but the core of the job is data work: querying, modeling, dashboarding, and rigorous analysis. As we scale, so will your scope — this is a launchpad role, not a fixed lane.
Responsibilities
Reporting & Dashboards: Own end-to-end reporting — build, maintain, and improve dashboards (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar) — and ensure the pipelines feeding them are accurate, timely, and well-documented.
Analysis & Insight Generation: Turn raw data into clear, actionable recommendations by analyzing funnels and attribution, tracking core KPIs (CAC, LTV, ROAS, retention), and proactively surfacing opportunities rather than waiting to be asked.
Data Integration & Engineering: Define and validate tables and data models, define BI events and tracking specs with product and engineering, and work closely with the data engineering team to keep data clean, unified, and query-ready across analytics, ad/campaign, CRM, and product data sources.
Experimentation: Support or run A/B tests across campaigns, product features, or content, applying statistical rigor to test design and readouts.
Stakeholder Communication: Translate complex data into clear narratives for non-technical stakeholders, and present findings with a structured, problem-first point of view rather than just executing requests as asked.
Requirements
B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering/Economics/Statistics, or equivalent degree
4+ years in analytics, business intelligence, or a similar analytical role.
Strong SQL and hands-on experience with BigQuery, Presto, or similar large-scale databases/warehouses.
Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar).
Experience building tables/data models and defining BI events, ideally in partnership with data engineering.
Experience working with digital data sources (e.g., Google Analytics, ad platforms, CRM systems).
Solid grasp of funnels, attribution modeling, and core performance KPIs.
Able to communicate complex data clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
High attention to detail; structured, problem-solving mindset.
Huge Advantages
Background in mobile / gaming / short-form content or other high-velocity B2C products.
Experience designing and evaluating A/B tests, including statistical significance.
Shortical.title: Data Analyst

Shortical.description:
Description
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join us and become the backbone for enabling our data-driven decision-making. This is a high-impact role where you will design and maintain our entire data infrastructure - from raw event ingestion to polished dashboards, empowering Content, Product, and Marketing teams with real-time, actionable insights.
You will own the full data pipeline: modeling, transformation, visualization, and automation.
Responsibilities
Data Pipeline Architecture: Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from multiple sources into the data warehouse.
Data Modeling: Design and maintain clean, well-documented data models that serve as the single source of truth for the organization.
BI & Analytics: Build and own dashboards, reports, and self-serve analytics tools that provide real-time visibility into KPIs across acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetization.
Data Quality & Governance: Implement monitoring, alerting, and validation frameworks to ensure data accuracy, freshness, and trust across all pipelines and reports.
Attribution Analytics: Support marketing and growth teams with deep-dive analysis on campaign performance, ROAS, LTV modeling, and attribution across paid and organic channels.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Content, Product, and Marketing teams to translate business questions into data solutions, A/B test analysis, and cohort studies.
Requirements
BSc/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
At least 5 years of experience with designing and building data pipelines, analytical tools, and data warehouses.
Strong Python and SQL skills
Practical experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT workflows using tools such as dbt and Airflow.
Strong proficiency with modern BI platforms (such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI) - building dashboards, calculated fields, and self-serve data products.
Strong analytical thinking with the ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear data solutions and actionable insights.
Experience working with mobile attribution platforms (AppsFlyer, Adjust), product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude), and ad platforms (Meta Ads, Google Ads).
Huge Advantage - industry experience:
Experience analyzing complex in-app purchase economies, subscription funnels, coin/reward systems, and LTV models.
Direct experience with streaming platforms, content performance analytics, or digital media data.
Experience working with Braze, Iterable, or similar CRM/engagement platforms and integrating their data into the warehouse.

Siemens Digital Industries Software.description:
In this role, you will provide essential technical support to our customers utilizing our Tessent Design-For-Test (DFT) products. You will also be responsible for delivering product instruction to both our customers and internal field personnel. This position offers a unique opportunity to deepen your understanding of advanced DFT techniques and their application in various IC designs across industries such as AI, Automotive, Cellular Phones, and many more.
Key Responsibilities:
As a Corporate Application Engineer, your role will involve:
Staying current with the latest advancements in Scan Insertion, ATPG, BIST, and Diagnosis tools.
Collaborating with our Application Engineers and customers worldwide to resolve complex technical DFT issues.
Developing and delivering best-in-class product and flow support for DFT.
Readiness for occasional business travel (less than 10% of working time).
Qualifications:
To succeed in this role, you should possess:
A Bachelor's (BSEE) or Master's (MSEE) degree in Electrical Engineering, with a Master's degree being preferred.
At least two years of experience in IC/VLSI design, specifically in IC/VLSI testing and design for testability.
Preferred experience includes design, simulation, and verification of IC/VLSI circuits and systems, design verification, and product test generation.
An in-depth understanding of Design for Test (DFT) structures is required.
Knowledge of Scan Data Compression methodologies and ATPG flows and/or MemoryBIST Flows is highly desired.
Experience with CAD tools such as Synthesis, Simulation, ATPG, Memory BIST, Logic BIST, and Boundary Scan.
Strong troubleshooting skills are essential.
Excellent interpersonal communication skills and customer-facing skills are a must.
Preferred Experience in Specific Areas:
UNIX, Linux.
Verilog (Behavioral, RTL, gate level), System Verilog, VHDL (Behavioral, RTL, gate level), TCL.
Why Us
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Compensation & Benefits
The salary range for this position is ILS 216,700 to PLN 368,400 and this role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/

Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Solitics.description:
Solitics is a leading SaaS company specializing in microservices, operating at high scale and leveraging cutting-edge technology.
We are committed to delivering top-tier solutions to our clients, and our innovative platform requires a meticulous and forward-thinking QA Engineer to ensure its quality and reliability.
We are seeking a dedicated QA Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for creating automated and manual tests with a primary focus on automation. However, manual testing will also be an essential part of this role, particularly for areas not covered by automated tests. This role involves selecting the right tools for automated testing and ensuring the integrity of our platform through rigorous testing protocols.
Key Responsibilities:
*Automated Testing: Develop and configure automated tests.
Ensure comprehensive coverage of the platform's functionalities through automated test
*Manual Testing: Perform manual testing when necessary, focusing on areas that cannot be covered by automated tests.
*Analytical Review: Analyze and understand the complexities of our platform to identify potential issues and areas for improvement.
*Quality Assurance: Maintain high standards of quality through meticulous testing and validation processes.
*Collaboration: Work closely with development and product teams to understand requirements and integrate testing seamlessly into the development lifecycle.
*Documentation: Create and maintain detailed documentation of test cases, processes, and results.
Requirements:
* Strong focus on automated testing- Willingness for the role which also contains manual tests.
*Proven experience in QA engineering, automations and AI tools
* Strong analytical skills to understand and navigate complex systems.
* Ability to take ownership of the testing process and ensure the highest standards of quality.
* Excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with team members and document testing procedures.
* Strong problem-solving abilities to identify and resolve issues efficiently.
Advantages:
* Experience with microservices architecture.
* Familiarity with AI tools: Cursor, Claude
* Experience with ETL processes.
* Knowledge of big data technologies and practices.
* Experience working with MongoDB.
Solitics.title: QA Engineer

Solitics.description:
We are looking for an experienced Technical Product Manager with strong hands-on experience writing engineering-grade specifications, to work deeply on a complex B2B SaaS platform. In this role, you will be responsible for translating product needs into precise technical specifications, working closely with engineering teams throughout development.
This role is not focused on outbound activity or broad strategic positioning — it is a deeply hands-on position centered on getting into the details and working internally across departments to take ideas from concept to execution.
Key Responsibilities
Product Requirements (PRD): Write detailed, engineering-level Product Requirement Documents, including functional logic, edge cases, technical dependencies, and clear specifications for implementation by R&D.
User Experience (UX): Hands-on involvement in the UX design process, ensuring specifications are intuitive, technically implementable, and meet high usability standards.
Collaboration with R&D: Work closely with engineers to clarify specifications, resolve technical questions during development, and ensure implementation matches the original intent of the spec.
Data Analysis: Use data analytics to inform product decisions and measure the impact of product changes.
Qualifications
Experience: Proven track record in product specification within a B2B environment, particularly SaaS Gaming\trading Experience with complex systems is essential.
Proven previous experience working closely with RND teams
Technical Skills: Hands-on experience building roadmaps and writing engineering-level Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) – required.
Hands-on experience with UX design – required.
AI Proficiency: Knowledge and hands-on experience using AI tools for product specification and product management (e.g., AI-assisted PRD writing, roadmap planning, and analysis) – a plus.
Familiarity with SaaS product development processes.
Experience in data analysis – a plus.
Problem-Solving: Exceptional problem-solving skills, with analytical and creative thinking to translate complex problems into clear technical specifications.
Technical Communication: Strong ability to communicate and translate complex requirements between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Solitics.title: Technical Product Manager

Solitics.description:
About Solitics:
Solitics is a data management platform providing multiple values to our customers, from marketing automation, BI “on the fly” to DWH on demand. We integrate with any type and origin of our customer’s data, transform it, remodel it, and expose it back to our customers in a clear dashboard.
It’s like having a team of data engineers, making magic with your data just for you.
Job Overview:
Junior Technology Integration Specialist
Join our dynamic Data Integration Team, where you'll play a key role in designing, implementing, and optimizing data integrations that drive real business value. This role requires a strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and a deep understanding of data processes to deliver high-quality solutions for our clients.
Responsibilities and Duties:
Data Integration (60%)
Design, build, and maintain seamless data integrations with customers using Streams, Databases (DBs), and APIs.
Ensure efficient data mapping, transformation, and validation processes.
Optimize integration pipelines for performance and scalability.
Customer Support & Issue Resolution (30%)
Troubleshoot and resolve integration or data-related issues for customers.
Act as a trusted technical advisor, helping clients optimize their data processes.
Work closely with Customer Success teams to enhance the onboarding experience and reduce time to value.
Continuous Improvement (10%)
Provide insights to enhance data integration processes, improve system efficiency, and contribute to automation efforts.
Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and implement best practices.
Requirements and Qualifications:
Must-have:
1\2 years max! experience working with SQL databases (MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL).
Strong analytical skills with the ability to understand end-to-end (E2E) data processes and optimize workflows.
Excellent teamwork and communication skills to effectively collaborate with multi-functional teams.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in data transformation and pipeline issues.
Strong ability to write high-performance, reusable SQL queries across multiple databases.
Degree in Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
High level of English required
Advantage:
Russian - speaking is a big advantage
Experience working with large-scale data integration projects.
Experience with MongoDB, JavaScript, Groovy, or API development.
Familiarity with data streaming technologies and cloud-based integrations.
Background in customer-facing technical roles or working closely with customer success teams.

We are looking for a sharp, proactive, and commercially minded Sales Operations Manager to support Surecomp's global commercial organization and work closely with our senior leadership team.
We are looking for someone who understands how sales organizations work, knows how to turn data into insights, and is eager to be in the middle of the action rather than on the sidelines of it. You will own the operational engine of our global sales organization, from Salesforce governance and pipeline visibility through to forecasting, reporting, and commercial analysis, while working closely with senior leadership to translate insights into action.
The right person for this role has a Sales Operations foundation and the mindset to go beyond it. Someone who takes ownership naturally, moves fast, thinks commercially, and uses AI and modern tools not because they have to but because they want to, proactive by nature, not because someone asked to be, and due to the excitement it brings.
This is a hybrid position based out of our Kfar Saba office, supporting a global commercial organization across EMEA, APAC, LATAM, and North America.
Roles and Responsibilities
Own and continuously improve global Sales Operations processes, reporting, and governance across the commercial organization.
Build, maintain, and optimize Salesforce dashboards, pipeline reports, data quality frameworks, and sales performance metrics.
Support the CRO and commercial leadership with forecasting, pipeline analysis, and business performance reviews.
Identify revenue risks, pipeline gaps, and growth opportunities through structured data analysis and commercial thinking.
Partner with regional sales teams to improve CRM adoption, opportunity management, and process discipline.
Support the preparation and execution of business reviews, including analysis, executive presentations, and follow-up tracking.
Work closely with senior leadership to translate strategic decisions into clear operational actions and cross-functional coordination.
Drive commercial initiatives in collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Product teams.
Leverage AI tools and automation to improve reporting, forecasting, and operational efficiency across the revenue organization.
Identify process gaps proactively and recommend improvements without waiting to be asked.
Requirements
Knowledge and Experience
Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations, or a similar business-facing role.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce, including dashboards, reports, pipeline management, and data quality.
Strong analytical skills with proven ability to build reports, track KPIs, and translate data into business insights.
Experience working with or supporting global sales teams or senior commercial leadership.
Full professional proficiency in English, including daily written and verbal interaction with global stakeholders.
Practical experience using AI tools to improve productivity, reporting, or operational workflows.
Advantages
Experience in SaaS, enterprise software, fintech, or another complex B2B technology environment.
Experience supporting QBR processes, forecasting cycles, or executive business reviews.
Familiarity with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
Experience with sales enablement, onboarding coordination, or process adoption programs.
Additional languages beyond English.
Skills
Highly analytical with strong attention to detail and a natural ability to connect data to business outcomes.
Proactive and self-driven, someone who identifies problems and acts on them without being prompted.
Strong commercial mindset and genuine interest in how sales organizations operate and grow.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present clearly to senior stakeholders.
Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving, global environment.
AI-driven approach to work, with a genuine interest in using modern tools to work smarter and faster.
Eager to learn, grow, and take on increasing responsibility over time.

About the Role
We are looking for a Junior Fullstack Engineer who is excited about building real product features end-to-end and eager to grow in modern web development within RIVO , our flagship platform.
This is not an internship , we’re looking for someone with solid foundations in TypeScript , Node.js , and ReactJS , who is motivated to deepen their skills in production-grade systems.
You’ll work alongside experienced engineers to design and build features across the stack, from UI and API design, through data modeling, to performance and reliability improvements.
Location: Kfar Saba, Israel
Reporting to: Full Stack Squad Lead
Employment Type: Full-time Position
Roles and Responsibilities
Develop and maintain frontend components using ReactJS.
Build backend services and APIs using Node.js + TypeScript.
Work with MongoDB for data modeling, queries, and performance improvements.
Integrate frontend and backend flows end-to-end (auth, data fetching, state management, etc.).
Implement modules from technical design to delivery including error handling, logging, and monitoring.
Contribute to code quality: clean code, reviews, refactoring, and testing.
Support performance improvements across the UI and API layers.
Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to deliver user-facing features.
Requirements
Knowledge and Experience
Recently completed a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field from a leading university, with an average grade of 90 or higher.
Knowledge of or experience with Node.js and TypeScript.
Knowledge of web development technologies (e.g., HTML, CSS, React).
Familiarity with databases, including SQL and NoSQL.
Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git).
Understanding of software testing and quality assurance practices.
Prior experience with software development projects or internships.
Skills
Ability to perform in a global company, in a multi-cultural environment
Strong organizational and time management skills
Ability to prioritize tasks effectively
Strong work ethic, proactive, self-motivated, and results-driven
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
Proficient in spoken and written English

SysAid.description:
Description
This is the demand generation engine, and it’s yours. Every digital channel that brings qualified demand into the funnel, paid and organic, is yours to build, run, and keep making better.
It’s a hands-on role, and honestly, that’s the best part. You’ll be in the ad accounts. You’ll build the nurture yourself in the automation platform. You’ll show up in the communities where your buyers actually spend their time. You launch something, watch what happens, and change it, often the same week. Short feedback loops, real budget, and the freedom to test things without asking permission first.
What you’re measured on is what converts, not what you launched. Lead volume matters, but the number you really own sits further down: MQL → SQL → Opportunity, and the pipeline that comes out the other end. When something slips, you get to go find out why: targeting, message, channel, or handoff, and fix it while there’s still time to matter.
You’ll run the calendar the way a good program manager would: multiple channels, agencies, and internal dependencies, with clear owners and dates. Campaigns ship when they said they’d ship, and that reliability is a big part of why the rest of the business trusts marketing.
You’ll work closely with Sales, SDR/BDR leadership, Product Marketing, and Revenue Operations every week. None of them report to you, which makes this a role for someone who enjoys bringing people along, sharing what’s working, being straight about what isn’t, and making it easy for everyone to see where the pipeline is coming from.
If you’d rather own a channel than oversee one, and you like the version of marketing where you can point at a number and say “that one’s mine,” you’ll enjoy this.
Key Responsibilities
Run the paid channels
Build, launch, and optimize paid search, paid social (LinkedIn, Meta, X), display and programmatic, and content syndication, audiences, creative, bids, budgets, and sequencing.
Run structured tests continuously across creative, audience, offer, and landing page. Weekly optimization cadence, not quarterly retrospectives.
Own the media budget end to end: allocate the next dollar to the channel producing pipeline, and shut down what does not — with the data to defend both decisions.
Run the organic and community channels
Own organic and community as genuine demand sources, not an afterthought: Reddit and other buyer communities and forums, organic social, YouTube, and owned content distribution.
Earn distribution where buyers actually are — participate credibly in communities rather than broadcasting into them, and know the difference between a channel that tolerates promotion and one that punishes it.
Own SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) — visibility and citation in AI search and answer engines — in partnership with content.
Account-based marketing
Build and prioritize target account and persona lists, and adapt the approach as deal size and buying committee change.
Run coordinated account-based programs across advertising, email, and SDR outreach so an account sees one story, not four.
Lifecycle, nurture, and marketing automation
Build and own email nurture programs, lead scoring, and routing logic directly in the marketing automation platform.
Keep data hygiene, suppression, and consent handling clean as programs scale.
Webinars and events
Own the full motion: pre-event targeting and registration driving, live engagement, and post-event follow-up with a defined SLA — measured on pipeline, not attendance.
Funnel ownership and Sales partnership
Define and defend qualified-lead criteria with Sales and SDR/BDR leadership, and own the handoff SLA and the feedback loop on lead quality.
Inspect stage-to-stage conversion weekly, diagnose drops, and adjust targeting, messaging, or channel mix.
Treat Sales feedback as a primary signal — and hold the quality bar when volume pressure pushes the other way.
Measurement, attribution, and reporting
Build and maintain the demand gen dashboard, and use it weekly rather than monthly.
Establish a defensible source of truth for attribution with Revenue Operations, and reconcile marketing-reported pipeline against what Sales sees in the CRM.
Present performance clearly to an executive audience — including the quarters that go badly, surfaced early with a recommendation attached.
Program and project management
Run a rolling multi-channel campaign calendar with named owners, dependencies, and deadlines across internal teams and external agencies.
Land launches on date, and unblock dependencies before they slip rather than reporting on them afterwards.
AI in the workflow
Apply AI where it produces measurable lift — creative production and testing, audience building, personalization at scale, predictive scoring, and campaign optimization — with guardrails on brand voice and data quality.
Requirements
Required
3+ years in B2B SaaS demand generation within a sales-led motion (mid-market and enterprise segments), not a pure self-serve or product-led environment.
Demonstrably hands-on. You personally build campaigns, sit in the ad platforms, and make the optimizations. You can walk through exactly what you changed in an underperforming campaign last month, and why.
A track record of improving funnel conversion and pipeline contribution — not only lead or MQL volume.
Fluent across the paid stack: Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta, programmatic/display, and content syndication.
Fluent across organic and community channels: SEO, community platforms including Reddit, and organic social — with a real point of view on how to earn attention there.
Hands-on with a marketing automation platform (Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, Eloqua or similar) and CRM (Salesforce or similar) — building programs yourself, not requesting them.
Experience with ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase or equivalent) and with multi-touch attribution and analytics tooling (GA4, BI/dashboarding, CRM reporting).

SysAid.description:
Description
This is a senior marketing leadership role with real breadth. You'll own SysAid's market narrative, brand identity, and the full content engine behind it, leading a team of seven across product marketing, content, creative, design, communications, partner marketing, and field marketing.
The right person has lived at the intersection of PMM and brand long enough to have opinions about how they should work together. They lead by creating clarity. They think in systems. And they're genuinely curious about what AI means for how a marketing team operates, not as a trend to follow, but as infrastructure to build on purpose.
About the role
You'll own how SysAid shows up in the market. That means the messaging that lands in a sales conversation, the brand identity on a campaign, the content that earns category authority over time, and the story that reaches analysts, press, and partners. All of it runs through you.
Your team covers a lot of ground: product marketing, content, creative, design, communications, partner marketing, and field marketing. That's a diverse set of disciplines, each with its own cadence and craft. The leadership challenge here isn't managing up; it's creating the conditions for seven specialists to pull in the same direction, at the same pace, without losing coherence.
You'll report to the CMO and sit at the table with Growth, Sales, and Product. You're expected to show up with a point of view on the message, on the market, on what we should be saying, and what we should stop saying.
The person we're looking for has probably led a repositioning. Has built a messaging framework that held up under pressure from Sales and Product. Has grown people who went on to lead their own functions. And is already thinking about how AI changes what a content team can produce, and what it takes to make that output trustworthy.
One thing worth knowing: this team owns the content infrastructure that feeds SysAid's AI-powered marketing engine. In a world where AI generates content at scale, the quality of the inputs determines the quality of everything downstream. That's not a technical problem; it's a leadership and editorial one. And it sits with you.
What you'll do
Own SysAid's messaging framework, which is the single source of truth for how the company talks about what it does and why it matters.
Build and maintain persona-level, product-level, and industry-level positioning that holds up in the field, including in a sales conversation, an analyst briefing, a paid campaign, or a press interview.
Translate product releases, market shifts, and competitive moves into messaging updates that reach every function fast.
Own SysAid's brand identity: visual standards, tone of voice, brand book, asset templates, and 10x our creative output.
Own the communications and PR strategy, specifically how SysAid shows up in press, analyst relations, and industry conversations.
Activate these narratives across every channel, in collaboration with Growth, to drive pipeline and brand awareness.
Grow and nurture your team, empowering them to achieve their targets and career goals.
Operationalize AI across every key content, creative, and GTM process.
Requirements
10+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with direct ownership of both product marketing and brand. Exposure to both is not the same thing.
Proven track record building messaging from scratch — frameworks that held up when they hit Sales, Product, and the market simultaneously.
Experience leading and growing diverse marketing teams. Your reports develop under you. That's a pattern, not a coincidence.
A track record in cross-functional GTM: launches, repositioning exercises, or category-defining moments you can walk through in detail.
AI-native mindset. Not someone who has just tried the tools, but someone who has thought through what AI means for how a content team should be structured, what the inputs need to look like, and how to keep quality high at volume.
Comfortable at the strategic layer when the picture is still forming. Precise and execution-focused when it's time to ship.
Empathic by default, but not soft. You lead by creating clarity — for your team, for your peers, for the exec team.
A robust sense of humor:)
Why SysAid
SysAid sits at the intersection of two things the market hasn't figured out how to combine yet: enterprise-grade ITSM with agentic AI that actually does the work.
Most IT platforms added a chatbot and called it AI. SysAid's AI resolves incidents, fulfills requests, triggers workflows, and deploys automations on its own: no code, no developer, no black box. Every action is logged, traceable, and tied to rules the IT team sets. That's not a product feature. That's a different category. And the market is still catching up to what that means.
The company is at an inflection point. The product is winning. The pipeline is growing. And the marketing team is mid-way through building the operating system to match, which is a structured execution model where AI handles content production at scale, and humans own direction, quality, and judgment. It's in motion, not finished. The person stepping into this role will shape how it comes together.
That's the opportunity. A market position that's genuinely differentiated. A product that does what it says. An infrastructure that's being built with intention. And a team of seven waiting for a leader who can raise the standard across all of it.
If you want to own the narrative for a company at this moment, not after the story is written, but while it's being written, this is it.
SysAid.title: Director of Product Marketing & Brand

SysAid.description:
Description
SysAid is becoming an agentic ITSM leader - and we're rebuilding R&D to match. In our AI-native model, a managed, always-on "Machine" produces most of the code while small pods of engineers, PMs and designers direct, review, and govern it. In that world, quality isn't a phase - it's how the system is built. We're hiring a Quality Lead to own that. Why this role is different: you won't run a traditional QA team that tests features at the end. You'll own the quality gates inside the Machine and in production, author the monitoring skills our pods rely on, and hold independent authority to fail the Machine's output. Quality is our north star, and this role sets the bar.
THE MISSION: Make reliability, performance, and user experience a property of the system — not of individual heroics. Build and lead a Quality function (~9 people) that keeps an AI-native delivery org fast and trustworthy, and give the business confidence that what the Machine ships is safe to ship.
WHAT YOU'LL DO:
﻿ Own quality gates in the Machine — prose-driven tests (generated from requirements, not the code), adversarial / agent-checks-agent review, static analysis and code-quality remediation (e.g. SonarCloud), and CI gates that run before anything reaches a human.
Own quality in production — release verification, production testing, and ownership of change-fail and deployment-rework rates.
Author monitoring guidelines & reusable observability skills that delivery pods and the Machine consume — so monitoring is built in, not bolted on.
Own the evals that score the Machine's output for behavioral consistency and reliability — treating evaluation as a first-class engineering discipline.
Act as an independent governance voice — with the authority to block or fail output that doesn't meet the bar, partnering closely with Architecture.
Partner with the Core Platform team on the quality of customer-issue fixes and existing functionality.
Lead, coach and grow the team — quality/gate engineers, an agent-evaluation engineer, production-monitoring (SRE) and QA-infrastructure engineers.
Set the quality metrics and report them — DORA + deployment-rework rate, escaped-defect rate, review-queue depth, eval pass rates.
WHAT YOU'LL OWN (OUTCOMES)
Fewer regressions and less firefighting; faster resolution of customer issues.
Reliability, performance and UX that customers can count on.
A quality system trustworthy enough to let autonomous delivery scale safely.
Requirements
7+ years in software quality / QA engineering, including leading a team, ideally owning quality for a SaaS product at scale.
Deep hands-on experience with test automation, CI/CD, and quality gates;
comfort with code-quality tooling (SonarQube/SonarCloud or similar).
Strong production monitoring / observability background (Datadog or
equivalent) and SRE-adjacent practices; monitoring-as-code a plus.
Fluency with engineering metrics — DORA, change-fail / rework rate, defect
escape — and using them to drive decisions.
Comfortable with AI-assisted / agentic development and evaluating LLM/agent
output (evals) — or a strong, demonstrated eagerness to go deep here.
A player-coach: credible hands-on and able to build and grow a team.
Able to hold an independent line and manage stakeholders across Engineering
and Product.
Professional English; based in (or able to work from) our Ukraine delivery center.
NICE TO HAVE
Experience with agentic coding tools and orchestration.
LLM evaluation frameworks and prompt/skill versioning.
ITSM domain experience.
WHY JOIN
An unusually broad, high-impact mandate: own quality across the Machine,
production, and monitoring — with real authority.
Shape the quality function of an AI-native R&D org from a strong technical base —and set standards that govern every build at fleet scale.
We build the way we sell: our own R&D is the proof case for agentic ITSM.
SysAid.title: Quality Lead - AI-Native R&D

SysAid.description:
Description
We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to lead complex product challenges from discovery to delivery, partnering closely with Product and Engineering to build exceptional enterprise experiences. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep UX expertise, strong product thinking, and modern AI-powered ways of building products.
At SysAid, we're building AI-first enterprise software used by thousands of IT teams worldwide. We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to lead complex product challenges from discovery to delivery, partnering closely with Product and Engineering to build exceptional enterprise experiences.
What You'll Do
Own the end-to-end design quality within one or more product pods, small cross-functional teams of Product, Design, and Engineering focused on solving customer problems together.
Lead UX research, discovery, and problem framing.
Design complex workflows and user experiences from concept to production.
Drive excellence across UX research, interaction design, and overall user experience.
Work in AI-first, code-first product development workflows.
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape product direction and delivery.
Improve design processes, tools, and team workflows.
Requirements
5+ years of Product Design experience, including at least 3 years designing complex B2B or enterprise products.
Experience designing AI-first products or AI-powered experiences.
Strong product thinking with the ability to balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints.
Excellent UX, interaction, and visual design skills with strong attention to detail.
Hands-on experience with modern AI tools as part of the design process.
A builder mindset with high ownership, pragmatism, and the ability to thrive in ambiguity.
Fluent English.
Nice to Have
Comfortable working with codebases, repositories, and frontend technologies.
Hands-on experience with AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar.
Experience with analytics or experimentation platforms such as Mixpanel.
Experience designing products for IT professionals or other complex technical domains.

Teads.description:
About Teads
Teads is a leading omnichannel advertising platform focused on driving outcomes for brand and performance advertisers across screens. With a focus on meaningful business outcomes for branding and performance objectives, Teads drives value by leveraging predictive AI technology to connect quality media, beautiful brand creative, and context-driven addressability and measurement. Teads is directly partnered with more than 10,000 publishers and 20,000 advertisers globally. The company is headquartered in New York, New York with a global team of around 1,700 people in 30+ countries.
For more information, visit www.teads.com.
Our main Engineering challenges at Teads
Build efficient and easy-to-use web products used by thousands of users working for the world’s most premium publishers, advertisers, and agencies.
Rich and diverse tech stack and system architecture to optimize for performance, scalability, resiliency , and cost efficiency. We use mostly Scala and TypeScript, among others.
Working in a very high-traffic environment (2.2 billion users per month, 100 billion events per day) with low latency and high availability constraints (2 million requests per second, responses in less than 150 milliseconds).
Management of large datasets with milliseconds order of magnitude access time, to compute in a near real-time complex auction resolution algorithm (18 million predictions per second).
A fast-changing environment where we continuously collaborate with Product teams and constantly adapt our Cloud infrastructure for new features and Products .
Bring a wide diversity of profiles to the same level of quality and knowledge Work in an international environment with offices located in Israel, Slovenia and France.
Our Core Data Platform team
We're a leading force in the ad tech industry, revolutionizing how brands connect with their audiences. Our platform processes billions of ad impressions daily, generating massive datasets that drive our core business.
We thrive on innovation and seek a Senior Data Infra Engineer to help us build and scale the data infrastructure that powers our insights and analytics.
This is a unique opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and make a direct impact on our products.
What will you do?
As a Senior Data Infra Engineer, you'll be a key part of our data platform team, responsible for designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable data pipelines. You'll work closely with data scientists, analysts, and server side engineers to ensure our data is reliable, accessible, and ready for analysis. Your expertise will be crucial in expanding our data warehouse and data lake capabilities, enabling us to deliver next-generation ad tech solutions.
Your mission will be to:
Develop and Optimize Data Pipelines: Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Apache Spark to ingest, process, and transform large-scale datasets from various sources.
Manage Cloud Infrastructure: Architect and manage our data infrastructure primarily on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Amazon Web Services (AWS) . This includes services like BigQuery, S3, GCS, EMR, and AirFlow.
Enhance Data Storage: Improve and manage our data warehouse and data lake solutions, ensuring data quality, consistency, and accessibility for business intelligence and machine learning applications.
Collaborate and Innovate: Partner with cross-functional teams to understand data needs and implement solutions that support new product features and business initiatives.
Ensure Data Integrity: Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging systems to maintain data pipeline health and ensure data accuracy.
What will you bring to the team?
5+ years of data engineering experience , building and operating production data pipelines at scale (TB+ datasets, hourly/daily batch or streaming workloads).
Hands-on production experience with Apache Spark and distributed data processing frameworks such as Flink, Hive, or Trino. Strong understanding of large-scale batch and streaming pipelines , including performance tuning and troubleshooting. Language is not a filter: Scala, Python, or Java are all fine. What matters is that you can debug and ship production Spark code, not which language you write it in
Production experience building and operating data solutions on GCP or AWS , including cloud-native services such as BigQuery, Dataproc, GCS, S3, EMR, or Redshift. Experience across the full project lifecycle is preferred.
Production experience with Kafka or Kafka-compatible streaming platforms , including the development, operation, and troubleshooting of real-time data pipelines, as well as debugging production incidents involving consumer lag, partition rebalancing, or data loss.
Strong understanding of data warehouse and data lake concepts , including Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and data platform best practices.
Nice to have
Production experience with a lakehouse table format (Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake). The specific format matters less than the underlying concepts: you understand how the lake stores data on object storage, how a table format adds transactional semantics on top and how a data warehouse can read that data. You have dealt with schema evolution and table maintenance.
Please submit your CV in English.
We care about you
Hybrid working model (3 days per week in the office)
Nearby parking available
Expand your toolbox with our mentorship program and internal learning tools
Pet friendly office
Happy hours
…and of course a fully stocked kitchen!

Teads.description:
About Teads
Teads is a leading omnichannel advertising platform focused on driving outcomes for brand and performance advertisers across screens. With a focus on meaningful business outcomes for branding and performance objectives, Teads drives value by leveraging predictive AI technology to connect quality media, beautiful brand creative, and context-driven addressability and measurement. Teads is directly partnered with more than 10,000 publishers and 20,000 advertisers globally. The company is headquartered in New York, New York with a global team of around 1,700 people in 30+ countries.
For more information, visit www.teads.com.
About the opportunity
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join a team of passionate engineers who build premium solutions at scale. Every day, we tackle ambiguous and stimulating challenges. We build and operate large-scale distributed machine learning systems that process 1B predictions per second during real-time auctions.
What will you do?
As a Senior Data Scientist , your mission will be to:
Improve existing algorithms & tools allowing to explore and analyze more and more data and provide accurate feedback on the Teads activities.
Develop new algorithms & new approaches to provide accurate predictions and drive new products by providing business insights.
Implement your algorithms and models end to end.
Collaborate with a variety of teams to develop services from design to production.
Make sure the software is in good hands by writing, running and automating tests (unit, functional, load...).
Keep up to date with the latest Machine Learning technologies to make sure we always use the best class algorithms according to the context.
Shape how billions of people discover and enjoy premium content by improving ad relevance, quality, and efficiency across Teads’ global publisher network.
What will you bring to the team?
Strong communication skills, working collaboratively with the team, able to teach concepts, and communicate clearly to a wide audience of complicated topics.
Strong problem solving skills, and deducing from specific problems wider range products.
True scientist skills: fast learner, curious, sense of details, rigorous.
Experience in Statistics (i.e. statistical analysis, regression analysis, …) and Artificial Intelligence (i.e. Data Mining, Machine Learning, …).
An appetite for Data Science applied to high-volumetry, low-latency topics.
Ability to read scientific articles, to analyze critically, and to implement as appropriate.
Good programming abilities.
You are very mindful about your application architecture, performance, testing and maintainability and its overall quality.
Requirements:
5+ years of hands-on experience with coding ML based solutions in high scale systems
Relevant industry experience / publications in ad-tech and recommender system
Msc/Phd in computer science / math
Industry experience in building engineering at scale
Large-scale distributed systems, service oriented architecture.
Previous experience with all or some of the elements of our Stack (we mainly use Go, Python, Java, AWS , Jupyter notebooks).
Knowledge in data engineering.
Ability to transform raw data into actionable business insights
Please submit your CV in English.
Life at Teads
At Teads, we don’t just offer new roles - we blend creativity, technology, and data to shape the future of media. You’ll work with smart humans, meaningful brands, and cool tools, all while helping redefine how advertising works in a world that demands more transparency, better insights, and smarter strategies.
As a Teadster, you’ll play a critical role in shaping our future success in the region. Here’s why Teads stands out:
We've merged two open internet category leaders—Outbrain and Teads—to create the ‘new’ Teads, a unified omnichannel platform that drives results from branding to performance across all screens, including CTV, mobile, and web.
As part of our team, you’ll thrive in a collaborative and forward-thinking environment that fosters innovation, creative problem-solving, and continuous learning.
Teads is committed to your success, offering the support, tools, and development opportunities you need to excel in your role.
Our company culture is welcoming, dynamic, diverse, global, and built on top performance.
Teads is an equal employment opportunity employer and committed to diversity and inclusion at all stages of recruitment and employment.
Our team is made up of individuals who are approachable, resourceful, passionate, and proactive. We foster a sense of belonging through our Employee Resource Groups – employee-led groups in which we debate topics and drive change: environmental, women empowerment, charitable initiatives to diversity, equity, and inclusion, you’ll be able to share your passions with likeminded people.

Tenengroup Ltd..description:
About the Role:
Our Business Analytics team is looking for a passionate and analytical team player to join us.
In this role, you'll take ownership of the deep analysis behind our brands' performance, turning complex data into actionable business insights. You'll analyze customer funnels, monitor key KPIs, evaluate experiments, and partner closely with cross-functional teams to drive data-informed decision-making.
As part of our AI-first approach, you'll also help shape how analytics is performed across the organization by leveraging AI tools, improving analytical processes, and raising the overall standard of our analytics function.
This is an excellent opportunity for a strong individual contributor who is looking to make a significant business impact without a managerial track.
Responsibilities
Explore and analyze large-scale data across our sources (internal DWH / Databricks lakehouse, Google BigQuery, GA4, and more) to understand and improve brand and business performance.
Own the deep analysis of each brand’s funnel and KPIs — explain what drives conversion, AOV/AIV, revenue per visitor and retention/LTV, and pinpoint where the funnel leaks and why.
Run the analysis behind A/B and pricing experiments end to end, and deliver a clear ship / iterate / kill recommendation.
Lead an AI-first approach to analytics — use AI and agents to analyze faster and deeper, and to build self-serve insight for non-analysts.
Shape how the analytics function works — champion high-quality data practices, set standards through best practices, drive standardization and scale, and mentor and guide other analysts.
Generate actionable insights through queries and data-visualization tools (Tableau), and turn them into recommendations that drive business decisions.
Initiate new projects and ideas that anticipate the company’s needs.
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics, Economics, or a related field.
4+ years of industry experience as a business/data analyst, with strong leadership engagement – must
3+ years writing complex SQL queries - must
3+ years with Tableau (or a comparable BI tool) - must
Experience in the online / e-commerce industry - must
Strong diagnostic analytics: able to break a KPI down into its drivers and analyze a full funnel, not just report numbers, but explain the “why” and find the lever -must
End-to-end ownership of the data flow: problem definition, data collection, modeling, analysis, and reporting - must
Hands-on, daily use of AI/LLM tools for analysis, with the drive to push an AI-first way of working — not just occasional use - must
Experience with A/B testing/experimentation and the statistics behind it - must
Experience with Excel.
Storytelling - turning analysis into a clear, convincing narrative- is what we are looking for.
Agile mindset - start fresh after a failure.
Advantages
Experimentation / feature-flag platforms (GrowthBook, Optimizely, Eppo, StatSig, VWO).
Building AI / agentic workflows for analytics - beyond using a chatbot: wiring LLMs into reporting, agent or MCP-based tooling, automated insight generation.
Python or R for analysis and automation.
Pricing, unit-economics or COGS-based profit analysis.
GA4, Adobe Analytics or Amplitude; modern data-engineering stack (dbt, Airflow, Kafka, lakehouse / Unity Catalog).
Experience in a considered-purchase category (jewelry, fashion, luxury).
Apply for this position

In this central role, you will oversee our business infrastructure and manage key workflows to ensure the team has everything they need to succeed. We are seeking a detail-oriented individual who takes ownership and thrives in a fast-paced environment, acting as the go-to person for keeping our operations running smoothly. Responsibilities Process Building: Build, document, and implement company-wide operational processes across Finance, HR, and Legal. Establish clear ownership and KPIs for how things get done. Finance & Legal Management: Manage our external service providers. Ensure they deliver payroll and audits on time, while you own the internal budget, burn rate, and commercial contract reviews. Corporate Housekeeping: Standardize procedures for the company's "back office" including ESOP, Cap table, compliance, and Commercial Agreements. Data & Reporting: Synthesize data from external financial teams and internal sales metrics to produce board-ready updates and actionable insights for investors and founders. HR & People: Manage the full employee lifecycle (onboarding to offboarding), recruitment flow, and company welfare. Vendor Management: Oversee procurement and external vendors, negotiating contracts to ensure cost-efficiency and service quality. ‍ Office Operations & Environment: Manage day-to-day office logistics and facilities to maintain a productive and positive work environment. This includes overseeing office administration, coordinating team events, and driving employee welfare initiatives. Requirements 1 Year of experience in Operations, Office Management, or Administration within a startup or high-tech environment. Comfortable with numbers, Excel, and tracking budgets. You don't need to be a CFO, but you must have strong financial literacy. Experience coordinating with external service providers (suppliers, legal, finance) and ensuring accountability and timely delivery. Previous experience in Law or Finance is a strong advantage. Tomorrow.io.description:
Tomorrow.io’s Saas department is focused on building software and products at scale, from infrastructure that handles massive amounts of data to outstanding customer centric user experiences in B2B, B2C and B2D products that change billions of lives worldwide.
We’re looking for a AI First - Senior Fullstack Engineering who will be a force multiplier on the Growth/Experts team - a high-output , impact-driven builde r who leverages every tool at their disposal (including AI) to move at extraordinary speed.
This person doesn't wait for a perfectly scoped spec - they understand the business problem, shape the solution, and build it end-to-end. They own complex challenges across backend and frontend, ship fast, unblock teammates, and raise the bar for what one engineer can accomplish.
AI tools are a natural part of how they work, making them dramatically more effective - not a separate initiative, just how they operate.
As a Senior Fullstack Engineer at Tomorrow.io, You’ll:
Build from problem to production - take a business need or user pain point, understand the "why," design the approach, and ship a working solution - even without a full design spec or detailed product requirements.
Ship at 10X pace - deliver complex, end-to-end features across backend and frontend at a speed that surprises people, by leveraging AI and smart shortcuts without cutting corners on quality.
Own big problems - take ambiguous, cross-cutting challenges and turn them into working solutions with minimal hand-holding.
Multiply the team - unblock teammates, share knowledge, raise quality through code reviews, and make everyone around them better.Build with impact - prioritize work that moves the needle for users and the business, not just what's technically interesting.
Continuous Improvement - proactively identify bottlenecks, tech debt, or inefficiencies and fix them without waiting to be asked.
______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
What you bring:
Technical
7+ years fullstack development
Knowledge in JS/TypeScript, React, Node.js
Strong system design skills - can architect features and services, not just implement tickets
Comfortable across the full stack: backend logic, APIs, databases, frontend UI
Experience with MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, cloud
Real Production system experience and scale
Fluent in AI-assisted development - uses AI tools daily as a natural part of their workflow to code faster, debug smarter, and explore solutions quicker
Nice to have: Mapbox, GCP, WebGL
Behavioral
Builder mindset - sees a business problem and instinctively starts shaping a solution. Doesn't need a pixel-perfect design or a detailed PRD to start building something valuable.
10X mindset - always looking for the fastest, smartest path to a high-quality result
Resourceful problem solver - uses every tool available (AI included) to get things done
Impact over output - thinks about what matters, not just what's assigned
Team multiplier - lifts others up through pairing, reviews, and knowledge sharing
Ownership without ego - takes full responsibility, puts team success first
At Tomorrow.io, we are revolutionizing climate intelligence through AI-driven insights, real-time decision-making tools, and cutting-edge forecasting technologies. Our Experts / Verticals team builds compelling solutions for both expert users (meteorologists and other weather-savvy users) and develops industry-specific solutions tailored to verticals such as Aviation, Logistics, and more.In addition, the team is responsible for building the company’s first AI-Native infrastructure that allows anyone to build new experiences using agentic workflows.
As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you’ll have the opportunity to work on impactful projects that directly influence industries like aviation, logistics, and emergency response, where weather intelligence is critical. You won’t just build software-you’ll help shape the way businesses operate in an increasingly unpredictable climate.
You'll be part of a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment where AI plays a central role in our technological evolution. If you thrive on learning new technologies, experimenting with AI integrations, and solving complex challenges that have a global impact, this is the role for you.
If you have reached this point and you are super excited but not sure you check all the boxes - we still want to speak with you! Your passion is priceless. Other things can be learned.

Tomorrow.io.description:
Tomorrow.io’s Saas department is focused on building software and products at scale, from infrastructure that handles massive amounts of data to outstanding customer centric user experiences in B2B, B2C and B2D products that change billions of lives worldwide.
We're seeking a Staff engineer - AI Builder to lead the design and implementation of AI-native technical frameworks that redefine how large-scale systems are built, extended, and evolved.
This role is deeply technical and architecture-driven, focused on designing modular, extensible, and AI-first system foundations that enable scalable development with AI as a core engineering collaborator.
You will work across the full stack, building infrastructure where AI actively generates, extends, and maintains software components as part of the native development flow.
This is not about incremental AI integration — this is about architecting the frameworks that let AI scale software engineering 10x faster and smarter .
Responsibilities
Architect and lead the development of AI-native system frameworks that emphasize modularity, extensibility, and adaptive scalability.
Build platform primitives that enable dynamic AI-driven module and extension generation .
Design and implement developer workflows optimized for AI-assisted software development , embedding AI collaboration as a first-class design principle.
Define and codify AI-native engineering practices , patterns, and guidelines to elevate Tomorrow.io’s software development lifecycle.
Establish and champion best practices for AI-assisted engineering across system design, code quality, testing, observability, and operational scalability.
Drive hands-on prototyping and iterative delivery across frontend, backend, and orchestration layers.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship, fostering an AI-first engineering culture across teams.
Partner closely with Product, AI, and Engineering teams to align system evolution with AI-native goals.
Requirements
Strong builder’s mindset — balancing deep system thinking with practical, hands-on delivery.
10+ years of full stack system architecture and complex platform engineering experience.
Deep expertise designing distributed, composable, and extensible systems across frontend and backend environments.
Strong hands-on skills with frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Next.js) and backend systems (e.g., Node.js, Python, Go, microservices, event-driven architectures).
Proven experience integrating and operationalizing AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) into engineering workflows.
Experience building plugin frameworks, extension systems, or developer platforms that emphasize modularity and scalability.
Track record of defining and promoting engineering best practices — especially in the context of AI-driven development.
Demonstrated technical leadership — mentoring engineers, shaping architecture standards, and driving adoption of new paradigms.
