Twine Security.description:
About the Role:
We're looking for a Product Manager to own the operational efficiency aspect of the platform end to end. This is both a strategy and an execution role: you'll decide what execution responsibilities the product would expand to and be in the details with engineering and design shipping it. The hard part isn't building a workflow - it's knowing which work a customer will genuinely hand to an agent, and what has to be true before they will.
What You'll Do:
Define human and agent interaction models: Shape how users collaborate with AI agents, from user initiated queries and agent driven outreach to seamless side by side execution.
Lead agentic ticket resolution and IAM automation : Own the end to end product strategy for identity tasks, including provisioning and deprovisioning, entitlement changes, plus joiner, mover, and leaver workflows.
Own the agentic execution layer: Spec the core product rails for executing actions in customer environments, including human approval flows, risk controls, and confidence building mechanisms.
Drive field to roadmap feedback loops: Partner closely with customer facing and POC teams to translate real world edge cases and customer insights into scalable roadmap features.
Requirements:
2+ years building or owning products where the deliverable is work getting done - workflow automation, ITSM, orchestration, ops tooling, RPA. Something with queues, approvals, handoffs, and a human on the other end who either trusts the system or works around it.
Experience with agentic AI or LLM-based system s - particularly human-in-the-loop design and how agents hold up their end of a conversation with a person
Enough security fluency to make access decisions responsibly, or the appetite to build it fast. You don't need years in the industry, but you'll be making calls about access and permissions and you can't be squeamish about the stakes.
You're comfortable in the details. You'll spec approval flows and escalation logic with engineering and design, define what "resolved" means precisely enough to measure, and write requirements precise enough to build from.
Nice to Have:
Background in IAM, IGA, or PAM - you know what an entitlement, a group, and a joiner-mover-leaver process actually are
Cybersecurity experience more broadly, in any function
Experience working with customer-facing or POC teams, turning field signal into roadmap
Intertwine your future with ours!
At Twine, we're dedicated to fast, informed decisions and transparent collaboration, tackling some of the cyber industry’s most complex challenges. With passion and expertise, we build AI digital cybersecurity employees like no other. Join us in addressing the evolving, unparalleled challenge of bridging the cyber execution gap.

About the Role:
You'll own technically difficult problems before the solution is known. Starting with a cybersecurity need, you'll study the domain, frame the technical challenge, investigate possible approaches, and build the solution through production. You'll have access to Twine's shared agent infrastructure, but the role goes far beyond configuring existing components. Many use cases will require new reasoning methods, agent architectures, evaluation techniques, data strategies, or model behavior. This is a role for someone who enjoys applied research but is motivated by outcomes. The goal is not simply to prove that an idea can work, it is to make it useful and reliable for customers.
What You'll Do:
Design and implement AI solutions for complex cybersecurity workflows.
Develop new approaches for agent reasoning, planning, tool use, context management, decision-making, and recovery from failures.
Determine the right technical approach for each problem, combining models, algorithms, data, and conventional software where appropriate.
Define quality for each use case and create evaluations that measure correctness, task completion, consistency, safety, latency, and cost.
Analyze agent behavior deeply, identify the underlying causes of failures, and improve the relevant model, data, tool, or architecture.
Collaborate with cybersecurity experts, product teams, software engineers, and AI infrastructure engineers throughout development.
Requirements:
Excellent software engineering skills and substantial experience with Python.
Hands-on experience building advanced systems with modern language models.
Deep familiarity with several areas relevant to AI agents, such as planning, tool use, retrieval, memory, structured generation, model adaptation, or evaluation.
The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a technical research plan and then into working software.
Strong experimental instincts: you form clear hypotheses, design meaningful tests, and make decisions based on evidence.
Sound judgment about when to use an AI technique and when a deterministic approach is more effective.
Ownership of the complete result, including its behavior after reaching production.
Nice to Have:
Developing autonomous or long-running agents that interact with real systems.
Building evaluation environments, simulations, or benchmarks for complex model behavior.
Experience in cybersecurity, identity, security operations, or enterprise automation.
Applying published research or your own research to production problems.

AI Software Engineer
Tel Aviv
· Full-time
About The Position
Upwind is a next-generation Cloud Security Platform that leverages runtime context to identify and prioritize critical risks, providing precise insights and efficient cloud security management. Unlike traditional tools, Upwind uses runtime data proactively for risk prioritization and posture insights, ensuring teams focus on what truly matters. With industry-leading efficiency and eBPF-powered sensors, Upwind delivers comprehensive capabilities, including agentless cloud posture discovery, real-time threat protection, and integrated API security. From misconfigurations to malware defense, Upwind ensures end-to-end, cost-effective cloud infrastructure protection. At Upwind, you’ll have the opportunity to think creatively, explore new ideas, and use your skills to make a meaningful impact on our growth.
We’re looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to build and own the agentic workflows at the heart of our security intelligence engine. This is a backend-focused engineering role : you’ll design, build, and maintain the autonomous systems that execute security workflows end-to-end — taking capabilities from research prototype to scalable, production-grade infrastructure.
You’ll be working at the edge of applied AI, turning LLMs and agentic frameworks into reliable, observable systems that operate in real customer environments.
What You’ll Build:
Agentic Workflows (Core Focus): Design and maintain the orchestration backbone for multi-step, autonomous agents that investigate, reason about, and act on complex security operations.
Internal AI Infrastructure: Contribute to a shared platform for models, data pipelines, training, evaluation, and observability that the whole AI team builds on.
Responsibilities:
Build and maintain the agentic workflow engine — orchestration, tool use, state management, retries, and evaluation — that powers our AI-driven security features.
Develop the backend services and APIs that deploy AI capabilities safely and at scale.
Collaborate with AI Researchers to translate findings into production-grade autonomous workflows.
Own reliability, observability, and performance of the agentic systems in production.
Requirements
Mid-to-senior engineering experience, or relevant technical military experience.
Strong backend engineering background with a focus on ML/AI systems.
Hands-on experience building with **LLMs and agentic frameworks** in production.
Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment, bridging research and product engineering.
Strong Advantages:
Experience with LangChain / LangGraph (or comparable agent-orchestration frameworks) — a significant plus for this role
Experience with evaluation frameworks and observability for non-deterministic AI systems.
Apply for this position

We are looking for a highly technical Infrastructure Team Lead to establish and lead a new Infrastructure team.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on the scalability, performance, and reliability of the systems our product and engineering teams run on. You will design and evolve our core infrastructure: databases, messaging systems, and the services around them- to keep pace with a fast-growing, high-load, multi-tenant system, while building and leading the team responsible for it.
This is a leadership role for someone who stays close to the technology: setting technical direction, guiding architecture, getting hands-on with hard performance and scale problems, and working through complex production challenges alongside the team.

Take ownership of our infrastructure's scalability, performance, and reliability — end to end, across a fast-growing, high-volume system
Build and lead a new infrastructure team, hiring and mentoring engineers as the team grows
Dive deep into architecture, databases (Aurora, OpenSearch, Redis), and system design to identify and resolve scale and performance bottlenecks
Work hands-on with messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and database infrastructure to keep pace with increasing load
Consolidate infrastructure work under one team and bring structure and clear ownership to this core domain.
Operate independently — you'll be given real ownership and real problems to solve, and you're expected to drive solutions without needing constant guidance
Partner with engineering teams across the company, but as the clear owner of infrastructure decisions, not just an advisor
Requirements
5+ years of hands-on software development / architecture experience and at least 2 years as a team lead/ tech lead, you've built and designed real systems, not just directed others
A proven, demonstrable track record of driving significant performance improvements- measurable gains in efficiency, latency, or system load.
Strong understanding of databases, scalability challenges, and system architecture
Experience across more than one company/environment
A degree (any field, any institution)
Independent, self-driven working style- you take a problem and run with it
Experience with Java is a big plus
What Success Looks Like
You build a team that can independently carry infrastructure work
You can take a messy, high-pressure infrastructure problem and turn it into a solved, owned, well-architected system
You help strengthen company culture where scale and performance solutions are happening by design and planning, not reactively.
Leadership can hand you a hard problem and have strong confidence that you will be able to handle it end to end autonomously.

We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager, part technologist, part storyteller, and deeply hands-on in turning complex cloud security concepts into clear, compelling narratives that resonate with engineers and security leaders. You’ll think like a security engineer and write like a product marketer, creating technical content, product narratives, launch assets, and enablement materials that explain not just what Upwind does, but how it works and why it’s architecturally different.
This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you’ll bring technical strategy to life through content. You’ll report to the Head of Product Marketing and collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Demand Gen, Sales, and leadership to turn complex innovation into market-ready messaging and assets that drive real pipeline impact.
﻿What You’ll Do
Own the technical narrative for Go To Market Enablement. Partner with Product to define use cases, and build supporting assets and training material for new features and releases.
Create and execute high-impact technical content. From deep-dive technical blogs and solution guides to architecture explainers and product landing pages, you’ll produce content that security engineers and cloud teams actually want to read.
Partner closely with Content Marketing to translate complex messaging into creative content formats and experiences across written, social, video, etc.
Translate complex architecture into clear value. Turn runtime telemetry, eBPF instrumentation, Kubernetes metadata, identity context, and API flow mapping into differentiated, defensible positioning.
Support demand with technical credibility. Collaborate with Demand Gen to provide strong technical angles for campaigns, content offers, and field programs that educate buyers over time, not just capture leads.
Develop competitive and market POVs. Analyze the CNAPP and cloud security landscape to create technically grounded differentiation and comparison assets that stand up to scrutiny.
Keep our technical voice sharp. Ensure our product storytelling is precise, modern, and human, authoritative when discussing architecture, and approachable when discussing customer value.

3–6 years of experience in product marketing, technical marketing, solutions engineering, product management, or a related role at an enterprise SaaS company, ideally in cloud security or cloud infrastructure.
Deep curiosity about how things work. You’re comfortable reading architecture docs, asking engineers hard questions, and understanding runtime systems at a technical level.
Understands the full sales processes, from pitching, to Demo to POC to production.
Strong technical writing skills. You can take complex infrastructure concepts and turn them into structured, compelling narratives without oversimplifying or hiding behind jargon.
Experience marketing to technical audiences. You’ve written for security engineers, DevOps teams, platform engineers, or CISOs and understand how to earn credibility with them.
Hands-on execution mindset. You don’t just define positioning, you write the blog, build the page outline, create the sales asset, and help get it live.
Familiarity with cloud-native environments. Kubernetes, containers, APIs, IAM, vulnerability management, runtime security, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, code, application security, Shift Left, Sast or related domains.
Comfort working cross-functionally. You can translate between Engineering, Sales, and Marketing without losing clarity or technical accuracy.
Fluency in modern marketing tools. Comfortable with CMS platforms, marketing automation tools like HubSpot, web tools like Webflow, analytics platforms, and enablement systems. Bonus for experience with demo tools, Storylane, or technical visualization tools.
Data-informed and impact-driven. You care about adoption, engagement, and pipeline influence, and you refine messaging based on real feedback from the field.
Comfortable with ambiguity and speed. You’re energized by building in a fast-moving startup where features ship quickly and messaging evolves alongside the product.

At Utila, you’ll help build the modern, enterprise-grade platform that powers digital asset operations for more than 200 global institutions. Join us, and help build something big.

Outline Utila’s product direction : Define the roadmap based on market research, competitive analysis, and direct engagement with prospects and customers.

Description
VAST Data is looking for a Senior AI Engineer to design and build production-grade, LLM-powered systems. You'll work at the intersection of software engineering and applied AI — shipping agents, RAG pipelines, and tool-using systems that solve real problems at scale. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who thrives at the frontier of what's possible with modern LLMs and isn't afraid to write the glue, the infrastructure, and the prompts that make it all work.
This is a **cross-functional, company-wide role**. You won't be embedded in a single product team — instead, you'll partner with every department to identify high-leverage opportunities and build AI-powered tools and workflows that boost productivity and efficiency across the entire organization.
This is a great opportunity to be part of one of the fastest-growing infrastructure companies in history, an organization that is in the center of the hurricane being created by the revolution in artificial intelligence.
"VAST's data management vision is the future of the market."- Forbes
VAST Data is the data platform company for the AI era. We are building the enterprise software infrastructure to capture, catalog, refine, enrich, and protect massive datasets and make them available for real-time data analysis and AI training and inference. Designed from the ground up to make AI simple to deploy and manage, VAST takes the cost and complexity out of deploying enterprise and AI infrastructure across data center, edge, and cloud.
Our success has been built through intense innovation, a customer-first mentality and a team of fearless VASTronauts who leverage their skills & experiences to make real market impact. This is an opportunity to be a key contributor at a pivotal time in our company’s growth and at a pivotal point in computing history.
What You'll Do:
- Design, build, and operate LLM-powered applications, agents, and workflows end-to-end — from prototype to production.
- Architect retrieval, context engineering, and tool-use strategies that make models reliable, accurate, and cost-efficient.
- Integrate LLMs with internal services, third-party APIs, and data stores to automate complex business and engineering workflows.
- Build, evaluate, and continuously improve evaluation harnesses for non-deterministic systems.
- Collaborate closely with product, research, and platform teams to translate ambiguous problems into shipped capabilities.
- Stay ahead of the rapidly evolving LLM ecosystem (models, frameworks, agentic patterns) and bring the best ideas into our stack.
Requirements
﻿ Engineering Foundations:
- Strong Python skills- you write clean, idiomatic, well-tested code and understand the language deeply.
- Hands-on experience using coding agents(Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to build complex software systems. You know how to delegate effectively to AI assistants and review their output critically.
- Experience with multiple database paradigms- both SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB, or similar). You can choose the right tool for the job.
- Experience designing and integrating with third-party APIs- REST and gRPC. Comfortable building robust clients, handling auth, retries, rate limits, and schema evolution.
- Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes- containerizing services, writing manifests, and debugging deployments.
- Strong Linux fundamentals- confident in bash and the terminal; you can navigate, script, and troubleshoot a server without reaching for a GUI.
- Experience building cloud-native tools on AWS, GCP, or Azure (compute, storage, queues, serverless, IAM).
AI / LLM Expertise:
- Solid understanding of what an LLM is and how it works- tokenization, attention, context windows, sampling, and the practical implications of each for system design.
- Strong grasp of modern patterns for integrating LLMs into real workflows, including RAG, MCP (Model Context Protocol), vector databases, agents, tool use, and context engineering- with hands-on experience building with several of them.
- Production experience implementing LLM-powered systems end-to-end, using relevant tools and frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Haystack, Pydantic AI, vector stores like Pinecone/Weaviate/pgvector, observability tools like LangSmith or Langfuse).
- Solid foundation in core ML concepts; embeddings, evaluation, overfitting, generalization, and how classical ML relates to and differs from modern LLM-based approaches.
Nice to Have:
- Experience fine-tuning or distilling open-source models.
- Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects.
- Experience with streaming, real-time systems, or low-latency inference.
- Familiarity with prompt evaluation frameworks and LLM-as-judge methodologies.
- Background in distributed systems or high-scale backend engineering.
What We Look For:
- A builder's mindset; you ship, measure, iterate, and don't get stuck in analysis.
- Comfort with ambiguity; LLM systems are non-deterministic and the field moves weekly. You navigate that with curiosity rather than frustration.
- Strong communication; you can explain trade-offs to engineers, product managers, and executives alike.
- Pragmatism; you know when to reach for a 200-line script and when to invest in proper infrastructure.

A Solutions Engineer works to balance various aspects of the project, from safety to design. Additionally, a Solutions Engineer researches advanced technology regarding best practices in the field and seek to find cost-effective solutions.
Job Description:
We’re looking for a Solutions Engineer with deep experience in Big Data technologies, real-time data pipelines, and scalable infrastructure—someone who’s been delivering critical systems under pressure, and knows what it takes to bring complex data architectures to life. This isn’t just about checking boxes on tech stacks—it’s about solving real-world data problems, collaborating with smart people, and building robust, future-proof solutions.
In this role, you’ll partner closely with engineering, product, and customers to design and deliver high-impact systems that move, transform, and serve data at scale. You’ll help customers architect pipelines that are not only performant and cost-efficient but also easy to operate and evolve.
We want someone who’s comfortable switching hats between low-level debugging, high-level architecture, and communicating clearly with stakeholders of all technical levels.
Key Responsibilities:
Build distributed data pipelines using technologies like Kafka, Spark (batch & streaming), Python, Trino, Airflow, and S3-compatible data lakes—designed for scale, modularity, and seamless integration across real-time and batch workloads.
Design, deploy, and troubleshoot hybrid cloud/on-prem environments using Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD automation tools.
Implement event-driven and serverless workflows with precise control over latency, throughput, and fault tolerance trade-offs.
Create technical guides, architecture docs, and demo pipelines to support onboarding, evangelize best practices, and accelerate adoption across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams.
Integrate data validation, observability tools, and governance directly into the pipeline lifecycle.
Own end-to-end platform lifecycle: ingestion → transformation → storage (Parquet/ORC on S3) → compute layer (Trino/Spark).
Benchmark and tune storage backends (S3/NFS/SMB) and compute layers for throughput, latency, and scalability using production datasets.
Work cross-functionally with R&D to push performance limits across interactive, streaming, and ML-ready analytics workloads.
Operate and debug object store–backed data lake infrastructure, enabling schema-on-read access, high-throughput ingestion, advanced searching strategies, and performance tuning for large-scale workloads.
Required Skills & Experience:
2–4 years in software / solution or infrastructure engineering, with 2–4 years focused on building / maintaining large-scale data pipelines / storage & database solutions.
Proficiency in Trino, Spark (Structured Streaming & batch) and solid working knowledge of Apache Kafka.
Coding background in Python (must-have); familiarity with Bash and scripting tools is a plus.
Deep understanding of data storage architectures including SQL, NoSQL, and HDFS.
Solid grasp of DevOps practices, including containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and infrastructure provisioning (Terraform).
Experience with distributed systems, stream processing, and event-driven architecture.
Hands-on familiarity with benchmarking and performance profiling for storage systems, databases, and analytics engines.
Excellent communication skills—you’ll be expected to explain your thinking clearly, guide customer conversations, and collaborate across engineering and product teams.

Voyantis.description:
Description
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our growing Data Infrastructure team!
The team's main responsibility is developing Voyantis' data platform - from building the microservices and pipelines that onboard customer data into our platform, to the infrastructure and tooling that enables our internal data teams to analyze, transform, process, and collect data independently. Our goal is to build leverage: every feature we ship reduces friction for the teams that depend on our platform. We're looking for a builder who takes full ownership from inception to production, cares deeply about quality and performance, and leverages AI tools to move faster and deliver better outcomes.
About Us
Voyantis was founded in 2020 on the premise that market fundamentals are shifting companies worldwide from growth-at-all-costs strategies to efficient and responsible growth practices, with a focus on improving Unit Economics. With a bold mission to leverage AI to reimagine the whole Growth process, to streamline this transition and ensure its sustainability, Voyantis eliminates the guesswork from customer value creation, empowering leaders with actionable strategies and tactics to acquire, nurture and retain the high-value customers their businesses really need, with the actions and the timing that would be most impactful to achieve their goals.
Leading companies like Miro, Rappi and Moneylion rely on Voyantis to effectively apply these predictions. They use Voyantis to drive high-value customer acquisition on platforms like Google and Meta, optimize incentives through Salesforce and Braze, and perfectly time upsells, resulting in a 20%-40% ROI uplift.
Voyantis is well-backed by top VCs such as Target Global and SquarePeg. The company has tripled in size annually over the past two years and now boasts a team of 100 with offices in California, New York and Tel Aviv.
Responsibilities
Design and implement scalable, production-grade data pipelines and microservices that ingest, transform, and move data from a wide variety of customer sources at high volume.
Build and maintain high-performance backend services and APIs that interface with our data ecosystem, ensuring reliability, low latency, and security.
Develop and evolve the platform infrastructure — data warehouse, orchestration, compute — that internal data teams rely on daily.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring workflows and turn ad-hoc needs into robust, self-serve platform capabilities.
Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and engineers across R&D to translate requirements into platform features.
Drive code quality through design reviews, code reviews, and adherence to engineering best practices.
Leverage AI tools throughout the full engineering cycle — from scoping and design to implementation and debugging — to deliver faster, higher-quality outcomes.
Requirements
5+ years building production backend services in Python / Go / Node
Strong software engineering fundamentals — design patterns, testing, CI/CD, microservices architecture
﻿ Experience designing and operating distributed systems in cloud environments (AWS)
Deep understanding of data — modeling, pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and query optimization.
Experience with modern data warehouses such as Snowflake / Databricks and orchestration tools such as Airflow / dbt.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale datasets.
Proven ability to take ownership end-to-end: from gathering requirements and designing solutions to deployment and production support.
Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) as a core part of the engineering workflow.
Proactive by nature with a strong sense of ownership and internal drive for excellence.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; high English proficiency.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
Voyantis.title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Platform

Reporting directly to the CTO, you will lead a group of three Product Managers, setting direction, raising the bar on product craft, and growing them as practitioners. This is a player-coach role: you will own the group's strategy and its people, while staying close enough to the product to make sharp calls on scope, model behavior, and customer trade-offs yourself.
A defining part of this role is your partnership with Operations. Today, a lot of what makes Acquire work is carried by our Operations team working alongside our AI engine. You will embed with them, understand their day-to-day in real detail, and productize it: turning manual and repetitive work into scalable, agent-driven capabilities so we can scale even further.
About Us
Voyantis was founded in 2020 on the premise that market fundamentals are shifting companies worldwide from growth-at-all-costs strategies to efficient and responsible growth practices, with a focus on improving Unit Economics. With a bold mission to leverage AI to reimagine the whole Growth process, to streamline this transition and ensure its sustainability, Voyantis eliminates the guesswork from customer value creation, empowering leaders with actionable strategies and tactics to acquire, nurture and retain the high-value customers their businesses really need, with the actions and the timing that would be most impactful to achieve their goals.
Leading companies like Miro, Rappi and Moneylion rely on Voyantis to effectively apply these predictions. They use Voyantis to drive high-value customer acquisition on platforms like Google and Meta, optimize incentives through Salesforce and Braze, and perfectly time upsells, resulting in a 20%-40% ROI uplift.
Voyantis is well-backed by top VCs such as Target Global and SquarePeg. The company has tripled in size annually over the past two years and now boasts a team of 100 with offices in California, New York and Tel Aviv.
Responsibilities
Own the Acquire strategy and roadmap end to end, from problem definition and prioritization through launch and adoption, and define the success metrics the group is held to, favoring experimentation and clear evidence over opinion.
Lead, coach, and grow a group of three Product Managers, setting clear ownership boundaries, quality standards, and a healthy operating rhythm across the group.
Partner with Data Science and Engineering to translate predictive model capabilities into product value, making informed trade-offs between model performance, signal latency, explainability, and customer trust, grounded in deep expertise in ad platform mechanics (Smart Bidding tCPA/tROAS, UAC, SKAN and privacy-driven attribution shifts).
Work side by side with Operations to learn their workflows firsthand and turn them into product: agentic workflows, AI-driven automation, and self-serve tooling that let a small team scale across a much larger client base.
Stay close to customers and partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing on positioning, launch readiness, and expansion.
Requirements
Experience & Leadership: 6+ years in product management, including experience leading and developing other PMs. Able to set direction and raise the standard across a group while remaining hands-on where it matters, with strong cross-functional influence across Engineering, Data Science, Operations, and Sales.
Domain Expertise: Strong background in marketing technology, ad-tech, or growth/performance marketing products. Familiarity with paid acquisition, bidding, attribution, and measurement is a significant advantage.
AI & Predictive Products: Hands-on experience shipping products built on predictive models or machine learning, plus practical experience designing agentic and LLM-based workflows into real products. Comfortable discussing model quality, evaluation, and failure modes with data scientists.
Product Craft & Customer Orientation: Excellent judgment on prioritization and scope, strong analytical and data fluency, and the ability to reduce a complex, ambiguous space into a clear product direction. Credible and comfortable with both external customers and internal operational stakeholders.

CyberSec Engineer
Kyiv
Wiliot was founded by the team that invented one of the technologies at the heart of 5G. Their next vision was to develop an IoT sticker, a self-powered computing element that harvests radio frequency energy, bringing connectivity and intelligence to everyday products and packaging. This revolutionary combination of cloud and semiconductor technology is already being used by some of the world’s largest consumer, retail, food, and pharmaceutical companies to transform how products are made, distributed, sold, used, and recycled.
Our investors include SoftBank, Amazon, Alibaba, Verizon, NTT DoCoMo, Qualcomm, and PepsiCo.
CyberSec Engineer works with all business units, supporting and maintaining IT security solutions and related governance for empowering business success. IT Security is responsible for protecting Cloud and IT infrastructure, edge devices, networks, and data. Responsible for preventing data breaches and monitoring and reacting to attacks.
CyberSec Engineer works on implementing a new developmental approach to the entire organization in preventing and alleviating threats/attacks. Oversee the company's security, backup, and redundancy strategies support. Should support security procedures in the software development process at every stage in the organization's ISMS activities.
The role relies on AI-assisted tools and scripting/automation to speed up analysis, response, and reporting.
Responsibilities:
● Assist and guide implementation of the ISMS activities.
● Monitoring the compliance of information security policies and procedures.
● Report to Senior Management periodically on different ISMS activities.
● Responsible for IT security, recognizing the security threats, and working with the IT team on closing vulnerabilities and mitigating misconfigurations.
● Monitoring and auditing that company's critical assets are secured and controlled.
● Incident Response - testing for and resolving system vulnerabilities, maintaining strong security best practices, and providing support for all incident handling measures.
● Install, configure, test, and maintain security systems, and other security tools related to IT Security.
● Maintain and support with SOC team collaboration and MDR service management.
● Use AI-based tools and scripting/automation to accelerate threat analysis, vulnerability triage, and security reporting.
Requirements
University or post-graduate degree
Strong academic background (e.g., computer science, engineering)
3+ years of experience in IT Security (IT Security and Cloud tools)
Strong private and public cloud security experience.
Experience and knowledge in security architecture, identity and access management, application security, and network security.
Cloud security experience.
Experience with Identity, SSO solutions and methodology. SAML and similar protocols.
Excellent written / verbal communication and professional maturity.
Able to multi-task in a fast paced, deadline-driven work environment.
Ability to work in afterhours to complete tasks in different time zones.
Ability to consistently demonstrate and reinforce organizational values.
Threat intelligence analyst experience. SIEM analyst experience.
Incident forensics (Digital forensics and incident response (DFIR)).
ISO 27001/27018 knowledge.
Working knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) for automation, log analysis, and security tool integration.
Solid understanding of network security fundamentals (TCP/IP, firewalls, VPN, network segmentation) and operating system security (Linux and Windows hardening, patch management).

San Mateo
Wiliot was founded by the team that invented one of the technologies at the heart of 5G. Their next vision was to develop an IoT sticker, a computing element that can power itself by harvesting radio frequency energy, bringing connectivity and intelligence to everyday products and packaging, things previously disconnect from the IoT. About the Role
We are looking for a Data Solutions Team Lead to join our delivery teams and work closely with customers on real-world IoT deployments.
In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring, analyzing, and improving the quality and performance of data generated from customer environments. You will work as part of cross-functional Scrum teams, partnering with customers, product, and engineering to ensure successful deployments and meaningful data outcomes.
This is a highly customer-facing, hands-on role that sits at the intersection of data, operations, and product.
﻿Responsibilities
· Work closely with customers as part of ongoing projects and deployments
· Monitor real-time data streams and system performance across customer environments
· Analyze data to identify trends, gaps, and anomalies in performance and data quality
· Investigate issues and perform root cause analysis (e.g. data collection issues, tag placement, configuration gaps, integration issues)
· Translate data into clear, actionable insights for both customers and internal teams
· Build dashboards and visualizations to communicate system performance and business impact
· Partner with FDE, Product, and Engineering teams to improve solutions and close gaps
· Escalate product or data issues and collaborate with internal teams to drive resolution
· Guide customers and field teams on best practices to improve deployment performance and data quality
﻿Requirements
· Bachelor's degree in Math, CS, data science/engineering or equivalent analytical degree
· 3–5+ years of experience in data analysis, technical customer-facing roles, or similar
· Architecture experience in big data, data warehousing, operational analytics and integration.
· Optimize the performance of big data systems to design and implement efficient analytics algorithms.
· Strong Python skills
· Experience with SPARK strongly preferred.
· Visualization tools experience including UI design (Plotly, Tableau, PowerBI, Grafana)
· Understanding of statistical analysis and relational database structures (SQL, Influxdb a plus)
· Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving abilities
· Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
· Ability to be self-sufficient and execute quickly when given autonomy
· Experience with IoT data streams and business context a plus
· Flexible team player who will thrive in a dynamic, constantly evolving environment

Responsibilities:
Technical Support and Maintenance:
Conduct, and/or coordinate the repair, preventive maintenance of ZOLL medical devices to ensure operational efficiency and compliance with standards.
Travel across Australia & New Zealand at short notice
Promote and support ZOLL Service Agreements to achieve individual and territory revenue budgets
Ensure that service documentation is completed accurately and in a timely manner for all service activities, including repair logs and preventative maintenance records.
Manage customer and distributor relationships to achieve Customer Satisfaction Targets
Maintain correct spare part inventory levels and participate in quarterly stock stake.
Actively seek product and business improvement suggestions from our customers.
Maintain Product Return Register
Add details of reported faults to the returns register and email return reference and shipping instructions to customers.
Update entries in the returns register when servicing/repair work has been completed by the service team.
Enter fault details into the service module to create a Service Report
Organise loan units if required after booking equipment into the returns register.
Preventative Maintenance (PM) Schedule
Together with the ZOLL Service Admin team, plan and co-ordinate PMs to ensure 100% on-time PMs are conducted.
Co-ordinate with third party service provider to ensure PMs conducted on time.
Customer Engagement and Service Excellence:
Develop and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders, serving as the primary technical contact for ZOLL Medical
Proactively address and resolve any customer concerns or feedback in a manner that aligns with ZOLL standards for customer service excellence.
Conduct customer training sessions and educational workshops as needed to ensure end users are well-equipped to use and maintain ZOLL products safely and effectively.
Develop and maintain strong communication links with management and sales staff providing updated customer information to support future initiatives.
Compliance and Safety:
Ensure all technical services are delivered in compliance with applicable local and national regulations, industry standards, and company policies, including health and safety standards.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service processes, reduce downtime, and maximize product performance.
Effective planning to ensure achieving of department revenue budget.
Qualifications and Experience:
· Bachelor’s degree in biomedical engineering, Electronics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent work experience.
· Minimum of 5 years of experience in a technical service or support role within the medical device industry, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or leadership capacity.
· Proven expertise in the maintenance and support of complex medical devices, with specific experience in defibrillators, monitors, or similar life- saving equipment being highly desirable.
· Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to inspire and develop a team.
· Exceptional troubleshooting, diagnostic, and problem-solving skills with a hands-on approach to technical issues.
· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with diverse stakeholders.
· Demonstrated ability to manage projects and resources effectively, with attention to detail and a commitment to meeting deadlines.
· Familiarity with health and safety regulations and a commitment to ensuring a safe working environment.
· Availability for on-call support and willingness to travel locally as needed for on-site service support.
Personal Attributes:
· A collaborative and team-oriented mindset with excellent interpersonal skills.
· Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
· Highly adaptable and resilient, with a strong commitment to excellence.
· Ability to multitask and work effectively in a team environment.
· Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with inventory management systems.
· Detail-oriented with strong organisational skills.
· A customer-first mindset with a commitment to providing outstanding service.
· Ability to handle pressure and adapt to a fast-paced environment.
· Willingness to learn and take on diverse responsibilities within the team.
Strong Communication and interpersonal skills

Zoll Medical Corporation.description:
In this role, you will own the end-to-end solution architecture, ensuring that design, configurations, and integrations are aligned with ZOLL’s strategic business objectives and long-term operational roadmap.
This role requires a unique combination of deep functional knowledge of Oracle Cloud ERP Field Service, Service Contracts, and Repair modules, hands-on configuration expertise, and the ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from design through deployment and ongoing support.
Your primary mission is to design robust, scalable, and high-performing solutions, with a particular emphasis on the core Oracle Cloud ERP Field Service, Service Contracts, Depot Repair, and Territory Management modules.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead and participate in all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, go-live, and post production support.
• Demonstrated success in integrating Oracle Fusion Service to streamline and enhance field service operations, ensuring seamless connectivity between back-office systems and on-site service execution.
• Proven expertise in deploying Oracle Field Service Cloud solutions to optimize scheduling, enable real-time tracking, and support predictive maintenance for field teams—resulting in improved stakeholder satisfaction and increased operational efficiency.
• Demonstrates the ability to align Oracle Fusion Service and Oracle Field Service Cloud strategies with organization-wide initiatives, enabling innovative service delivery models and delivering measurable business value.
• Perform hands-on configuration of Oracle Cloud Field Service, Service Contracts, Territory Management, and Depot Repair modules to meet evolving business requirements.
• Ensure solutions are scalable, sustainable, and aligned with Oracle's leading practices. Provide advisory guidance to project teams on functional and configuration decisions.
• Translate complex technical and functional concepts into clear, actionable insights for business stakeholders. Manage expectations and drive successful delivery outcomes.
• Demonstrate broad expertise across Oracle Service and Repair modules, with deep specialization and understanding in Discrete Manufacturing.
• Diagnose and resolve complex system issues, especially within Service modules, and develop effective, long-term solutions.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with technical teams, business users, and leadership to ensure alignment and successful execution of Service initiatives.
Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information science, or engineering required, master’s degree in a related field preferred
• 15+ years of Oracle Supply Chain experience, including 5 years in Oracle Fusion Cloud Service. Oracle Cloud Service Certification(s) preferred.
• Extensive functional and configuration experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud Field Service, Depot Repair, Service Contracts, and Territory Management
• Proven ability to lead complex projects through full implementation lifecycles.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills within the Oracle Service side.
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Experience with Oracle Fusion Applications (CX, ERP, HCM) is highly desirable.
• Ability to work independently, drive decisions, and influence teams across the organization.
The annual salary for this position is:
$125,100.00 to $165,000.00
Factors which may affect starting salary include geography, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. Details of ZOLL's comprehensive benefits plans can be found at www.zollbenefits.com .

Main Roles and Responsibilities:
Interpersonal Excellence & Relationship Management
Middle Management Ally : Act as a close partner and trusted advisor to Heads of Departments (HODs). Understand their daily operational struggles, diagnose friction points, and provide them with active, human-centric support rather than bureaucratic barriers.
Employee Connection & Trust : Be an approachable, visible point of contact for employees - making sure they feel heard, valued, and connected to our culture.
High Emotional Intelligence (EQ) : Navigate complex personal, political, and cultural dynamics across different regions with extreme sensitivity, maturity, and a human-first approach.
Salesforce System, Portal & Core People Management
Department & Team Leadership : Lead, mentor, and direct a global HR team of professionals, establishing high operational standards and clear ownership of execution.
System & Portal Ownership: Run day-to-day employee processes - onboarding, offboarding, probation check-ins, and promotions - entirely within Salesforce .
Org Data Integrity: Maintain all org charts, reporting lines, job titles, and department structures accurate and up to date in Salesforce.
Cross-Departmental Collaboration & Global Alignment
Universal Departmental Alignment: Ensure equitable, high-touch support across all global business units.
Think Global, Do Local Focus : Maintain consistent global HR standards while tailoring execution to local office cultures and regulations.
Talent Strategy & Career Paths: Build internal talent pools and clear career progression paths in alignment with HODs.
Performance, Leadership & Managerial Detection
Managerial Coaching & Detection : Proactively monitor internal team dynamics to detect leadership gaps, providing continuous guidance, mentorship, and practical management tools to HODs.
Practical Performance Reviews: Lead lightweight performance cycles focused on real growth and feedback, rather than formal "box-ticking."
Conflict Resolution: Decisively resolve organizational challenges, toxic behaviors, and escalations with empathy and high integrity.
Recruitment & Offboarding Logistics
Recruiter Performance Monitoring: Actively monitor the progress, output, and quality of results delivered by external or internal recruiters to ensure high-quality and timely talent acquisition.
Compliant & Smooth Onboarding and Offboarding: Lead voluntary and involuntary terminations in close coordination with Zota’s Legal team.
Risk Mitigation & Asset Retrieval: Oversee asset retrieval and work with IT/Security to ensure prompt access removal when someone leaves.

A minimum of 8 years of professional HR experience, with a proven track record of owning end-to-end people processes.
Managerial Experience: Solid, proven team management experience (must have managed at least 2-3 direct reports previously). The candidate must demonstrate the ability to lead, delegate, and scale a global team.
Language Requirement : Business-fluent or native English (written and spoken).
Advanced Salesforce System Skills: Proven, deep hands-on experience utilizing Salesforce as the primary platform for data management and task tracking is an absolute prerequisite.
Stellar Interpersonal Skills: Natural charisma, outstanding empathy, and a proven track record of building authentic, trust-based relationships with middle management and diverse employee groups.
Fast-Paced Startup/Scale-up Background : Mandatory experience working within high-growth, fast-paced startup or scale-up environments. Must demonstrate the ability to build processes from scratch, adapt to fluid environments, and handle rapid organizational changes.
Global Footprint: Demonstrated history of managing employee processes across diverse geographic regions and offices globally, focusing equally on international and local teams.
Anti-Corporate Mindset: Built for fast-paced, fluid environments. Disdains standard corporate bureaucracy, preferring lightweight approvals, practical documentation, and decisive execution.

aspectiva.description:
Description
Senior UX Designer at Walmart Global Tech Israel
﻿
About us:
Walmart Global Tech’s presence in Israel has grown over the past few years with 4 acquisitions to date, all develop using industry leading technologies.
We are seeking a highly skilled and self-driven Senior UX Designer to join our Tel Aviv UX team.
The ideal candidate will have strong experience in User Experience (UX/UI) and understanding or User Research (UXR) , combined with strong UI and creative design skills , a deep understanding of research- and data-driven product goals , and the ability to take ownership of end-to-end UX processes .
This role requires a designer who can work in a structured and methodical way —defining problems clearly, grounding decisions in user research and data , and translating insights into clear, intuitive user flows and high-quality experiences , while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead Core Product UX Design: Take full ownership of the user experience for Walmart Israel's digital products, shaping the design vision and transforming complex requirements into intuitive, highly functional digital solutions.
End-to-End Execution: Map comprehensive user journeys and structural workflows, seamlessly translating them into interactive prototypes and pixel-perfect, high-fidelity UI designs.
Research & Data-Driven Iteration: Conduct targeted user research (e.g., usability testing, user interviews) and leverage behavioral analytics to validate design hypotheses, pinpoint friction areas, and continuously optimize the product.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the central design advocate, partnering closely with Product Managers and Engineers to balance user insights with technical feasibility and overarching business goals.
Requirements
UX Strategy, Research & Data
﻿Research & Synthesis Expertise: Demonstrated ability to conduct foundational and evaluative research (interviews, surveys) and distill findings into actionable artifacts like personas and Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD).
Methodological Fluency: Deep understanding of Human-Centered Design principles, Double Diamond frameworks, and Information Architecture modeling.
Analytical Acumen: Strong capability to interpret behavioral data, A/B test results, and funnel metrics to ground design hypotheses in empirical evidence.
Design Execution & Collaboration
Craft & Tooling Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Figma and Adobe CS, backed by a portfolio showcasing scalable design systems and meticulous attention to UI detail.
Collaborative Mindset: Proven track record of thriving in agile, cross-functional environments alongside technical and commercial teams.
Persuasive Communication: Excellent storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently defend design choices to leadership using structured rationale and data.
Nice to Have – AI Mindset:
Interest in how AI is shaping user experience and product design
Ability to integrate AI thinking into discovery, ideation, and UX flows
Awareness of user trust, transparency, and limitations in AI-driven experiences
Experience designing AI-driven or data-informed experiences is a plus
Additional Requirements:
Strong English communication skills
Hebrew – required
aspectiva.title: Senior UX Designer

Description
French Business Operations Specialist at Walmart Global Tech IL
﻿
*This is an outsourced-contractor position for Walmart.
About the role:
Walmart is looking for a proactive, adaptable, and detail-oriented French-Speaking Business Operations Specialist to join our team and support the Walmart Reviews Syndication Program, while also contributing to strategic initiatives that support the continued growth and evolution of the Marketplace business.
In this partner-facing role, you will work closely with Walmart account managers, Marketplace sellers, and internal stakeholders to drive program adoption, support seamless onboarding, and deliver an outstanding partner experience.
This role also offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of operations, partner engagement, and business support. As Marketplace priorities evolve, the scope of the role may expand to include new processes, tools, stakeholder groups, and cross-functional initiatives. We are looking for someone who embraces change, enjoys solving operational challenges, and is excited to grow alongside a fast-evolving business area.
Responsibilities:
Process applications and operational requests in alignment with program guidelines, ensuring data accuracy and quality.
Ensure adherence to program policies, operational procedures, and applicable Legal and Compliance requirements throughout the registration and review syndication process.
Own and manage key workflows and processes using CRM systems and other business tools.
Partner with Walmart associates, Marketplace sellers, and other stakeholders to provide guidance, support, and a seamless experience.
Serve as a trusted point of contact for Marketplace business partners and collaborate on program execution, engagement, and operational initiatives.
Support onboarding, adoption, and ongoing program participation across various stakeholder groups.
Identify opportunities to improve, streamline, and optimize workflows, processes, and reporting.
Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to support evolving business needs and strategic priorities.
Contribute to special projects, testing efforts, process enhancements, and new initiatives as the program and organization continue to grow.
Support operational tracking and help maintain accurate reporting and documentation.
Requirements
Native French speaker with full professional proficiency in English.
Up to 2 years of experience in business operations, program support, customer success, account management, project coordination, or a related field, preferably within eCommerce, technology, retail, or digital platforms.
Comfortable using Excel, PowerPoint, and standard business tools to support reporting, tracking, and operational activities.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships across diverse teams and external partners.
Demonstrated ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities, processes, and business needs.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
Ability to support meetings and collaborate across Israel and Canada & US time zones.
Self-starter with a proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of new challenges.
Curiosity, learning agility, and enthusiasm for working in a dynamic and evolving environment.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
Experience working with CRM platforms and business support tools, such as Salesforce, is a plus.

Description
Walmart Global Tech's presence in Israel has grown over the past few years through 4 acquisitions to date , and this team sits at the core of Walmart's e-commerce platform — the largest retailer in the world .
You'll join an AI Platform team that applies advanced Data Science, NLP, ML, and LLM-based capabilities to infer deep product insights.
Your Mission:
﻿
You bridge complex technical infrastructure and data-science-driven capabilities, turning diverse requests from product teams into a unified, scalable platform roadmap. This is a high-visibility role requiring strong execution and the ability to align engineering, data science, and global stakeholders.
﻿Responsibilities:
﻿Platform Roadmap: Turn diverse requests from product teams into a unified, scalable platform roadmap — prioritized by business impact and scalability.
Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with Data Science, Engineering, and Product teams to resolve dependencies and ship reliably at scale.
Global Collaboration: Work seamlessly with Israel-based and US/global teams, bridging timezones and working styles.
Requirements
2–4 years of PM or Technical PM experience in backend, platform, API, or data-driven environments.
Strong ability to abstract specific feature requests into generalized, reusable platform capabilities.
A B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical/quantitative field — or meaningful equivalent experience.
Deep comfort with technical systems: REST APIs, databases, ETL pipelines, and high-scale data infrastructure. Strong conceptual grasp across the stack (Kafka, NoSQL, BigQuery, agentic/MCP platforms, and similar).
Bias for action — extremely organized, execution-focused, and eager to move fast in ambiguity.
Professional working proficiency in English (spoken and written) — fluent enough to own async communication, lead cross-timezone meetings, and write precise technical specs with a global team.
Advantages & Nice-to-Haves
B2C e-commerce or consumer product background — consumer intuition helps prioritize the right platform signals.
Hands-on experience working alongside Data Science on model evaluations or quality frameworks.
Who Thrives Here
We especially appreciate people who...
Are genuinely excited by the challenge of building infrastructure that scales to hundreds of millions of shoppers — even when the work itself is invisible to them.
Learn fast, share ideas openly, and give honest feedback.
Have a can-do attitude and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
Think in systems — connecting a single technical decision to its impact across every team and surface it touches.
Not sure you fit all the criteria? Apply anyway — let us decide.

Description
This is a temporary position covering a maternity leave, for a period of six months
Walmart Global Tech’s presence in Israel has grown over the past few years with 4 acquisitions to date. The team is an integral part of the core of Walmart’s e-commerce platform – the largest retailer in the world. In Aspectiva, the first acquisition in this site, we build state-of-the-art NLP solutions that enable millions of Walmart shoppers to make smarter and more confident buying decisions.
We are looking for an Associate AI Product Manager (entry-level position) to join our team for a 6-month contract (backfill). This is an opportunity for a highly-capable entry-level individual to gain valuable industry experience, as part of a team of strong product professionals.
You'll work at the intersection of Data Science, e-commerce, and data platforms – owning capabilities that directly shape how millions of customers discover and buy products. You’ll own real product problems, and work across Walmart's e-commerce organization.
The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and technical foundations – from a quantitative, engineering, or CS background – combined with hands-on experience working alongside data science or ML teams, strong intuitions on how to define quality criteria and drive model improvements, and the ability to take full ownership of a technical backlog and deliver results independently.
﻿Responsibilities:
﻿ Own, deeply understand, and execute plans for improving NLP / DS models and capabilities across various domains and customer needs; from prioritizing improvement iterations, through defining quality criteria, to collaborating with DS and Engineering on delivery.
Define evaluation frameworks: Establish quality dimensions, create labelling guidelines and examples, and work with quality and data science teams to build automated evaluation pipelines.
Own and drive a prioritized backlog of improvements to platform capabilities; understand the domain in-depth, gather feedback and faults (incl. customer analytics), and apply methodical reasoning to assess best prioritization within a given capacity.
Collaborate with data science and ML engineers as well as with global product teams, to translate product problems into model improvements; challenge assumptions, evaluate trade-offs, and drive measurable outcomes.
Manage multiple concurrent workstreams across a global, cross-timezone team.
Requirements
1-2 years of Product Management experience in a data-centric or platform-focused role – or proven equivalent analytical/technical background with clear PM-relevant responsibilities.
Strong technical foundation – degree in Computer Science, Data Science, a highly related scientific field
Passion for, and deep understanding of ML and NLP concepts, techniques, and models.
Experience engaging directly with data science or ML functions, feeling comfortable in technical discussions and in meaningfully challenging DS choices.
Strong analytical skills – comfortable with data, metrics, and quality evaluation; able to define what "good" looks like and how to measure it.
Strong written and spoken English; able to communicate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to work independently and drive progress.
Advantage: experience managing B2C products and features.
Advantage: experience working with teams across different time zones and geographies.
We especially appreciate people who...
• Are genuinely excited by the problems AI can solve for shoppers.
• Learn fast, share ideas openly, and give honest feedback.
• Have a can-do attitude and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
• Think customer-first, connect technical outputs to real shopper value and impact.
Not sure you fit all the criteria? Apply anyway — let us decide.

scaleops.description:
ScaleOps is redefining autonomous cloud and AI infrastructure. We're on a mission to free DevOps and platform engineers from manual resource management so they can focus on innovation, not tuning resources. The results: maximized performance and a reduction of cloud costs by up to 80%.
As the category leader in Autonomous Cloud and AI Infrastructure Resource Management, we're trusted by leading enterprises including Adobe, Wiz, Epic Games, Northwestern Mutual, Coinbase, DocuSign, and Fortune 100 companies to autonomously manage their most critical production environments.
Backed by Insight Partners, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and other leading VCs with over $210M in funding, ScaleOps is the leading player in a massive and growing market. We are building the autonomous infrastructure management platform that will power the next decade of enterprise compute.
We're building ScaleOps to be an AI-first company internally, not just in our product. We're looking for a builder to sit inside the CEO office and own that mission end to end: setting the AI roadmap, and personally building and shipping the agents, skills, and tools that every GTM function runs on daily.
What you'll be doing
Set the AI roadmap for the company, and push AI initiatives across the organization
Run the weekly AI review, where each function shows what it automated that week
Enable the CEO directly, keeping him at the front line of AI technology, and drive tech stack improvements
Work closely with R&D leadership to ensure cross-company collaboration
Enabling the Sales, CX and Marketing teams to become AI-native
Ramp every new hire on the ScaleOps AI stack within their first two weeks
Audit every function for AI gaps and prioritize by revenue impact
Measure adoption - hours saved, tasks automated, usage rate per skill
Requirements
Experience at building and shipping AI agents and processes in the last 18 months in a GTM or business operations context, not purely research
Experience leading at least 2-4 people
Highly technical, likely ex-engineer, able to build hands-on and not just direct
Comfortable operating at CEO speed
RevOps experience is a strong advantage - understands GTM workflows end-to-end, including pipeline, CRM hygiene, Gong, Salesforce, lead routing, and post-sales handoffs
Experience working embedded with a sales or marketing team, building AI on top of their actual workflows, is a strong advantage

tailormed.description:
The Role
At TailorMed , we’re on a mission to eliminate barriers across the entire medication journey—from affordability to access and adherence. As a pioneering force in healthcare, we’re building a new category that transforms how patients, providers, pharmacies, life sciences, and payers collaborate to ensure every patient receives the treatment they need without delay.
TailorMed is the medication success platform removing every barrier across the patient journey, from access and affordability through adherence and ongoing care. Our connected network spans 945+ hospitals, 4,700+ clinics, 3,100+ pharmacies, 100+ life sciences programs with a reach of 75 million patients and has secured more than $7.4 billion in financial assistance since 2020 tapping into an asset of 6000+ support programs.
As Sourcing Partner, you’ll own the top of the funnel for TailorMed’s hiring in the US — building pipeline for sales, customer success, operations and marketing roles across all levels. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with a direct line to leadership, where the people you bring in will shape the direction of the company.
You’ll work closely with our recruiters and hiring managers to understand exactly what ‘great’ looks like for each role, build targeted sourcing strategies, and consistently deliver qualified, engaged candidates into the pipeline..
What You’ll Do
• Build and execute targeted sourcing strategies for GTM and Ops roles
• Identify and engage passive candidates in order to impact top of funnel and candidate pipeline
• Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to understand role requirements, ideal candidate profiles, and what makes each role compelling
• Maintain a strong and organised pipeline in our ATS, ensuring accurate tracking and timely communication with candidates
• Contribute to employer branding efforts — helping TailorMed show up in the right communities and in front of the right talent
• Continuously refine sourcing approaches based on data — tracking outreach rates, response rates, and pipeline conversion
• Stay close to the talent market — understanding where great people are, what they care about, and how to reach them
What We’re Looking For
• 3–5 years of sourcing or recruiting experience, with a strong focus on GTM roles (sales, CS, marketing)
• Experience working in digital health B2B SaaS is required. Experiences working for companies in areas such as patient support services, specialty pharmacy, care coordination, or financial assistance platforms is a strong advantage.
• Proven track record of building pipeline for hard-to-fill roles through proactive, creative sourcing
• Strong written communication skills — you write outreach that people actually respond to
• Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS platforms;
• Data-driven mindset — you track what’s working, iterate quickly, and can speak to your pipeline metrics
• Genuinely curious about people — you enjoy the detective work of finding the right person and making a compelling case for why they should talk to us
• Comfortable working in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where things change and priorities shift
Why TailorMed
• Work that matters — every hire you make contributes to a platform that helps patients access care they couldn’t otherwise afford
• A talent function that has a real seat at the table — sourcing is treated as a strategic capability, not a support function
• A high-growth environment where your impact is visible and your scope can grow with you
• A team that is ambitious, collaborative, and genuinely invested in doing things well
• Competitive compensation, benefits, and the flexibility of a fully remote role
We’re not looking for people who want a job. We’re looking for the ones who can’t help but build. If you’re energised by the challenge of finding exceptional people and motivated by work that has real impact, we’d love to hear from you.
TailorMed is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. TailorMed prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
Due to the sensitive nature of the data that TailorMed handles, finalist candidates must complete a successful background and reference check.

About the role
We are looking for an AI Full Stack Engineer to be the technical owner of Pulse, Vi’s client-facing analytics product: an LLM-driven system that lets health enterprises query their data in natural language and get back answers, visualizations, and recommended actions.
You will carry full accountability and single ownership for the architecture, development, and delivery. Tackling roadmap, features development, and system stability.
Responsibilities
Architecture – own the system architecture, determine the technical approach to building the system, and main capabilities within it.
Delivery – own delivery of Pulse as a live and production system to clients.
Non-functional integrity – Reliability, performance, security, observability, and quality across your scope, in a HIPAA-regulated environment handling real patient data.
An AI-native operating model – Agentic development tooling, automated evaluation, and adapt as models and tooling keep changing.
Requirements
4+ years as a Full Stack Engineer, building and maintaining production systems.
AI Engineering capabilities, Production- grade experience with LLM application patterns: agents, orchestration frameworks, RAG.
Build with agentic coding tools daily, and own the output.
Strong backend and data foundations, APIs, real-time and event-driven services, and high-scale distributed data pipelines in Python with Spark or comparable frameworks.
Cloud Capabilities (AWS), you’ve deployed applications to production, used by real customers. Storage, compute (Serverless & k8s), data pipelines (Airflow/Glue/EMR), CDN, security & networking, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions). Worked closely with Infrastructure/DevOps teams.
Exceptional learning velocity, you absorb new domains, tools, and model capabilities faster than the market moves. Being able to tell the difference between what makes true impact and AI slop.
Fluent English, working directly with US-based stakeholders, technical and commercial.
What success looks like in the first 6 months
Taking responsibility for the code and system and getting to a rhythm of delivering features at a fast pace using AI.
Gaining a deep understanding of the system and strategy for the execution of future capabilities.

vi.description:
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, operating, and scaling our cloud infrastructure while supporting both engineering and machine learning initiatives.
You will own our AWS environment end-to-end — from infrastructure architecture and Kubernetes operations to MLOps enablement, security hardening, and cost optimization. This role goes beyond traditional DevOps and includes responsibilities across IT operations support, multi-account AWS management, DevSecOps practices, DevFinOps ownership, and machine learning infrastructure.
You will play a critical role in ensuring our systems are secure, scalable, observable, and cost-efficient, while enabling fast and reliable software and model delivery.
Responsibilities
Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Ownership
Design, implement, and maintain scalable infrastructure in a multi-account AWS organization
Manage and deploy applications using Helm charts, GitOps workflows using ArgoCD
Support CI/CD pipelines and release processes.
Observability & Reliability
Implement and maintain monitoring and logging solutions.
Define alerts, dashboards, and SLOs to ensure system health and operational excellence.
MLOps Enablement
Support and operate ML infrastructure in AWS
Enable reliable model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
DevSecOps & Security
Implement security best practices across infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines
Enforce IAM least-privilege policies and secure networking configurations
Integrate security ownership and compliance controls.
DevFinOps & Cost Optimization
Monitor and optimize AWS resource utilization and costs
Implement cost visibility and reporting practices
IT & Operational Support
Support internal IT-related infrastructure tasks
Continuously improve operational processes and automation
Requirements
~5 years of experience working in a DevOps or Platform Engineering role.
BSc degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent (required).
Strong hands-on experience operating in an AWS environment.
Solid understanding of networking fundamentals , including: VPC design, subnets, routing tables, Load balancers, NAT/Internet gateways.
Experience maintaining Kubernetes clusters at scale , including managing and deploying Helm charts.
Strong background in observability and monitoring using: Prometheus , Grafana , and Loki and CloudWatch.
Experience with GitOps workflows and continuous delivery using ArgoCD.
Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform / Cloudformation), preferably using AWS CDK (Python and/or TypeScript).
Core understanding of MLOps principles , including model deployment, monitoring, versioning, and lifecycle management.
